article.articleHeadline: 中國駐佛得角大使館：涉漢坦病毒疫情郵輪上無中國公民 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde: No Chinese citizens aboard the cruise ship involved in the hantavirus outbreak - Hong Kong Wen Wei Po
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship, anchored off Praia, the capital port of Cape Verde. The World Health Organization and Cape Verde's Ministry of Health reported on May 4 seven cases linked to the vessel: two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases; three deaths, one patient in critical condition, while the remaining cases present with mild symptoms. The ship was confirmed to have no Chinese citizens aboard by the Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde. International health authorities are coordinating the response with relevant countries. The Chinese embassy urged Chinese nationals in Cape Verde to follow official updates from the Cape Verde Health Ministry and the Chinese embassy, maintain hygiene, and avoid contact with rodent species to lower exposure risk. Public health measures and ongoing surveillance are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐カーボベルデ大使館：ハンタウイルス疫情に関連する客船上に中国国籍者はいない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で『異常・予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』に該当（2つ以上）。クルーズ船という国際的移動手段での多国籍乗客関与により、複数国への感染拡大のリスクが存在し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが'People's Republic of China'を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーを精読するとハンタウイルスアウトブレイクはカーボベルデのプライア沖に停泊するMV Hondius客船上で発生しており、中国国籍者がいないことを確認するための中国大使館声明が記事の主題である。実際の感染発生地はカーボベルデであり、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。ただしクルーズ船の国際的性質と多国籍乗客の存在により、国際的な感染拡大リスクは存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, Thai Nguyen province in Vietnam is intensifying efforts to prevent African swine fever (ASF) from spreading further. The current ASF strain is highly virulent, and hot, heavy rainfall conditions are facilitating rapid transmission, shortening the interval from infection to death. Officials have activated the highest level of outbreak response to curb spread and minimize losses to the public and the state, indicating an elevated mobilization of resources and enforcement. The report provides no numerical case or death counts, no laboratory confirmation details, and does not disclose information on infection sources or whether any cases are imported or exported.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生上の異常事象（高毒力株、気象条件による急速な伝播）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、詳細な流行規模・死亡数・確認状況等の情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ベトナム・タイグエン省でのアフリカ豚コレラの流行報告。記事は高毒力株と気象条件による急速伝播を指摘し、最高水準の対応を発動したとしているが、患畜数・死亡数・検査確認の詳細が開示されていない。人間への健康被害の言及がなく、動物衛生上の事象として分類される。続報で流行規模等が明確化された場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 7人发病，3人死亡，豪华游轮无法靠岸 汉坦病毒疫情爆发
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven people fell ill, three dead, luxury cruise ship unable to dock amid hantavirus outbreak
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed hantavirus cases and five suspected, including three fatalities, aboard the luxury cruise Hondius after departing Argentina on April 1; the ship is off Cape Verde in the South Atlantic, unable to dock, pending clearance from Cape Verde health authorities for passenger disembarkation and medical transfer. The cases include a Dutch passenger who developed fever, headache, and mild diarrhea on April 6 and died on board; his wife died en route to the Netherlands and was later confirmed infected. As of May 4, three suspected cases on board show high fever and gastrointestinal symptoms; several others develop pneumonia and severe illness. Hantavirus exposure is thought to be rodent-related. HPS is typical in the Americas and can be contagious in close contact, while Eurasian hantaviruses more often cause HFRS without person-to-person spread. The Shenzhen hospital head Lu Hongzhou notes the pattern aligns with HPS and rapid progression.

triage.headline_ja: 7人が発病、3人が死亡、豪華客船が接岸できず ハンタウイルス感染症流行発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、かつ死亡者3名を含む深刻な事例。国際的移動中の感染症集団発生は公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチンから出発し、喜望峰沖にある豪華客船Hondiusの事例が主題。感染源はハンタウイルスで、齧歯類由来の可能性が高い。Shenzhen病院の専門家Lu Hongyouが言及されているため、China（特にShenzhen）がシグナル監視に関与。対象国リスト内ではThailandとChinaのみが記事の主題として該当する。Netherlands、Argentina、Cape Verdeはいずれも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 一邮轮暴发疫情，已致3人死亡、多人感染，恐发生人际传播，中国大使馆发声
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak on a cruise ship has killed three people and infected many, with suspected person-to-person transmission; the Chinese embassy has issued a statement.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus on the Dutch-owned expedition cruise Hondius, anchored off Praia, Cape Verde, has caused three deaths and infections among 149 people aboard (88 passengers, 61 crew) from 23 countries. The WHO notes hantavirus is usually environmental (rodent excreta) but human-to-human transmission can occur, and suspected transmission on Hondius is reported. Three infected passengers will be airlifted to the Netherlands; others remain in isolation, with a specialist physician assigned. Spain’s health ministry says the ship will dock in the Canary Islands for support, with the operator coordinating next steps. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde reports no Chinese citizens aboard. Separately, a UK national treated for hantavirus in South Africa after traveling on Hondius (Ascension Island, then Johannesburg) is in critical condition; SA finds no wider transmission. Hondius: built 2019, about 108 m, 80 cabins, up to 170 passengers.

triage.headline_ja: 邮轮爆发疫情，已致3人死亡、多人感染，恐发生人际传播，中国大使馆发声（クルーズ船で感染症が発生、3人死亡、多数感染、人間への感染が懸念され、中国大使館が声明を発表）
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス集団発生で死亡3例、149人中複数感染、人人感染の可能性があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当（重症性・国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当し、国際支援の必要性も認められる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には南アフリカ、オランダ、スペイン、カナリア諸島、カーボベルデ、イギリスなど複数国が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはChina（中国大使館への言及のため）のみ。記事の主要イベントはカーボベルデ沖のクルーズ船で発生しており、カーボベルデは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、中国国民乗船の有無確認やハンタウイルスの人人感染確認により、中国への国際的拡大リスクが存在する。オランダの医療施設への患者移送、スペイン領カナリア諸島への寄港予定があり、複数国での対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde confirma mais 391 casos de dengue no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health confirms 391 more dengue fever cases in Paraná
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil, reports 391 new dengue cases, pushing the 2026 total to 3,232 with 2,674 locally acquired infections. The Paraná State Health Department (Sesa-PR) bulletin published May 5 notes the increase since the previous report. By comparison, the May 6, 2025 bulletin recorded 53,416 dengue cases in Paraná, with more than 43,000 locally acquired, underscoring a substantial year-over-year decline. Despite the sizable reduction in early 2026, authorities reiterate the ongoing transmission risk and urge continued preventive measures. The report highlights circulation of all four dengue virus serotypes—DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4—requiring vigilance to prevent further spread. Climate conditions that favor Aedes aegypti breeding are cited as a factor sustaining transmission, and the presence of multiple serotypes raises concerns for future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、パラナ州でデング熱391例が追加確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱感染報告だが、2025年同時期比で大幅な減少傾向（53,416→3,232）であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とは言えない。ただし複数血清型の同時循環と気象条件による継続的な伝播リスクがあるため、経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル・パラナ州の地域報告であり、対象国リストに含まれるブラジルのみが該当。前年比での顕著な減少傾向があり、IHR基準は全て未充足。ただし複数血清型循環と気象条件による継続的伝播リスクが指摘されているため、WPRO基準の「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」に該当する。社会的関心が不明だが、政府レベルでの関心確認が可能なため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: ハンタウイルスがクルーズ船内で感染、3人死亡　「日本に入ってくるリスクは低い」と専門家...中韓では同種ウイルス感染例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus infection aboard a cruise ship leaves three dead; experts say the risk of it entering Japan is low... There have been cases of the same virus in China and South Korea.
article.articleSummary: Six people aboard a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde are suspected to be infected with hantavirus, with three deaths reported. Kenji Kutsuna, professor at Osaka University Medical School, explains transmission occurs when rodent saliva, urine, or feces become aerosolized in dust and inhaled, leading to infection. Symptoms resemble influenza and typically emerge within weeks; severe cases can cause marked lung inflammation and respiratory distress. The case fatality rate is described as tens of percent, and human-to-human transmission is rare. The incident was discussed on News Zero, noting concurrent hantavirus activity in China and South Korea. Japanese experts say the risk of hantavirus entering Japan is low, but the event underscores the need for vigilance around international cruises and rodent-control measures to prevent imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスがクルーズ船内で感染、3人死亡　「日本に入ってくるリスクは低い」と専門家...中韓では同種ウイルス感染例
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染による死亡事例は重症度基準を満たすが、発生地がアルゼンチンからカーボベルデへのクルーズ船（対象国外）であり、verified_locations に該当国がない。中国での同種ウイルス活動は言及されるが主題ではなく、情報不足により継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にJapan、Republic of Korea、China、Argentine Republic、Cape Verdeが含まれるが、記事の主たるイベント（クルーズ船での感染）はアルゼンチア～カーボベルデ間であり、対象国外。中国での同種ウイルス活動への言及のみにより China を verified_locations に含める。IHR基準2つ以上該当するが、対象国での発生ではないため PICKUP ではなく WATCH とする。

article.articleHeadline: 09:12:46更新｜中國駐佛得角使館：涉疫郵輪上無中國公民 請加強衛生防範
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 09:12:46 Update | Chinese Embassy in Cape Verde: There are no Chinese citizens on the cruise ship linked to the outbreak. Please strengthen hygiene precautions.
article.articleSummary: On May 4, 2026, the Hondius cruise ship, moored off Praia, Cape Verde, reported a hantavirus outbreak. WHO and Cape Verde’s health authorities documented seven cases on the vessel, including two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases; three deaths were recorded, with one patient in critical condition and others mild. The ship reportedly carried no Chinese citizens. Cape Verde’s health ministry is coordinating with WHO and affected countries to respond. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde advised Chinese nationals to monitor official updates, maintain hygiene, and avoid contact with rodents; emergency number 130 was provided. Oceanwide Expeditions later disclosed that among the three deaths, two Dutch nationals had disembarked, while one German death remained on board, with a body still onboard.

triage.headline_ja: 09:12:46更新｜中國駐佛得角使館：涉疫郵輪上無中國公民 請加強衛生防範
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度（死亡3件）」が確認され、海上での急速な感染拡大が示されている。複数国籍者の関与と死亡事例があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはドイツ・オランダ・カーボベルデが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題となる実際の感染症イベント（郵輪上での発症事例）はカーボベルデ沖で発生。中国は外交的関心（中国公民の有無確認、大使館声明）のレベルでの言及のみだが、対象国内での直接的な感染事象は記述されていない。ただし、船舶での多国籍者の接触と死亡事例、WHO関与、渡航制限リスクの観点から、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、シグナル基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Giun ký sinh ở chuột tấn công não người phụ nữ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Parasitic Worm in Mice Attacks a Woman's Brain.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a 30-year-old woman, Hoa, developed eosinophilic meningitis due to Angiostrongylus cantonensis (rat lungworm). She presented with severe headache, tinnitus, photophobia, and later dizziness and imbalance. MRI 3 Tesla showed multifocal nodular lesions in cortex, subcortical areas, brainstem, and cerebellum. CSF had leukocytosis (973/µL) with eosinophilia, elevated protein, and low glucose. CSF PCR confirmed Angiostrongylus cantonensis infection. The parasite’s rat hosts release larvae that migrate to the CNS; snails are intermediate hosts. Transmission likely via contact with rats or consumption of undercooked snails or vegetables contaminated with snail material. Treatment included 7–10 days of anti-inflammatory therapy and 2–3 weeks of antiparasitic drugs, with liver function monitoring. After ~2 weeks, symptoms improved; discharge with outpatient follow-up. Mortality for eosinophilic meningitis is about 2–3%, but long-term neuro sequelae such as memory and balance impairment can occur. Prevention emphasizes cooking food, washing produce, and good pet hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミの寄生虫が女性の脳を攻撃 - ラット肺虫による好酸球性髄膜炎
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるAngiostrongylus cantonensisによる散発的神経感染症の報告。重症度は高いが現在は単一症例の報告であり、国際的拡大リスクは不明。流行のリスク要因（宿主・伝播経路）は存在するが、情報不足のため継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告ですがAngiostrongylus cantonensisは重大な神経感染症を引き起こし、致死率2-3%、長期神経後遺症リスクがある。ホーチミン市内のネズミおよび中間宿主カタツムリを介した伝播経路が確認されており、地域的な流行の可能性があります。複数症例の発生状況や公衆衛生当局の対応状況に関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: 男友婚前查出乙肝，女子父母担心传染让两人分手
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boyfriend diagnosed with hepatitis B before marriage; the woman's parents worry about transmission and cause them to break up.
article.articleSummary: In Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, a 26-year-old woman, Xiao Wu, discovers her boyfriend has chronic hepatitis B during a pre-marital check. He tests positive for hepatitis B surface antigen. Fearing transmission and facing family pressure, the couple nearly breaks up. A physician explains that routine daily contact (sharing meals, handshakes, hugs, or using the same toilet) does not spread HBV. Regarding sexual transmission, even with unprotected sex, about 5% of exposed adults progress to chronic infection, while 95% clear the virus with a healthy immune response, effectively a natural vaccination. Xiao Wu is found to have hepatitis B antibodies, indicating she already has immunity and is not at risk of infection. The boyfriend begins antiviral therapy, achieving an undetectable viral load within three months. After counseling, Xiao Wu’s parents accept the relationship; they are engaged and planning a wedding by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: 男友婚前查出乙肝，女子父母担心传染让两人分手（婚前検査で彼氏がB型肝炎と判明、女性の両親が感染を懸念して別れさせようとする）
triage.triage_reason: B型肝炎の個人的な事例報道であり、公衆衛生上の突発的集団発生ではない。情報提供的な医学記事であり、新規のアウトブレイク、異常な疾病増加、国際的拡大のリスクなし。
triage.notes: 本記事は杭州での個人的なB型肝炎診断ケースと医学教育的内容であり、感染症イベント検知の対象ではない。患者の地理的位置は中国（浙江省杭州）だが、公衆衛生上の突発事象ではなく個人的な医療ニュース。IHRスクリーニング基準に該当しないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 'This time we don't have strength to rebuild': Bird flu hits western India's biggest egg-supply hub, again
article.articleSummary: Navapur in Maharashtra's Nandurbar district, an egg hub feeding Mumbai, Surat, Jalgaon, endures a third Avian Influenza outbreak. The outbreak began April 12 with sudden poultry deaths; by April 26 samples from Diamond and Tasleem farms tested positive, and Navapur was declared infected on April 30 with a 1 km infected radius and 10 km surveillance radius; poultry movement was banned for 90 days. By May 5, over 2 lakh birds had been culled; about 8 lakh eggs destroyed and more than 210 tonnes of feed discarded. Affected farms include Diamond Poultry Farm, Tasleem Poultry Farm (Taslearia’s 62,300 birds culled; 6 lakh eggs destroyed; 72 tonnes feed wasted) and Wasim B Poultry Farm (30,000 birds and 60,000 eggs wiped out). Compensation remains low (Rs 140 per bird in 2024; costs up to Rs 500 per bird); farmers advocate vaccination against H5N1, which India does not permit for highly pathogenic strains.

triage.headline_ja: 「今回は再建する力がない」：鳥インフルエンザが西インドの最大卵供給ハブを再び襲う
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの継続的な感染拡大（3度目の発生）、大規模な家禽の殺処分と経済的損失、人獣共通感染症の公衆衛生リスク、および社会的・政治的関心が高い。IHR基準3項目該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: マハーラシュトラ州ナワプール地区は家禽供給の重要なハブであり、3度目のH5N1発生。大規模な経済的損失（200万羽以上の殺処分、800万個の卵破棄）と農業への深刻な影響。インドは高病原性H5N1の予防接種を許可していないため、管理困難性が高い。ムンバイなど複数都市への卵供給影響による社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ketahui penularan utama virus hanta dari tikus ke manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out the main transmission of hantavirus from rats to humans
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) transmission is via inhalation of aerosolized dried rat urine, feces, or saliva from infected rats. Andes virus (ANDV) can, in limited cases, spread between humans in close contact. In Jakarta, Indonesia, expert Dicky Budiman notes the disease is zoonotic; initial symptoms include fever, body aches, and weakness, followed by vascular leakage that causes pulmonary edema and acute respiratory failure. Case fatality can reach about 40% due to hypoxemia; progression to severe lung involvement can occur within days, underscoring the need for early recognition and supportive care. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management relies on oxygen delivery, ventilatory support, and careful fluid management. Global pandemic potential is small because transmission is not primarily human-to-human. Prevention emphasizes hygiene and reducing exposure in high-risk settings such as ships or poorly ventilated enclosed spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミから人間へのハンタウイルスの主な感染経路を知る
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジャカルタでのハンタウイルス感染症の情報提供記事。確認された症例の報告ではなく、疾患の特性と症状についての教育的記事であり、具体的な流行状況や複数症例の発生の明確な報告がないため、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患特性の教育的説明であり、ジャカルタでの実際の症例発生状況の詳細が示されていない。ハンタウイルスの高い致命率（約40%）と急速な進行が懸念材料だが、人間-人間感染が限定的であることから大流行リスクは低いとされている。今後の情報更新、特に確認症例数の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 节俭吃出大病！长期食用冰箱存货，病菌可能“上脑”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frugal eating could lead to a serious illness! Prolonged consumption of fridge stock may cause bacteria to invade the brain.
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China: a 79-year-old man developed pyogenic meningitis caused by Listeria monocytogenes (Pasteur strain) after prolonged consumption of expired items stored in the refrigerator. He presented with sudden weakness, fever near 39°C, neck stiffness, and inability to speak, followed by confusion, diarrhea, and urinary incontinence. Admission labs showed elevated infection markers and MRI revealed bilateral frontal subdural effusions. He was diagnosed with acute bacterial meningitis and gradually recovered with treatment. Investigations point to ingestion of long-stored fridge stock as the infection source; Listeria can survive and multiply at 0–4°C and reach the brain via the bloodstream after gut infection. The report emphasizes that refrigeration is not sterilization and warns against consuming foods kept long-term (frozen meat, seafood, dairy), offering fridge-use tips to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 節約が大病に！冷蔵庫の古い食材を長期間食べると、病菌が「脳に侵入」する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発患者報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。教育的な公衆衛生啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 単発の臨床ケースレポートであり、集団発生（outbreak）の証拠なし。記事は冷蔵庫食材の安全管理に関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発であり、感染症シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam permanece libre de infección humana por virus Hanta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam remains free of human hantavirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports no human hantavirus infections to date amid concerns about cases linked to an international cruise. The Ministry of Health’s Preventive Medicine Department, with WHO, is monitoring and guiding prevention efforts; the public is urged to adopt preventive measures and not panic. No Vietnam cases confirmed. Guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with rodents or droppings, ventilating and dampening areas before cleaning, wearing gloves and masks, washing hands after exposures, sealing rodent entries, proper food storage, and daily waste management. Symptomatic individuals with relevant exposure should seek care. By May 4, 2026, seven cruise-linked cases were identified: two confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected; three deaths, one critical, three mild. Hantavirus can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome or hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; treatment is supportive. Transmission is rodent-borne; incubation typically 2–8 weeks; early symptoms include fever, chills, headache, muscle pains; progression to respiratory distress is possible.

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus no Brasil: país registrou 189 mortes nos últimos 10 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus in Brazil: the country recorded 189 deaths in the last 10 years.
article.articleSummary: Three hantavirus deaths were confirmed on a cruise ship traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde, with three more passengers under suspicion; the vessel remains isolated near its destination, which prohibits disembarkation. In Brazil, hantavirus cases and deaths have declined over 2016–2025. The Northeast region records the fewest cases and deaths but the highest fatality rate (3 cases, 2 deaths; 66.6% CFR). The South bears the largest burden with 238 cases and 77 deaths (CFR 32.3%). Hantavirus is transmitted via urine, feces, and excreta of wild rodents, primarily affecting rural workers. Infected individuals can develop hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, with fever, shortness of breath, and tachypnea; severe cases may progress to respiratory or cardiac failure. There is no specific antiviral treatment, contributing to the disease’s mortality.”}{

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman developed meningitis caused by a worm from mice, almost misdiagnosed as a stroke.
article.articleSummary: Angiostrongylus cantonensis–induced eosinophilic meningitis in a 30-year-old woman in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. She presented with two weeks of headache, tinnitus, photophobia, and imbalance; MRI showed widespread cortical and subcortical nodules with brainstem and cerebellar involvement, not typical for acute stroke. Lumbar puncture revealed marked eosinophilic meningitis (973 cells/µL) with elevated protein and low glucose; CSF PCR confirmed Angiostrongylus cantonensis. The rat lungworm infects humans via ingestion of undercooked snails/slugs or produce contaminated with snail larvae; the patient reported raw vegetables and keeping hamsters at home. Treatment included 7–10 days of anti-inflammatory therapy to reduce cerebral edema and about 2–3 weeks of antiparasitic medication, with periodic liver monitoring. After ~2 weeks, headaches and dizziness improved; outpatient follow-up to assess potential long-term neurologic sequelae such as memory impairment and balance disorders. Prevention stresses cooking foods thoroughly, washing greens, and avoiding uncooked snails or contaminated produce.

article.articleHeadline: 戴手套！"超72小时未治疗死亡率近100%"，又有人中招_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wear gloves! "Untreated for more than 72 hours, the mortality rate is nearly 100%," another person has fallen victim.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus wound infection case in Shanghai, China: a 70-something woman (alias Li A) sustained a left middle finger puncture while handling seafood on March 16; within 24 hours she developed swelling and fever, with white blood cell count 16.03×10^9/L. Diagnosed as traumatic Vibrio vulnificus infection; multidisciplinary team started cefoperazone-sulbactam plus levofloxacin. Because she had a prosthetic heart valve with pacemaker and was on anticoagulation, plus diabetes and diabetic ketoacidosis, the infection posed high risk of septic shock or heart failure. Left-hand debridement and drainage on March 19; due to extensive infection, a second debridement on March 26 with a negative-pressure wound therapy device. Tissue sent for metagenomic next-generation sequencing, confirming Vibrio vulnificus with high read counts. Antimicrobials adjusted accordingly; anticoagulation managed; insulin infusion for hyperglycemia and ketosis. After two weeks, fever resolved, swelling subsided, and she was discharged. Emphasizes rapid progression and >72 hours mortality near 100% without treatment.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven people reported ill, three have died! WHO: The outbreak-related cruise ship may have already shown human-to-human transmission; the first confirmed couple boarded in Argentina. China confirms: There are no Chinese citizens on board.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship Hondius off Praia, Cape Verde. Seven of nearly 150 passengers and crew have fallen ill, with three deaths; one patient is in intensive care in South Africa. The first confirmed cases were a couple who boarded the ship in Argentina. Three patients are to be evacuated by air ambulance to the Netherlands; one aircraft has already arrived in Cape Verde, with transfer to be completed when safe. China’s embassy in Cape Verde confirmed no Chinese citizens are on board and urged Chinese nationals to strengthen hygiene. Spain’s health ministry said the Canary Islands will receive the ship, as Cape Verde lacks capacity for this disposal; Oceanwide Expeditions is coordinating. WHO notes hantavirus is rodent-borne and typically transmitted via excreta, but intimate close-contact exposure (e.g., spouses, cabin-mates) may allow limited human-to-human transmission. The ship had stopped at several African-island locations with rodent populations, suggesting possible sources. The situation is being coordinated with affected authorities to move toward the Canary Islands.

triage.headline_ja: 7人が患者報告、3人死亡！WHO：アウトブレイク関連の客船では人間同士の伝播の可能性があり、最初の確定患者の夫婦はアルゼンチンで乗船。中国は確認：船上に中国国民はいない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：3人死亡、異常/予想外：客船上での流行、国際的拡大リスク：複数国への影響と患者避難、渡航制限リスク：船舶運営制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い（WHO声明、中国大使館確認など）。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーを精査した結果、実際の感染症イベント発生国はカーボベルデ（Cabo Verde）、南アフリカ、アルゼンチン、スペイン（カナリア諸島）、オランダが含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはChinaのみ（中国大使館の確認声明が記載されているため）。Bluedot APIが付与した他の地域（Canary Islands, South Africa, Netherlands, Cabo Verde, Argentine, Spain）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。本イベントは国際的な対応が必要な重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Pencegahan terbaik virus hanta dengan pengendalian tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Best Prevention of Hantavirus Through Rodent Control
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-06, in Jakarta, Indonesia, Griffith University epidemiologist Dicky Budiman says primary hantavirus prevention hinges on rodent control in residential environments, especially during the rainy season and floods. Core measures include sealing rodent access to homes and warehouses, storing food in closed containers, and cleaning damp surroundings. While rodent droppings pose hantavirus risk (which targets the lungs and can cause rapid death), urine can carry leptospirosis, which attacks the kidneys and liver. During floods, risk increases; use boots, avoid contact with dirty water, and protect wounds. Cleanup teams and warehouse workers should wear masks and wash hands regularly. When sweeping dusty areas, disinfect first and wear a mask to prevent inhalation of aerosols. Early detection remains crucial, with rodent control, environmental hygiene, and personal hygiene emphasized during the rainy season.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever not relieved by over-the-counter meds! Man diagnosed with meningitis hospitalized; experts warn that droplets and kissing may transmit.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed cases of meningococcal meningitis in Taiwan: a one-month-old infant and a man in his 30s in Taichung City. The adult, who traveled to Thailand and Malaysia from late February to early March, developed fever in late April. He self-medicated before hospital admission on May 1 and is now hospitalized. One close contact, a foreign national, has left Taiwan and is being monitored through May 9. Global meningococcal meningitis outbreaks persist in Africa's Sahel, as well as Vietnam, Japan, North America, Europe, and Oceania. Transmission occurs via throat and nasal secretions and droplets through close contact or prolonged proximity; risk higher for those with lower immunity. Common symptoms include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, and rash; severe cases may cause coma, delirium, pneumonia, sepsis, or meningitis. Public health measures: seek prompt care, report travel/contact history, practice hand hygiene, avoid crowded places, cough etiquette; masks as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱が市販薬で改善せず！男性が髄膜炎と診断され入院　専門家：飛沫感染やキスで感染の可能性

article.articleHeadline: Pencegahan virus hanta dengan pengendalian tikus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus prevention through rodent control.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta-based epidemiologist Dicky Budiman says hantavirus prevention hinges on rodent control in homes and warehouses, especially during the rainy and flood seasons. Core measures include sealing rodent access, storing food in sealed containers, and keeping damp areas clean. During rain and floods, the risk from rodent droppings rises, with hantavirus transmission limited but possible; leptospirosis from rat urine on surfaces also poses a threat. Hantavirus attacks the lungs and can cause rapid death, while leptospirosis affects the kidneys and liver. Protective actions include wearing boots during floods, avoiding contact with dirty water, and ensuring cleaners in closed spaces wear masks and wash hands regularly. When sweeping dusty areas, use disinfectants first and wear a mask to prevent inhaling aerosols. Transmission during floods remains rare, but vigilance and early detection—via rodent control, environmental hygiene, and personal hygiene—are crucial in Indonesia's rainy seasons.

triage.notes: 記事は予防対策に関する専門家コメントに焦点を当てており、具体的な患者報告や集団感染事例の記載がありません。洪水季節におけるハンタウイルスおよびレプトスピラ症の潜在的リスク増加は示唆されていますが、現在のアウトブレイク状況の詳細は不明です。続報によって実際の患者発生が確認されることに注視が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Anambas MBG Food Poisoning: Lab Finds Borax, E. coli
article.articleSummary: Mass poisoning linked to Indonesia's Free Nutritious Food (MBG) program in the Anambas Islands Regency, Air Asuk area, with at least 155 people affected. An Extraordinary Event (KLB) was declared on April 15, 2026. Lab results from the Natuna District Health Office found borax in remaining MBG meals (contamination levels 100–5,000 mg), and BPOM confirmed the presence of Escherichia coli. The National Food and Nutrition Agency (BGN) will tighten oversight; the Integrated Health Post for Nutritious Food (SPPG) MBG kitchen must renew its Hygiene and Sanitation Suitability Certification (SLHS) and meet all standards before resuming operations. Investigations by the Department of Food Security, Agriculture, and Animal Health and the Provincial Health Office are ongoing, with sanitary rapid tests conducted and meal samples sent to Batam BPOM for confirmation. The exact source of contamination in water or food remains unidentified, with further investigation planned to prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: アナンバス地域の栄養食給付事業における集団食中毒：ホウ素と大腸菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの公式給食プログラムに関連した155人以上の集団食中毒事件。ホウ素汚染と病原菌（大腸菌）の確認、公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、および管理上の課題により、複数の評価基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアナンバス諸島地域（Kabupaten Natuna）のインドネシア政府栄養給食事業（MBG）における集団食中毒を扱っている。Bluedotが検出したBatam、Provinsi Riau、Provinsi Kepulauan Riauはいずれも関連する検査・調査地点だが、実発生地域はアナンバス島地域（Natuna地区）内のAir Asuk地域。対象国リストでの検証により、インドネシア（1643084）のみが該当。2つ以上のIHR基準と複数のWPRO基準の該当、および高い社会的・政治的関心によりPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Fear mounts as Hantavirus spreads, cruise-ship infections, WHO warning about fatalities, how much of a concern is this for India?
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus concerns rise after suspected infections aboard a cruise ship off the Atlantic coast near Cape Verde, with three passengers dying. The World Health Organization warns that, though rare, human-to-human transmission is possible in some settings, but overall risk remains low and authorities say the situation is under control. Hantavirus can spread via inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent droppings, urine, or remains, highlighting rodents as the transmission source. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains and cramps, potentially progressing to more severe illness. The report notes suspected hantavirus infections on the vessel and ongoing monitoring, with no details on laboratory confirmation provided. The article raises questions about implications for India while stressing vigilance and prudent public health responses during this developing situation as of May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：恐怖が高まるハンタウイルス、クルーズ船での感染、死亡についてのWHO警告、インドにとってどの程度の懸念か？
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスのクルーズ船での集団感染疑い（3名死亡）は異常かつ予想外のイベントだが、WHOは総リスクが低く状況は管理下にあると述べており、確定診断が不明。インドへの直接的な拡大リスクが明確でないため、追加情報を要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはクルーズ船がケープベルデ沖大西洋で発生しているが、Bluedot APIが付与した'Republic of Cabo Verde'は地理的発生地であり、実際にイベントが発生している国ではない。インドは記事の主題で名前が言及されているが、インド国内での確認事例は述べられておらず、理論的関心となっている。ハンタウイルスのクルーズ船での集団感染は異常だが、WHOは総リスク低と評価し、確定診断が示されていない。追加の疫学情報と確定診断の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 做这事记得戴手套！又有人中招了！情况严重可夺命！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remember to wear gloves when doing this! Another person has fallen victim to it! The situation is serious and potentially life-threatening!
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus wound infection from seafood exposure caused two severe cases highlighted in Shanghai. A 70-year-old woman with heart valve replacement, pacemaker, chronic anticoagulation, and diabetes developed rapid left-hand swelling and severe pain after a puncture while handling seafood. She spiked to 39.7°C; leukocytosis and elevated inflammatory markers supported a diagnosis of traumatic Vibrio vulnificus infection at Shanghai Sixth People’s Hospital. She underwent urgent wound debridement and drainage with multidisciplinary care and broad-spectrum antibiotics; after two weeks, fever resolved, edema subsided, inflammatory and glucose markers stabilized, and she was discharged. In a separate case, an elderly man sustained a small puncture from a blue crab on the left hand, developed swelling with purulence and rising creatinine, progressed to necrotizing fasciitis and septic shock, required emergency amputation, ventilation, and dialysis, but died within 9 days. These cases underscore the high fatality risk of wound Vibrio vulnificus infections after seafood exposure.

triage.headline_ja: この作業をするときは手袋を忘れずに！また被害者が出た！状況は深刻で命を奪う可能性がある！
triage.triage_reason: Vibrio vulnificus感染は重症度が高く（死亡例含む）、予想外の海産物露出による創傷感染という異常な発症パターンを示しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・異常性基準に該当する。また社会的関心が高い公衆衛生警告である。
triage.notes: Vibrio vulnificus感染は海産物取扱者に対するリスク警告として公開されている。2症例報告（1名死亡、1名退院）であり、創傷感染経由の急速進行性疾患である。海産物露出後の創傷感染として患者管理上の重要性が高い。ただし国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限リスクは低いと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: งานวิจัยบ่งชี้สาเหตุ 'คนไม่รู้จักไข้ดิน' ทั้งที่เป็นโรคอันตราย | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research points to the cause of people's lack of awareness about melioidosis, even though it is a dangerous disease
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or 'soil fever,' is an endemic yet poorly known disease in Thailand for nearly seven decades. A 2024 ethnographic study at Thammasat University by a sociology/anthropology researcher examined why awareness remains limited. The research, the first Thai anthropology study on melioidosis, identifies two major obstacles: medical complexity and social/policy complexity. Clinically, the pathogen is an 'evasive' organism that mimics tuberculosis or pneumonia and can destroy lymphatic, blood, bone, brain, and spinal structures; diagnosis relies on culture and may take days, contributing to deaths. Despite a mortality rate around 40% even with hospital care, many patients die within 2-3 days of admission. Treatment spans two phases: an initial 10-14 day intensive IV antibiotic course, followed by 12-20 weeks (3-5 months) of oral therapy to clear infection. Public awareness is hampered by attitudes and government policies; cases from Vietnam War veterans illustrate long latency and diagnostic surprises. Published May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 研究が指摘する『ブルセラ病の認知度の低さ』の原因 - それは危険な疾患であるにもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスはタイの風土病だが、認知度向上を扱った研究論文の発表が主題であり、新たな流行や異常な発生増加を示すイベントではない。スクリーニング基準では該当するが情報の性質上、継続的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の新規発生や流行の報告ではなく、タイの大学による疫学研究（認知度低下の原因分析）の発表である。メリオイドーシスの重症度（致死率40%）と長期曝露リスクは確認されるが、イベント性（新規検出、異常な増加など）に乏しい。公開情報は学術研究の発表に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Cuántos muertos y contagiados deja brote de hantavirus en crucero por el Atlántico? | Noticias RCN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How many dead and infected does a hantavirus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship leave?
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, three deaths and multiple hantavirus infections are linked to a cruise off Cape Verde. MV Hondius, carrying about 147–149 people from 23 nationalities, is at anchor amid a possible outbreak. The World Health Organization reported 147 aboard; operator Oceanwide Expeditions cited 149 on board. Of the passengers, 88 came from 15 countries (including UK, US, Spain, Netherlands; one Argentine); 61 crew from 12 countries (Philippines, Ukraine, Netherlands, UK; one Guatemala). The fatalities include a Dutch couple who traveled in South America before Ushuaia, Argentina, aboard 1 April: husband ill 6 April, died 11 April; body removed 24 April on Saint Helena; wife fell ill, disembarked, died 26 April; hantavirus confirmed 4 May. A German passenger developed fever 28 April and died 2 May; body remains on ship. Incubation 1–6 weeks; Andes virus suspected; results awaited. No vaccines or specific treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 大西洋クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生による死者・感染者数は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。多国籍乗客・乗員を乗せたクルーズ船での死亡事例3件を含む確認済み集団発生。国際的な懸念と支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの詳細分析：Bluedot APIが付与した多くの国は乗客・乗員の国籍地として言及されているが、実際のハンタウイルス発生地は大西洋クルーズ船（Cape Verde沖）である。対象国リストから検証可能な国籍は Philippines（乗員）のみ。発生地がアルゼンチン（ウシュアイア）経由の可能性があるが、発生の主舞台はクルーズ船であり、Andesウイルスの疑いで結果待ちの段階。死亡3件、多数感染、多国籍集団での国際的リスク高、特定治療法なし。

article.articleHeadline: PH ready to test Filipino crew from MV Hondius if repatriated amid hantavirus monitoring
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-06, the Philippines' Department of Health said it is prepared to conduct hantavirus testing for 38 Filipino crew aboard expedition vessel MV Hondius if they are repatriated. The crew remain asymptomatic and in strict quarantine aboard the ship; DOH spokesperson Albert Domingo noted local laboratories can perform hantavirus testing, including PCR. WHO's International Health Regulations system continues to monitor the situation, with about 80 individuals traced as potentially exposed after a passenger linked to the vessel traveled by plane; passengers originally could not disembark in Cabo Verde. The ship operator is weighing docking options, with Spain among potential destinations. Hantavirus is linked to rodent urine and droppings; symptoms include fever, body pain, headaches, and respiratory symptoms, though not specific. The Philippines has not recorded a confirmed hantavirus case this year.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、MV Hondius号の乗員の帰国時のハンタウイルス検査実施を準備
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な海上乗員の曝露イベントで、複数国にまたがる潜在的な暴露者（約80人）が確認されており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク、異常性、重大性を満たす。初期スクリーニングレベルではピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはSpain（2510769）とCabo Verde（3374766）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではフィリピン政府の対応と乗員検査対応が主題であり、実際の症例発生地はフィリピンのみ。スペイン・カボベルデは船舶の寄港地・潜在的曝露地点であり、公衆衛生上の懸念は存在するが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。乗員は現在全員無症状だが、国際移動を伴う曝露イベントとして国際的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫苗認賠10億收場  新藥證攻台灣十倍大市場  腸病毒疫苗打進越南搶市  高端力拚轉盈- 今周刊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 vaccine settlement ends with a 1 billion yuan payout; New drug approvals target Taiwan's tenfold larger market; Enterovirus vaccines enter Vietnam to seize market share; Medigen Vaccine Biologics strives to turn a profit — CommonWealth Magazine
article.articleSummary: Medigen Vaccine Biologics (Taiwan) reports its EV71 enterovirus vaccine now commands about 90% of Taiwan’s domestic market, marking a turning point after years of development. Enteroviruses include poliovirus, enterovirus type 71, and Coxsackie viruses, though there is currently no vaccine for Coxsackie viruses. In March, Vietnam granted its first self-paying enterovirus vaccine license, positioning Medigen as the sole provider for self-pay vaccination in Vietnam, a country with a population exceeding 100 million. Founded in 2012, Medigen aims to return to its original mission of preventing epidemic infectious diseases and to achieve profitability through its enterovirus vaccine portfolio and expansion into Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスワクチン和解により10億元で決着、新薬承認台湾の10倍の市場を狙う、腸病毒ワクチンがベトナムに進出し市場を掌握、高端バイオテクノロジーが黒字化を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は腸病毒（EV71）ワクチンの商業的成功と市場拡大に関する企業ニュースであり、感染症の発生・流行を報告するイベント情報ではない。現在の感染症危機を示す証拠がなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は高端バイオテクノロジー社のEV71ワクチンの商業展開と市場シェアに関する企業ニュースである。腸病毒の感染流行やアウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、ワクチン製品の販売成績と業績改善を扱う経済記事である。記事内にEV71やポリオウイルスの現在の疾病負荷、発生事例、死亡、重症化の報告は含まれていない。したがって感染症シグナルとしてのピックアップ価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kendalikan tikus jadi kunci cegah Virus Hanta - ANTARA News Jawa Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Controlling rats is the key to preventing Hantavirus
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — An epidemiologist from Griffith University, Dicky Budiman, stresses that preventing hantavirus spillover from rat feces hinges on rigorous rodent control at homes and warehouses, especially during the rainy season and floods. Key measures include sealing rat access, storing food in closed containers, and keeping damp environments clean. During rains, exposure to contaminated dust and surface urine increases, raising the risk of hantavirus infection; leptospirosis from rat urine is also a concern. Hantavirus chiefly attacks the lungs and can cause rapid death, while leptospirosis targets the kidneys and liver. Protective actions include wearing boots during floods, avoiding contact with dirty water, and workers cleaning warehouses using masks and routine hand hygiene; disinfectant use before cleaning dusty areas in closed rooms. Early detection and persistent environmental hygiene remain essential during monsoon and flood periods.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスを防ぐためのカギはネズミを制御すること
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）でハンタウイルスとレプトスピラ症の発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で複数該当するが、具体的な患者数や死亡例などの重症度情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な公衆衛生対策について専門家からのアドバイスの形式で報告されており、具体的な患者数、死亡例、発病数などの疫学データがない。ハンタウイルスは高い致死率を持つ可能性があり（記事では『急速に死亡を引き起こす可能性がある』と述べられている）、レプトスピラ症とともに雨季・洪水期の懸念として挙げられている。さらに詳細な疫学情報の報告を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: मई-जून में चूके तो बरसात में पशुओं पर टूटेगा बीमारी का कहर, अभी लगवाएं ये टीका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you miss it in May–June, disease havoc will strike animals in the rainy season—get this vaccine now.
article.articleSummary: May–June vaccination before the rains is crucial in Deoghar, India, to protect dairy cattle and goats from Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS), Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR), and Enterotoxemia (ET). As the monsoon approaches, moisture and dirt raise infection risk, threatening milk production and animal survival. Dr. Poonam Soren of the Deoghar Agricultural Science Center notes that effective vaccines exist for major diseases. FMD spreads rapidly, causing mouth and hoof ulcers and fever; vaccination every six months is advised, especially before rains. HS is deadly, with high fever, breathing difficulty, and throat swelling; administer HS vaccine annually. Goats face PPR—fever, diarrhea, and nasal/ocular discharge—and ET, which can cause sudden death; both vaccines are typically given once yearly. Emphasize cleanliness and dry housing to safeguard livestock and milk yields.

triage.headline_ja: 5月～6月に予防接種を逃すと、雨季に動物たちに病気の被害が襲いかかる―このワクチンを今すぐ接種してください
triage.triage_reason: インドの限定的な地域（ジャルカンド州デオガル地区）での動物感染症に関する予防啓発記事。疾患の重症度は高いが、現在の発生報告ではなく予防ガイダンスであり、情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は現在の確定的な感染症発生ではなく、雨季前の予防接種キャンペーン・啓発記事である。疾患（FMD、PPR、HS、ET）の重症度と雨季での曝露リスク、家畜への影響が述べられているが、IHR基準を満たすレベルの公衆衛生的危機や国際的拡大リスクの記載がない。デオガル地区の農業科学センターによる推奨であり、政府レベルの対応と考えられる。続報で実際の発生確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Brain damage, pneumonia, and death': The serious risks of whooping cough in infants
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-06, pertussis, or whooping cough, is a highly contagious bacterial respiratory infection spread through coughing and sneezing. In Gold Coast, Queensland, general practitioner Dr. Maria Arzineth Concepcion-Sison warns it is especially dangerous for unvaccinated infants under six months, who can develop severe complications including pneumonia, apnea, seizures, brain damage, and death. Transmission occurs via close contact and respiratory droplets. No specific case counts or outbreak details are provided in the piece, but it serves as a local health advisory from a Queensland physician, underscoring the grave risk of pertussis in infancy.

triage.headline_ja: 「脳損傷、肺炎、死亡」：乳幼児における百日咳の深刻なリスク
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリア（対象国外）での百日咳に関する医学的警告であり、対象国での発生報告ではない。検証された発生地域がないため、現時点での情報不足状況下では経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Ghana を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーはオーストラリア（クイーンズランド州ゴールドコースト）での医学的警告に限定されており、ガーナでの実際の発生報告は記述されていない。対象国リストにはオーストラリアが含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事に具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク詳細がないため、現段階での IHR/WPRO 基準の判定に不確実性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Belum Ada Obatnya, Medis Pakai Ribavirin untuk Pertolongan Pertama - Tribun-medan.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no cure yet for hantavirus; medical professionals use ribavirin for initial treatment - Tribun-medan.com.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus infection in Indonesia shows no cure or vaccine. Early symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, and vomiting; severe cases may progress to acute respiratory distress with potential death, and can involve kidney dysfunction, bleeding, and renal failure. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; management is supportive, with intensive care for respiratory or kidney complications. Ribavirin may be used as initial treatment for those exposed to hantavirus, according to Honest Doc, as it inhibits viral replication, but it must be prescribed by a clinician and not used without medical supervision. The article emphasizes that treatment remains supportive and symptomatic, underscoring the absence of a definitive cure and the need for medical oversight in exposure management.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスにはまだ治療薬がない、医療従事者は初期治療としてリバビリンを使用 - Tribun-medan.com
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのハンタウイルス感染に関する医療情報記事。重症度と国際拡散リスクは潜在的にありますが、具体的な症例数、流行状況、地域的拡大の証拠が記事内に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 本記事は教育的・医療情報的性質が強く、進行中の流行や集団発生の報告ではない。具体的な患者数、死亡例、地理的拡大、社会的影響に関する具体的情報が欠落している。ハンタウイルスの重症度は高いが、記事内に現在の発生状況を示す証拠がないため、より詳細な続報を待つ必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ไวรัสฮันตาคืออะไร? เช็กอาการที่ต้องระวังและวิธีป้องกัน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is hantavirus? Check the symptoms to watch for and how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus is a rodent-borne virus that can infect humans, causing either hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) or hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) depending on the virus type. Early, flu-like symptoms include fever, chills, myalgia, fatigue, headache, nausea, and vomiting; rare cases progress to severe disease. HFRS with kidney failure has been reported in Korea, China, and eastern Russia, while HPS can cause severe pneumonitis and pulmonary edema and has been associated with outbreaks in North America. Transmission to humans occurs mainly through contact with rodent urine, feces, or saliva, or inhalation of dust contaminated with excreta; human-to-human spread is not the primary risk. Prevention emphasizes rodent control, cleaning with disinfectants, wearing masks and gloves during cleanup, and good hygiene. In Thailand, no severe cases or deaths have been reported; hantavirus antibodies were found in 2.3–3.0% of mice in Bangkok and other provinces, indicating exposure but not necessarily illness.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとは何か？注意すべき症状と予防方法をチェック
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は重篤な疾患だが、記事は主に啓発・教育的内容であり、タイでの重症事例や死亡報告はない。ただし、複数の対象地域（タイ、韓国、中国）での検出報告があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にハンタウイルスの医学的情報と予防方法の啓発であり、アウトブレイク報告ではない。タイでは抗体保有マウスが検出されているが、人での重症事例や死亡報告はなく、現在のリスクは低い。韓国と中国での既知の流行は記事の背景情報として言及されている。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、現在の急性段階での新規事例報告ではないため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Virus Hanta Bisa Mematikan, Ini Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! Hantavirus Can Be Deadly; Here’s How It Is Transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) is highlighted in Indonesia as a potentially deadly zoonotic infection. As of 6 May 2026, epidemiologist Dicky Budiman of Griffith University notes transmission is mainly via inhalation of aerosols from dried rodent urine, feces, or saliva. Human-to-human spread is rare and limited to certain strains such as Andes virus. Early symptoms include fever, body aches, and fatigue and can rapidly progress to severe pulmonary involvement due to vascular leakage, causing fluid in the lungs and acute respiratory failure. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive (oxygen, ventilation, and strict fluid management). While global pandemic potential is low due to limited human transmission, vigilance is needed in high-risk settings like warehouses, ships, and enclosed spaces with poor ventilation, and avoidance of rodent droppings.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！ハンタウイルスは致死的となる可能性がある。ここがその感染経路である。
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのハンタウイルス肺症（HPS）に関する啓発記事。重症度基準に該当するが、具体的な患者数や発症例の報告がなく、主に感染経路の一般的な教育情報であるため、実質的なアウトブレイク兆候が不明確。
triage.notes: 記事は医学教育的な啓発内容で、実際のアウトブレイク報告や患者数の増加を明示していない。ハンタウイルスは高い致命率を持つが、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的（Andesウイルス一部除外）であり、グローバル・パンデミック可能性は低いと専門家も記述している。定期的な監視対象として位置付けるが、即時的なフルRRAは不要。

article.articleHeadline: Putus Rantai Penularan, 28.068 dari 84.369 Ekor Anjing di Denpasar Bali Telah Divaksin Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Break in the Transmission Chain: 28,068 of 84,369 Dogs in Denpasar, Bali Have Been Vaccinated Against Rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination in Denpasar, Bali, has reached 28,068 dogs (33.27% of a total dog population of 84,369) as of end-April 2026, with a 2026 target of 92.65% vaccination coverage. Two rabies-positive cases in 2026 were confirmed in dogs, both from stray animals. Denpasar’s animal health authorities are intensifying vaccination through door-to-door campaigns and increasing public education to promote responsible pet ownership and routine vaccination. Residents are urged to report animal bites and avoid contact with stray dogs, as rapid intervention is crucial to prevent rabies from becoming a broader public health threat. The situation highlights challenges posed by stray dogs in urban rabies control and the need to accelerate vaccination to achieve herd immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 感染チェーンの遮断：バリ州デンパサルの84,369頭の犬のうち28,068頭が狂犬病ワクチン接種済み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）での狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する記事。2026年に犬から2件の狂犬病陽性例が確認されたが、当局が積極的に対応中。シグナル基準1つ以上該当するが情報（死亡・入院患者数、ヒト感染など）が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 犬での狂犬病陽性例2件（野犬由来）が確認されているが、ヒト症例に関する記載がない。都市部における野犬による狂犬病リスク、ワクチン接種率がまだ33%程度に留まっていることから長期的な曝露リスク・流行しやすさに該当。ただし記事は主にワクチンキャンペーンの進捗報告であり、パブリックヘルス上の緊急性は現時点では明確ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 30人吃桶仔雞11人疑食物中毒...91歲阿嬤也狂拉　孫怒批店家 | ETtoday社會新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30 People Ate Bucket Chicken; 11 Suspected of Food Poisoning... 91-Year-Old Grandmother Also Had Diarrhea; Grandson Slams the Store | ETtoday Social News | ETtoday News Cloud
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung Dashu District bucket-chicken restaurant linked to suspected food poisoning after a May 3 Mother’s Day family meal for 30 relatives. By May 4, nine family members developed vomiting and diarrhea; by May 6, 11 people were affected, including a 91-year-old grandmother and a third-grade nephew. Diners reported a hot, crowded dining area, slow service, overly salty dishes, and bamboo shoots that looked like reheated leftovers; one family member claimed seeing cockroaches on the floor. Health authorities collected specimens for laboratory testing to identify the pathogen and guide enforcement, and ordered a two-day closure with full disinfection for risk control. The restaurant said it would handle matters through its insurer and awaits lab results, while criticizing the lack of immediate concern from the business.

triage.headline_ja: 30人がバケットチキンを食べ11人が食中毒の疑い...91歳の祖母も下痢、孫は店舗を批判
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飲食店での限定的な食中毒事例であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクがない。不明な感染症ではなく、食中毒管理当局による対応も適切に実施されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはKaohsiung（台湾）とJiangsu Sheng（中国）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは高雄市大樹区（台湾）の飲食店での食中毒事例に限定されている。台湾は評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。この事例は通常の食中毒事故であり、感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの監視対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemiolog Jelaskan Potensi Penularan Hantavirus di Indonesia, Perlukah Diwaspadai?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiologist Explains the Potential for Hantavirus Transmission in Indonesia; Should We Be Worried?
article.articleSummary: Six people on cruise MV Hondius traveling from Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde, Africa have been affected by hantavirus, with three fatalities and one patient in intensive care. The World Health Organization confirms one laboratory-confirmed case and five suspected; laboratory testing and epidemiologic analysis are ongoing as of May 6, 2026. Hantavirus is a rare zoonotic virus carried by rodents, transmitted mainly through inhalation of aerosolized rodent urine, feces, or saliva, particularly in closed environments. The main reservoir is rats or mice, which can contaminate ships' cabins, warehouses, cargo areas, and ventilation, raising transmission risk on cruise ships. Human-to-human transmission is not dominant, except in certain strains like Andes virus in South America. The article also notes the potential risk of introduction to Indonesia, which requires further assessment by public health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学者がインドネシアでのハンタウイルス感染の可能性を説明、警戒が必要か？
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船での複数ハンタウイルス感染例（死亡3例含む）という異常かつ予想外のイベント。国際的な渡航関連リスクを示唆し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン・ウシュアイアのクルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生ですが、インドネシア（対象国）への潜在的リスク・導入可能性の評価について述べられているため、インドネシアのみを verified_locations に含めます。アルゼンチン・ケープベルデは対象国リストに含まれないため除外しました。複数死亡と重症例の存在、国際的な渡航経路、公衆衛生当局による評価の必要性が強調されており、シグナル認識の閾値を満たしています。
