article.articleHeadline: ¿Cómo llegó la infección al barco? Argentina analiza el origen del brote de hantavirus cuya 'cepa andina' deja ya 32 muertos en un año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How did the infection reach the ship? Argentina analyzes the origin of the hantavirus outbreak whose 'Andean strain' has already claimed 32 lives in a year.
article.articleSummary: Seven hantavirus cases aboard the MV Hondius—two lab-confirmed and five suspected, including three deaths and one in critical condition—are under investigation in early May 2026. Spain’s Health Ministry says the ship will dock in the Canary Islands for screening and transfer home. The World Health Organization traces the outbreak to its origin, with the hypothesis that infection occurred off the ship after embarkation in Ushuaia, Argentina, on 1 April for a South Atlantic itinerary to South Georgia, the South Sandwich Islands, and Saint Helena. Incubation of 1–6 weeks supports off-ship exposure. Argentina and Tierra del Fuego authorities are coordinating, with testing in South Africa’s National Reference Laboratory to identify the strain. The Andes hantavirus variant is involved; nationally, Argentina reports 101 cases since June last year with 32 deaths (31.7% CFR). Regions at risk include Northwest, Northeast, Center, and South; Tierra del Fuego has no cases since 1996, Santa Cruz none in seven years.

triage.headline_ja: 感染は船にどのようにして到達したのか？アルゼンチンがハンタウイルス集団発生の起源を分析　『アンデス株』は既に1年間で32人の死亡者を出している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当（異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスク）。アルゼンチンで32人の死亡者を含む101症例、ハンタウイルスアンデス株による重篤な集団発生であり、国際航海中の船舶での感染確認は医学的・公衆衛生的に重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにCalabarzon（フィリピン）の地理的言及はなく、Bluedot APIが誤って付与した可能性がある。主な発生地域はアルゼンチン（ティエラ・デル・フエゴ州）であるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事から確認できる対象国はフィリピンのみ。ただしサマリー内に具体的なフィリピンでの感染報告は記載されていない。重症度（CFR 31.7%）、人-ヒト感染の確認（船舶内での複数症例）、国際的な動向（スペイン・南アフリカ・WHOの関与）から、フルRRAを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 曾赴泰國、馬來西亞旅遊  30歲男返台發燒竟罹流腦 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 30-year-old man who had traveled to Thailand and Malaysia returns to Taiwan with fever and contracts meningitis - Liberty Health Net.
article.articleSummary: Taichung, Taiwan reports 1 new confirmed meningococcal meningitis case, bringing this year’s total to 7, a near ten-year high. The patient, a man in his 30s with no chronic illness, had traveled to Thailand and Malaysia in late February to early March. Fever began April 26; he was hospitalized for chest tightness and dyspnea, diagnosed with sepsis, and laboratory confirmation on May 5–6 identified Neisseria meningitidis in blood culture. One close contact, a foreign national who has left Taiwan, is under monitoring through May 9. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, nausea, vomiting, irritability and rash; severe disease can progress to coma, pneumonia or septic shock. Transmission occurs via respiratory secretions and prolonged close contact. Vaccination is advised for high-risk travelers. Globally, outbreaks persist in Africa’s meningitis belt with sporadic cases in Vietnam, Japan, North America, Europe and Oceania.

triage.headline_ja: タイとマレーシアに旅行した30歳男性が台湾帰国後に発熱し髄膜炎に罹患
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。台湾での確認症例であり、複数国への旅行関連と海外での散発症例報告により国際的懸念がある。
triage.notes: 台湾での確認症例は輸入症例だが、現地で診断・報告された重要な事例。タイ・マレーシア訪問後の発症が確認され、アフリカ髄膜炎ベルトおよびアジア太平洋地域での散発症例との関連を示唆。マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため検証対象地から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 79歲伯「節儉」細菌侵腦　吃冰箱兩年存貨引化膿性腦膜炎 | ETtoday大陸新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 79-year-old man — 'frugal' bacteria invade the brain; eating two years’ worth of fridge stock leads to pyogenic meningitis.
article.articleSummary: As reported on 2026-05-06, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, a single case of pyogenic meningitis due to Listeria monocytogenes occurred in a 79-year-old man after years of stocking the fridge with overdue frozen meats and seafood and drinking expired dairy. He presented with sudden high fever, neck stiffness, limb rigidity, and confusion; MRI revealed bilateral frontal subdural effusions. Laboratory tests indicated severe infection. Doctors traced the source to ingestion of contaminated refrigerated food, allowing bacteria to enter the bloodstream and invade the central nervous system. Listeria monocytogenes is a fridge-associated pathogen able to grow at 0–4°C; other common fridge bacteria discussed include Staphylococcus aureus (heat-stable toxin) and Salmonella (raw meat/eggs). The patient survived after treatment. Preventive advice: clean fridge shelves quarterly, refrigerate produce for no more than a week, keep raw and cooked foods separate, and apply first‑in‑first‑out to avoid expired or moldy items.

triage.headline_ja: 79歳男性が「節約」で細菌が脳に侵入　冷蔵庫に2年保存した食材を食べて化膿性髄膜炎に
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の食中毒関連髄膜炎であり、公衆衛生的な深刻さ、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、または渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 本イベントは単一症例の個人的な食品保存習慣に起因する医療事例であり、流行病学的なアウトブレイク、クラスター、またはエピデミック性の兆候はない。記事は医学的教育目的で予防策を記載しているが、公衆衛生危機の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: IDAI Ungkap Gejala Awal DBD pada Anak yang Bisa Berujung Komplikasi Serius
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI Reveals Early Symptoms of Dengue Fever in Children That Could Lead to Serious Complications
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DF) remains a serious threat to Indonesian children. Early symptoms—sudden high fever, headache, muscle and joint pain, nausea or vomiting—can rapidly progress to severe bleeding and shock, with possible seizures or decreased consciousness. Early detection is crucial. Although about 75% of cases occur in ages 5–44, mortality is highest among 5–14-year-olds, accounting for roughly 41% of deaths, likely due to developing immunity and delayed recognition. Prevention must be comprehensive beyond vector control. Baseline environmental measures (3M Plus: drain, cover, recycle items that breed mosquitoes) should be supplemented with additional protections. Health workers should educate communities on prevention options, including vaccination. Following BPOM approval, dengue vaccination is now recommended for children aged 4–18 as an added protective measure against dengue disease.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI、子どもにおけるデング熱の初期症状を公表 - 深刻な合併症に至る可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の流行継続を示す報告だが、記事は予防啓発・ワクチン推奨の公衆衛生情報が主体であり、新規の流行拡大や急激な患者増加については記載されていない。情報不足のため要経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアでの常在感染症であり、本記事は既知の流行状況に関する医学情報・公衆衛生啓発である。IHR基準では深刻度が認められるが、異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限リスクはなく、スクリーニング基準でも複数該当するものの急激な事態悪化の兆候は記載されていない。BPOM承認済みワクチンの推奨推進という管理側の対応が進行中であることから、管理可能性は良好と推測される。継続的な動向観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: മൂന്നാം തവണയും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; രണ്ട് ലക്ഷം പക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കി, കണ്ണീരോടെ നവാപൂരിലെ കോഴി കർഷകർ | Bird flu hits western India's biggest egg-supply hub | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the third time, avian influenza; two hundred thousand birds killed, tearful poultry farmers in Navapur.
article.articleSummary: Navapur, Maharashtra reports its third avian influenza outbreak, with over 200,000 chickens culled and 800,000 eggs destroyed by May 5, plus more than 210 tonnes of litter discarded. First signs emerged April 12; mortality surged as farmers shifted from heat-related explanations to disease. NIHSAD in Bhopal confirmed positives from three farms, and on April 30 the district collector declared Navapur an infected area. A 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance radius were established; poultry and egg sales and transfers are banned for 90 days. An 18-member rapid response team and about 140 officials are deployed for culling and monitoring. Farmers face crores of rupees in losses; each chicken costs at least Rs 200. Vaccination is not permitted during severe outbreaks to protect surveillance. Navapur’s poultry numbers declined from about 18 lakh in 2021 to 12 lakh; compensation will be paid, with restrictions through July 31. Previous outbreaks occurred in 2006 and 2021.

triage.headline_ja: 3度目の鳥インフルエンザ；20万羽の鳥が殺処分、涙流すナヴァプール地域の養鶏農家
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」と「深刻な公衆衛生影響」の2項目該当。また複数のWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行性、管理可能性）に該当し、動物感染症ながら人への感染リスク（H5N1など）を有する鳥インフルエンザの確定事例であるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月6日配信（未来日時の可能性あり、入力データの確認推奨）。ナヴァプール（マハラシュトラ州）での3度目の大規模発生で、20万羽以上の感染鶏を確認・殺処分。NIHSAD（インド国立獣医学高等研究所）がH5N1陽性を確認。当該地域は感染区域に指定、3ヶ月間の家禽販売禁止令が発令されている。人への直接感染報告はサマリーに記載されていないが、H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確定事例として人獣共通感染症の本質的リスクを有する。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Virus Hanta, Bagaimana Pencegahan Terbaiknya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Outbreak: What Is the Best Way to Prevent It?
article.articleSummary: On the MV Hondius cruise ship of Oceanwide Expeditions, hantavirus infections are being investigated among passengers, per WHO. Timeline: May 2, 2026, a passenger died with severe respiratory distress; by May 4, seven related cases were reported, with two laboratory-confirmed and five suspected; three deaths, one patient in critical condition, the rest mild. Investigations are ongoing; WHO says the response includes deep investigations, isolation and care, medical evacuation, and laboratory testing. Preventive guidance from epidemiologist Dicky Budiman emphasizes rodent-control to prevent spillover from rat droppings, especially during floods. Practical measures: seal rodent access to buildings, store food in sealed containers, clean damp areas; footwear during floods; avoid contact with dirty water, particularly if wounds. For workers cleaning enclosed spaces: wear masks, wash hands, disinfect before cleaning, and use masks when dust is generated. hantavirus primarily damages lungs, causing rapid death; leptospirosis, from rat urine, can affect kidneys and liver.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス感染症の流行：最良の予防方法とは？
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船での多数の確定症例および死亡事例が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常・予想外」に該当。国際渡航による拡大リスクも存在し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルス感染症の発生は国際クルーズ船（MV Hondius）上で報告されており、インドネシア発着の船舶ですがWHOも対応に関与。確定症例2件、疑い例5件、死亡3件。呼吸窮迫症候群による急速進行性疾患で重症度が高い。ハンタウイルスおよびレプトスピラ症の同時報告があり、感染症複数種の複合イベントである可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 读懂手足口病信号，科学应对不慌张
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the signs of hand-foot-and-mouth disease and respond scientifically without panic.
article.articleSummary: Hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) is described by Jiangxi Center for Disease Control as a common pediatric infection with a spring–summer peak in April–July, especially in children under five. The incubation period is 2–10 days (avg 3–5). Early signs include vesicles or ulcers in the mouth (tongue, gums, palate) and on the hands, feet, and buttocks, with fever, cough, runny nose, reduced appetite, and diarrhea possible. In rare cases, the virus can affect the nervous system causing meningitis, encephalitis, or myelitis, and may lead to pulmonary edema/hemorrhage or circulatory failure; seek urgent care for persistent high fever, lethargy, or rapid breathing. Transmission occurs by direct contact with lesions or contaminated objects, the fecal-oral route, and respiratory droplets. No antiviral treatment exists; management is supportive. Prevention centers on thorough handwashing, food and drink hygiene, avoiding contaminated items, ventilation, regular disinfection, and limiting crowded settings during high season.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の信号を理解し、科学的に対応し、パニックに陥らない
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病は中国江西省で周知の季節性小児感染症であり、異常性・予想外性がない。記事は予防啓発・教育的内容であり、新規の感染症危機や異常なイベントを報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は江西省疾病予防管理センターによる手足口病に関する知識啓発・予防ガイダンスであり、新規の異常なアウトブレイク事象ではない。4月～7月の春夏シーズンに既知の季節性ピークがある一般的な小児感染症として位置付けられており、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Langkah Konkret Pemerintah Atasi TBC, Penguatan Deteksi hingga Perbaikan Rumah Pasien
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concrete steps by the government to tackle TB, from strengthening detection to improving patients' homes.
article.articleSummary: TB in Indonesia: As of May 3, 2026, the National TB program reports over 241,000 cases detected; 84% of the target for treatment initiation (target 95%); 80% treatment success (target 90%). Six measures are under way to accelerate progress. First, TB screening is integrated with Free Health Check (CKG); worker screening covers 16 ministries and will expand to 50. Second, detection at puskesmas will be strengthened with Near Point Of Care Testing (NPOCT) and chest X-ray tracing, starting in the second half of 2026. Third, community empowerment via TB Alert Villages (desa siaga TBC): 6,484 villages in 117 regencies/cities across 23 provinces have committed to prevention and self-management, with screening, tracing, treatment support, TB preventive therapy, and nutrition; target 30% of ~70,000 villages (currently ~6,000; ~9%). Fourth, TB tracing via CKG in 13 districts of West and Central Java reaching 5,500 contacts (April–May 2026), with nationwide expansion planned. Fifth, housing improvements: 2026 target 8,000 repaired TB patient homes in high-burden areas; 5,453 homes proposed via Sibaru. Sixth, cross-sector coordination across 38 provinces and 514 districts/cities.

triage.headline_ja: 政府による結核対策の具体的措置、検出強化から患者の家屋改善まで
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、インドネシア政府による対策強化は予期された官民協働の施策である。新規の公衆衛生上の危機的状況、異常な拡大傾向、国際的な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の既知の流行地であるインドネシアにおける政府の公式な対策・プログラムの進捗報告である。24万1千例以上の検出、84%の治療開始率達成など、検出・管理の強化が進行中である。シグナルとしてのピックアップ要件（IHR基準2つ以上または異常な拡大傾向）に該当しないため、見送りと判定する。

article.articleHeadline: FKH UNAIR Gelar Bimtek, Perkuat Penanganan Penyakit Pada Hewan Ternak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNAIR Faculty of Veterinary Medicine Holds Technical Training Workshop to Strengthen Disease Management in Livestock
article.articleSummary: Surabaya, Indonesia — The UNAIR Faculty of Veterinary Medicine hosted a two-day Technical Training Workshop (BimTek) in Bojonegoro Regency’s Office of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries meeting hall on May 4–5, 2026, to strengthen livestock disease management. Participants included paramedic veterinarians, veterinarians, and clinic staff, with a focus on field monitoring and farmer education. Three modules covered viral diseases (Foot-and-Mouth Disease, FMD, and Peste des Petits Ruminants, PPR), parasitic infections, and zoonoses. The FMD segment stressed rapid spread and productivity losses, noting that PPR is not yet reported in Indonesia but vigilance and early detection remain essential. The parasitology module addressed larval and helminth infections and the importance of routine control and understanding parasite life cycles. The zoonoses module advocated a One Health, cross-sector approach to prevent transmission to humans. The program aims to raise capacity for sustained livestock and public health protection.

triage.headline_ja: UNAIRの獣医学部が技術研修ワークショップを開催、畜産動物の疾病管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: 記事は家畜疾病管理の研修・トレーニングイベントであり、進行中の感染症の流行ではなく、教育的な能力構築プログラムを扱っている。インドネシアではFMDは既に存在するが、PPRはまだ報告されておらず、現在のアウトブレイクを示す具体的な患者数、死亡、まん延の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の感染症流行ではなく、2026年5月4-5日に開催された予防的な技術研修ワークショップの報告である。FMDとPPRは既知の家畜疾病であり、記事は能力構築と予防啓発を目的としている。シグナルとしてのピックアップは不適切。

article.articleHeadline: El virus del moquillo canino arrasa en Tailandia y causa la muerte de 72 tigres
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The canine distemper virus ravages Thailand and causes the death of 72 tigers.
article.articleSummary: Canine distemper virus (CDV), a morbillivirus related to measles, has killed 72 tigers in two tourist parks in northern Thailand over about ten days in February. Initial fears of avian influenza were dismissed; laboratory tests confirmed CDV infection. The outbreak appears confined to captive wildlife and highlights spillover from domestic dogs—often semi-feral or unsupervised—acting as virus reservoirs that bridge infection to vulnerable wild felids. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated materials; symptoms range from nasal/ocular discharge to digestive and neurological signs, though detection in tigers is difficult. Overstocked parks with high animal density, tourism contact, and possible inbreeding may accelerate spread. Origin is not confirmed; researchers point to dog-mediated spillover through shared environment or feeding. While not directly affecting humans, the event underscores broader zoonotic spillover risks, with global tiger populations estimated at 3,700–5,500 in the wild.

triage.headline_ja: タイでイヌジステンパーウイルスが猛威を振るい、72頭のトラの死亡を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: イヌジステンパーウイルスによる野生動物（トラ）への感染事例であり、麻疹関連のモルビリウイルスという点で公衆衛生的関心がある。ただし人間への直接的な影響は記述されておらず、IHR基準の該当性が限定的であるため、追加情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイヌジステンパーウイルス（CDV）によるトラの集団死亡であり、人間への感染は報告されていない。麻疹関連のモルビリウイルスであることと、ズーノーティック・スピルオーバーの懸念が指摘されている点が注視対象。ただし現在のところ人獣共通感染症の人間への直接的な脅威は記述されていない。観光地での発生であるため社会的関心が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄桶仔雞爆食物中毒！受害者增至11人  痛批店家冷血 | 社會 | Newtalk新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung Bucket Chicken Food Poisoning Outbreak! Victims rise to 11; shop slammed as cold-blooded | Society | Newtalk News
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung, Taiwan — A food poisoning outbreak linked to a Dashu District bucket chicken restaurant. Of 30 diners, 11 developed gastrointestinal illness (diarrhea and abdominal pain; 7 with diarrhea, 2 with vomiting; one dehydrated requiring IV). The Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reported initial suspected cases (3) on 2026-05-04, later expanding to 8 with symptoms; several sought medical care. Investigators collected six environmental samples (garlic-oyster dish, blanched shrimp, knives, cutting boards, pots/pans, kitchen cloths) and six human specimens for laboratory testing to identify the pathogen. The restaurant was ordered closed for two days and environmental disinfection performed, with reopening contingent on a follow-up inspection. Social media posts criticized cleanliness. No confirmed infection source or imported/exported cases at this time.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄桶仔雞爆食物中毒！受害者増至11人 痛批店家冷血
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の局所的な事例であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。原因病原体未確定で、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響の証拠が不足しており、確認された対象国内でも限定的。
triage.notes: 発生地域にTaiwan（Kaohsiung）とChina（Jiangsu）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはKaohsiungの単一レストランでの食中毒事例のみを扱っており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には台湾が含まれていない。Chinaは対象国だが、記事にはJiangsuでの実際の発生が記述されておらず、原因病原体も未確定である。局所的な食中毒であり、公衆衛生上の広範囲な影響や管理上の困難さは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Temukan Sapi Terjangkit LSD di Pasar Hewan Sidomoro Blitar, DKPP Minta Pedagang Bawa Pulang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cows Infected with Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) Found at Sidomoro Livestock Market in Blitar, DKPP Urges Traders to Take Them Home.
article.articleSummary: On May 6, 2026, in Blitar City, East Java, Indonesia, health inspectors at Dimoro Livestock Market found one cow infected with Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) during a routine check ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. The trader was instructed to take the infected animal home, and disinfection spraying was conducted around the site due to LSD’s viral nature. The inspection also identified 16 cows with helminth infections (parasitic worms), for which deworming treatment was given, and a cow with a chest wound was treated with disinfection applied. DKPP Kota Blitar urged traders not to bring ill animals to the market to minimize transmission risk. Officials confirmed that stock of sacrificial animals in Blitar remains safe and adequate for Eid al-Adha.

triage.headline_ja: ブリタル市シドモロ家畜市場でルンピー皮膚病(LSD)に感染した牛が発見、DKPP当局は商人に持ち帰るよう促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの牛のルンピー皮膚病発生の報告であり、動物衛生上の懸念があるが、現在のところ人への健康影響の証拠がなく、国際拡大リスクの具体的な情報も限定的である。引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ルンピー皮膚病は動物疾病であり人への直接的な健康脅威はないが、家畜市場での発生はZoonotic potentialと社会経済的影響を持つ。東ジャワの地方当局が適切に対応している(隔離、消毒)との報告あり。Eid al-Adhaの犠牲家畜供給時期での発生であり、流通を通じた拡大リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Takeda dan Halodoc Perkuat Upaya Bersama Cegah DBD di Momentum Pekan Imunisasi Dunia 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Takeda and Halodoc Strengthen Joint Efforts to Prevent Dengue Fever During World Immunization Week 2026
article.articleSummary: Takeda Innovative Medicines and Halodoc have strengthened joint dengue prevention efforts in Indonesia during World Immunization Week 2026. The partnership provides education for health workers and broad public outreach via Halodoc's digital platform, plus access to doctor consultations and vaccine information, including immunization options. Dengue fever (DBD, Demam Berdarah Dengue) remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, with Ministry of Health data showing dengue cases over the past five years rising nearly threefold; year-round transmission is no longer strictly seasonal, and peak cycles have shortened to about three years or less. The burden is substantial economically: BPJS Kesehatan reports more than one million dengue hospitalizations in 2024 and roughly Rp3 trillion in related costs. Vaccination uptake on Halodoc nearly doubled in Q1 2026 vs Q4 2025. BPOM recommends dengue vaccination for children aged 4–18, aligning with World Immunization Week and the goal of zero dengue deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: タケダとハロドックが2026年世界予防接種週間の機会にデング熱予防の共同努力を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の継続的な公衆衛生上の課題と、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの取り組みについての報道だが、新しい流行の発生や急速な危機的状況を示す証拠に欠ける。疾患の予防・管理に関する政策レベルの情報であり、シグナル検知の閾値には達していない。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の負担は重大であることが記事で述べられている（2024年に100万件以上の入院、3兆ルピアの関連費用）。しかし、本記事の主眼はワクチン接種キャンペーンと民間企業によるパートナーシップの紹介であり、新規流行の検知やアウトブレイク報告ではない。継続的な監視対象疾患の管理状況についての報道として捉えられるため、シグナル検知の判定基準を満たさないWATCH判定とした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: अटलांटिक में क्रूज शिप पर हंता वायरस का कहर: 3 मौतें, भारत के लिए कितना खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Ravages Cruise Ship in the Atlantic: 3 Deaths, How Much of a Threat Does It Pose to India?
article.articleSummary: Three deaths from hantavirus have been reported aboard the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius off Cape Verde in the Atlantic, with several other passengers ill. The 147-person vessel (88 passengers, 59 crew) left Ushuaia, Argentina on 1 April for Antarctica and the South Atlantic Islands; cases occurred 6–28 April. Hantavirus is a rare infection transmitted mainly via infected rodent urine, droppings or saliva and can cause pneumonia; fever, headache, vomiting, diarrhea and shortness of breath are common symptoms. Human-to-human transmission is possible but rare, seen in some South American cases. Cape Verde did not allow docking; WHO is monitoring with the Netherlands, Spain, South Africa and the UK, and medical teams on board. Passengers and crew are advised isolation, masks, hand hygiene and distancing; diverting toward the Canary Islands is under consideration. For India, risk is very low, though vigilance for travelers from South America and Africa is advised.

triage.headline_ja: アトランティックの客船でハンタウイルス感染: 3人死亡、インドにとってどのような脅威か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ該当（重症性・国際的拡大リスク）し、複数国の当局が監視中だが、記事が特定対象国での実際の発生を示しておらず、インド向けリスク評価は「非常に低い」と明記されている。情報が限定的で、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに対象国が複数含まれているが、サマリーの実際の事象は客船MV Hondiusでの発生であり、特定の陸上国での感染症流行ではない。インドは記事見出しで言及されているが、本文では『インドにとってのリスクは非常に低い』と明記されている。イベントの実質的な関連は限定的。南米訪問者への警戒強化は推奨されているが、対象国内での発生確認ではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: New Hantavirus Cases Confirmed Onboard Cruise Ship Now Stuck Now Anchored Near Cape Verde
article.articleSummary: Two new hantavirus cases confirmed onboard the MV Hondius, anchored near Cape Verde, Africa, as a deadly outbreak has claimed three lives. The deceased include a Dutch husband and wife and a German passenger; the Dutch woman tested positive. A British national who also tested positive is in intensive care in South Africa. Two crew members with unconfirmed cases will be evacuated, along with a close contact of the German national who died. Other passengers and crew remain onboard under strict isolation; disembarkation has been barred by local authorities. The ship’s Filipino crew members number 38 of 61. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne, transmitted via contact with infected rodents’ urine, droppings or saliva, usually by inhalation. There is no vaccine or antiviral treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケープベルデ沖に停泊するクルーズ船上でハンタウイルス感染症の新規症例が確認、現在船に立ち往生中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：3死亡、予想外の船上集団発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施中）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーを詳細に検証した結果、実際の感染症イベント発生地は①ケープベルデ沖（アンカー地点）②南アフリカ（患者移送先）③オランダ・ドイツ・英国（患者の国籍地）であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはフィリピン（クルーメンバーの国籍地）のみ。ケープベルデはGhana(2300660)やZambia(895949)ではなく対象国に含まれないため除外。本イベントは国際的な船舶関連の多国籍集団発生であり、WPRO地域外の事象だが、フィリピン国籍クルーの関与により対象国リストに該当。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、死亡例と重症例があり、国際的隔離措置実施中であるため、フルRRA対象として PICKUP 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Na uitbraak op cruiseschip: Wat is het hantavirus precies? - Newsmonkey
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After an outbreak on a cruise ship: What exactly is hantavirus?
article.articleSummary: Three passengers died after a suspected hantavirus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship. A Dutch couple and a German national have died; two confirmed cases, including the Dutch woman, while investigators study the deaths of the other two. Hantaviruses spread primarily through inhalation of particles from rodent droppings, though bites or scratches by rodents can occur. They cause two serious diseases: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), which begins with fatigue, fever and myalgia and can progress to respiratory failure with about 38% mortality; and Haemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS), which damages kidneys and can lead to hypotension, internal bleeding and acute kidney failure. Worldwide, hantavirus infections occur; around 150,000 HFRS cases are reported annually, mainly in Europe and Asia, with China accounting for more than half. No specific treatment exists; management is supportive. CDC recommends minimizing rodent exposure, sealing basement/attic openings, and using protective gear when cleaning droppings.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船での流行後：ハンタウイルスとは正確には何か？
triage.triage_reason: 大西洋のクルーズ船での集団ハンタウイルス感染（3名死亡、2名確認症例）は異常かつ予想外であり、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）2項目以上に該当。国際的な対象国（ドイツ、オランダ、中国に関連）を含むため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー内で中国は「ハンタウイルス感染の年間症例の半数以上が中国で報告されている」という文脈での言及のみ。実際のクルーズ船での急性集団発生地点は大西洋上（ドイツ・オランダ国籍者が該当）であり、評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は China のみ。ただしクルーズ船でのHPS/HFRS混在の急性集団発生、高い致死率（38%）、国際的な乗客構成を考慮するとIHR Annex2の全4基準に該当するため、シグナルとして PICKUP 判定は妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 冷凍肉放冰箱「過期2年」照吃　79歲翁太節儉　感染化膿腦膜炎險喪命 | 兩岸(大陸) | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frozen meat stored in the fridge 'two years past expiry' and eaten anyway; a 79-year-old man was extremely frugal; contracted purulent meningitis and nearly died | Cross-Strait (Mainland China) | SETN News SETN.COM
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, a 79-year-old man developed purulent meningitis caused by Streptococcus pasteurianus subspecies after long-term storage of frozen meat and seafood in his fridge. He woke with sudden weakness, fever up to 40°C, neck stiffness, and inability to speak, later experiencing altered consciousness, diarrhea, and incontinence. Hospital MRI showed bilateral frontal subdural effusions; laboratory tests indicated severe infection. Streptococcus pasteurianus subspecies was identified as the pathogen; infection likely originated from ingestion of expired freezer stock, with bacteria surviving in the gut and invading the brain. The patient was promptly treated and survived. The report notes three bacteria commonly lurking in refrigerators: Listeria monocytogenes, Staphylococcus aureus, and Salmonella, and urges regular fridge cleaning, careful food handling, and washing produce before consumption to reduce foodborne meningitis risk.

triage.headline_ja: 冷凍肉放冰箱「過期2年」照吃　79歲翁太節儉　感染化膿腦膜炎險喪命
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生的な流行・アウトブレイク状況ではない。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本件は中国・深圳での単一症例（79歳男性が期限切れ冷凍肉を摂取し、化膿性髄膜炎（Streptococcus pasteurianus）を発症したが治癒）の臨床報告である。食品衛生に関する一般的な注意喚起を含むが、流行・集団発生の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の機関対応を要する緊急事態ではない。個別の医学記事として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sapi Terjangkit LSD dan Cacingan di Pasar Dimoro Blitar, DKPP Perketat Pengawasan - Suara Merdeka Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cattle Infected with Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) and Worm Infestation at Dimoro Market, Blitar; DKPP Tightens Surveillance - Suara Merdeka East Java
article.articleSummary: One case of Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) identified in a cow at Dimoro Market, Blitar, East Java, with around 16 cows found to have parasitic worm infections and a goat with scabies. Health officials from DKPP Blitar say checks began in early May to ensure sacrificial cattle for Eid al-Adha are fit for sale. LSD is viral and highly contagious among cattle; after the finding, the surrounding area was disinfected to curb spread. The worm infections are being treated with deworming, and the goat scabies case addressed on site. Vendors were urged not to bring animals displaying LSD or Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) symptoms to market. Surveillance of market cattle will be tightened through Eid al-Adha to ensure healthy, safe, and suitable meat for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: ブリタル市ディモロ市場で牛がルンピースキン病と寄生虫感染に罹患、DKPP当局が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患の局所的集積事例（16頭の寄生虫感染、1頭のLSD、1頭の疥癬）で、獣医当局による局地的対応が進行中。人獣共通感染症ではなく、国際拡大リスク、公衆衛生への重大影響は現段階では限定的だが、LSDおよびFMDは家畜生産に重要であり、東南アジア地域での感染拡大可能性を継続監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 動物市場での限定的な集積。当局による局地的対応（消毒、検査、監視強化）が実施されている。LSDとFMDはいずれも家畜への感染が確認されており、疫学的には注視対象。ただし現段階では人の健康被害は報告されていない。イード・アル・アドハの祭礼に向けた食肉供給チェーン管理の一環として理解される。継続的な情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam chưa ghi nhận trường hợp mắc bệnh do virus Hanta trên người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has not yet recorded any human cases of hantavirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus infection: Vietnam has not recorded any human cases as of 2026-05-06. Hantavirus can cause severe disease in humans, including hantavirus pulmonary syndrome and hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, with rapid progression to respiratory failure and potentially death. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive and respiratory care as needed. The Ministry of Health's Preventive Medicine Department reiterates no human cases to date and outlines five key preventive measures: avoid direct contact with rats or rodent droppings; when cleaning rodent-affected areas, ventilate rooms, wear gloves and a mask, damp-wipe contaminated zones with disinfectant rather than sweeping or vacuuming; wash hands after cleaning or handling waste; seal entry points, use traps, and store food and water in closed containers; dispose of waste daily. If fever, chills, headache, dizziness, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, or diarrhea occur after rodent exposure, seek medical care promptly and report exposure to healthcare providers.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはまだハンタウイルス感染症のヒト症例を記録していない
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのハンタウイルスのヒト感染例は報告されておらず、予防啓発に関する情報提供である。現在のイベントがないため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準への該当がなく、シグナルの閾値に達していない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は「ベトナムではハンタウイルスのヒト感染例が未報告」という予防啓発メッセージであり、実際の感染症発生イベントではない。政府衛生部門による予防策の周知は確認されるが、現在のイベント性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 11 tuổi sốc nhiễm trùng nặng: Sai lầm của phụ huynh cần tránh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11-Year-Old Girl in Severe Septic Shock: Parents' Mistakes to Avoid
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old girl from An Giang Province, Vietnam, developed septic shock with severe pneumonia and sepsis-induced myocardial injury due to Streptococcus pneumoniae. After four days of fever and GI symptoms, she deteriorated and was transferred from a local hospital to City Children’s Hospital. On admission she was drowsy with tachypnea (42/min), hypotension, and cold extremities; EF 20–24% with elevated lactate. Diagnoses: septic shock and severe pneumonia with organ dysfunction. She required intubation, vasopressors, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and VA‑ECMO. PCR confirmed pneumococcus. She received blood products, electrolyte correction, and four CRRT sessions with liver support. After ~two weeks on ECMO, EF rose to 50–55% and BP stabilized; ECMO was removed. A complication of thrombosis in left vertebral and left external iliac arteries was treated with thrombectomy and anticoagulation, restoring perfusion. Nearly one month, she recovered: alert, eating, with improving liver/kidney function. Advised not to self-medicate and to vaccinate against pneumococcus and influenza.

triage.headline_ja: 11歳の女児が重篤な敗血性ショック：保護者が避けるべき過ちについて
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌による重症敗血性ショック症例の個別ケース報告。重症度は高いが、単一症例であり異常/予想外性は限定的。ベトナムは対象国に含まれるが、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の問題を示す根拠が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事は個別症例（11歳女児）の重症肺炎球菌感染による敗血性ショックの臨床経過レポートである。医学的には重要だが、集団発生や流行を示唆する情報がない。記事の目的は保護者教育（自己投薬の回避、肺炎球菌・インフルエンザワクチン接種の推奨）であり、公衆衛生上の警告フェーズ記事である。疾患自体は既知で予防可能。国際的拡大リスクはない。続報による追加症例数の情報があれば判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: พญาไท-เปาโล จับมือ Jaymart Group เปิดดีลสุขภาพเชิงรุก ยกระดับการรับมือไข้เลือดออก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phaya Thai–Paolo Teams Up with Jaymart Group to Launch a Proactive Health Deal, Elevating Dengue Fever Response.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Phaya Thai–Paolo Hospital group collaborates with Jaymart Group to launch the 'Vaccine for Thailand' campaign, integrating preventive health care with financial protection. The program promotes dengue vaccination using the latest vaccine Qdenga, covering four serotypes. Eligible individuals include children aged 4 years and older and adults, including those with no prior dengue history, with no immunity testing required. The vaccine is reported to provide over 80% protection against infection and reduce hospitalization risk by more than 90%. The regimen consists of two doses administered three months apart. The initiative aims to elevate preventive health care across Thailand by aligning medical expertise with insurance-based risk management to improve access and sustainability of health services.

triage.headline_ja: パヤタイ・パオロ病院がジャイマート・グループと提携し、デング熱対応を強化する積極的ヘルスケア施策を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンキャンペーンの医療・財務協力についての報道であり、新規患者発生や感染症危機を示す情報がない。疾患管理・予防イニシアティブの施策であるため、緊急感染症シグナルの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はワクチンキャンペーン・予防保健施策の商業的発表であり、疾患の流行拡大、患者数増加、医療危機などの感染症イベント指標を含まない。デング熱ワクチン導入推進の制度的ニュースとして分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Pour la première fois, un virus d'origine aquatique infecte l'Homme : état des connaissances et symptômes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the first time, a virus of aquatic origin infects humans: state of knowledge and symptoms.
article.articleSummary: First-ever human infection by an aquatic-origin virus: the covert mortality nodavirus (CMNV) identified in 70 patients with anterior viral uveitis and ocular hypertension in China. A Nature Microbiology study (March 26, 2026) detected CMNV genetic material in ocular tissues with a 99% sequence match to animal CMNV strains, and other ocular viruses were not found. Most patients had CMNV-specific antibodies in blood. Over 70% shared exposure to aquatic species carrying CMNV through unprotected handling or raw seafood consumption. Mouse experiments showed CMNV can elevate intraocular pressure and damage ocular tissues, and the virus can infect mammalian cells in vitro, raising questions about a human threat. Risk remains difficult to quantify; the outbreak is currently limited, but cross-species potential and global presence warrant close monitoring and further research.

triage.headline_ja: 初めて、水生由来のウイルスがヒトに感染：知見と症状の現状
triage.triage_reason: 新規病原体（CMNV）による初のヒト感染事例で、70人以上の患者が関与し、動物からのクロススピーシス感染が確認されている。異常性、重症度（眼部組織損傷）、感染可能性が認められ、国際的な監視が必要な新興感染症として認識される。
triage.notes: 新規ウイルス（Covert Mortality Nodavirus; CMNV）による初のヒト感染事例。患者は中国で眼部炎症（前部ウイルス性ぶどう膜炎）および眼圧上昇を呈している。Nature Microbiologyに発表された研究（2026年3月26日）。動物由来で、水生動物の取り扱いや生水産物摂取が主な曝露経路。マウス実験で眼組織損傷とIOP上昇が確認され、哺乳動物細胞への感染能力あり。現在のところ発生は限定的だが、クロススピーシス感染ポテンシャルと世界的な動物保持率から継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Inspektorat povlači proizvod zbog opasne bakterije: Hitno provjerite svoje police - Dnevno.hr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inspectorate Recalls Product Due to Dangerous Bacteria: Urgently Check Your Shelves
article.articleSummary: Croatia's Government Inspectorate recalls GREEN BOX LIMITED ENOKI GLJIVE 100 g after detection of Listeria monocytogenes. The product, series G22030, barcode 6936489101348, was placed on the market via Asia Express Food of Kampen, Netherlands, and distributed in Croatia by Gorkhas and Associates d.o.o. of Zagreb; the item originates from China. The recall follows non-compliance with EU Regulation 178/2002 guaranteeing food safety. Consumers are advised not to consume the product and to return it to the point of purchase or dispose of it per retailer instructions; seek medical care if symptoms occur. Listeria monocytogenes can cause serious illness, including central nervous system infection, and can survive and grow at refrigeration temperatures. Transmission is via contaminated foods such as raw or undercooked products, chilled ready-to-eat foods, deli meats, dairy, and vegetables. In healthy people infections are mild, but pregnant women, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals may develop sepsis or meningitis, risking fetus.

triage.headline_ja: 検査官庁が危険な細菌のため製品をリコール：棚を緊急に確認してください
triage.triage_reason: クロアチアのリステリア菌汚染食品（キノコ）のリコール事案。検出は単一製品ロットで、EU圏内の規制当局による適切な対応が実施されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的な流行拡大のリスクが認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはクロアチア、オランダ、中国が含まれているが、記事の主題は欧州で流通した食品のリコール事案（製造地は中国だが患者報告なし）。対象国リストに該当する国が実際の感染症発生地ではなく、食品安全規制当局による予防的措置であるため、シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: നവാപൂരില്‍ വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; രണ്ടുലക്ഷം കോഴികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza again in Navapur; two lakh chickens culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza hits Navapur, Maharashtra. By May 5, 2026, authorities culled over 200,000 chickens, destroyed about 800,000 eggs, and discarded more than 210 metric tons of feed to curb spread. First signs appeared April 12; initial mortality was attributed to heat stress before deaths surged. Lab confirmation by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) identified positive samples from three birds. On April 30, the district collector declared affected areas, with a 1 km infected zone and a 10 km surveillance radius. Movement and sale of poultry and eggs are banned for 90 days. An 18-member culling team and about 140 field staff are deployed. This marks the third major avian influenza outbreak in India since 2006 and 2021. Farmers face losses of at least ₹200 per bird; vaccination is not yet permitted due to surveillance concerns, though compensation will be distributed quickly.

triage.headline_ja: ナーワープルで再び鳥インフルエンザ発生；200万羽の鶏を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: インドの動物感染症（高病原性鳥インフルエンザ）であり、大規模な殺処分（20万羽以上）と公衆衛生対応が実施されている。WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: マハラシュトラ州ナーワープルにおける高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）の再発生。20万羽以上の鶏の殺処分、80万個の卵破棄、210トン以上の飼料廃棄が実施された。国立高度安全性動物疾病研究所（NIHSAD）による検査で3羽から陽性が確認。90日間の家禽・卵の移動・販売禁止措置が発令。インド国内では2006年以降3番目の大規模発生。人への感染リスクは現時点で記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: クルーズ船ハンタウイルス集団感染は序章にすぎない？ 科学者が警告する気候変動により南米全土へ"大移動"する齧歯類ウイルスの恐怖 - TOCANA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the cruise-ship hantavirus outbreak only a prologue? Scientists warn of a climate-change-driven "great migration" of rodent-borne viruses across the entire South American continent.
article.articleSummary: Off the Cape Verde coast, the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius has seen three deaths, a Dutch couple and a German, from hantavirus infections among passengers and crew after docking in Argentina and sailing back into the Atlantic. WHO has officially confirmed six hantavirus infections, with roughly 150 people still aboard. Officials say rodent exposure aboard the ship or at South American ports could be sources. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne causes of hemorrhagic fever with no vaccine or specific antiviral therapy. Separately, Arenaviruses—Guanarito (Venezuela/Colombia), Machupo (Bolivia/Paraguay), Junin (Argentina)—pose regional threats. A study using machine learning links climate-change-driven rodent range shifts and land-use change to potential South American spread over 20–40 years, predicting Guanarito expanding into Colombia, Suriname border, and northern Brazil; Machupo into Bolivian plains to the Andes; Junin across Argentina. Zoonotic spillover could affect immunologically naive populations.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船ハンタウイルス集団感染は序章にすぎない？ 科学者が警告する気候変動により南米全土へ"大移動"する齧歯類ウイルスの恐怖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当。クルーズ船での確認死亡例と感染者、複数国での病原体脅威、気候変動に伴う広域拡大リスクの報告がある。
triage.notes: クルーズ船の港湾立ち寄り地がアルゼンチンで、その後大西洋にてケープベルデ沖で症例発生。記事サマリーの主題は南米全体の齧歯類ウイルス拡大リスクであり、複数国（ベネズエラ、コロンビア、ボリビア、パラグアイ、アルゼンチン）が言及されているが、対象国リストではBrazilのみ該当。ハンタウイルスとアレナウイルス（Guanarito、Machupo、Junin）の複合的な脅威、気候変動に起因する齧歯類分布変化による20～40年での広域拡大予測が報告されている。WHOによる6感染者の確認、3名の死亡、150名以上の船上滞在者がいる。

article.articleHeadline: Yolcu gemisinde ölümlere neden olan hantavirüs hakkında neler biliniyor?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the hantavirus that caused deaths on the passenger ship?
article.articleSummary: Three deaths linked to hantavirus on the MV Hondius in the Atlantic; WHO confirms two laboratory-confirmed hantavirus cases aboard, with five suspected cases under investigation. One confirmed decedent is a Dutch woman; her husband reportedly died on board but his case remains unconfirmed. Investigations, including laboratory testing, are ongoing. The ship, operated by Oceanwide Expeditions, carries 149 people from 23 countries, en route from Argentina to the Cape Verde Islands, with plans to reach the Canary Islands where two crew members, including a British doctor, were to be evacuated by helicopter for urgent care; the deceased's body was also to be transported. Transmission is rodent-borne, via inhalation of aerosolized excreta; rarely by bites. Symptoms include HPS (fever, fatigue, muscle pain, possibly fatal respiratory failure, ~38% mortality) or HFRS (kidney involvement). Global incidence: ~150,000 HFRS cases annually; China accounts for over half; Seoul virus is widespread. Treatment is supportive; prevention emphasizes rodent control. In Feb 2025, Betsy Arakawa died from a hantavirus-related respiratory illness, suspected to be HPS contracted in the U.S.

triage.headline_ja: 乗客船での死亡を引き起こしたハンタウイルスについて何が知られているか？
triage.triage_reason: 大西洋の乗客船MV Hondiusでハンタウイルス感染による複数死亡が確認され、国際的に移動する乗客（23ヶ国から149人）が関係しており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外性」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡）と流行しやすさ（密閉船舶環境での多国籍人口）が該当し、高い社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはIowa、Florida、Canary Islands等が含まれるが、これらは対象国（CEPR指定）に含まれていない。ただしサマリー内でChina（世界的ハンタウイルス症例の半数以上を占める）への言及があり、また乗客船は国際海域（大西洋）を移動中で複数国籍者が関係している。本件は国際保健上のシグナルとして重要であるが、対象国の検証では基本的にChinaのみ該当する（WHOの他国への通知対象事例）。

article.articleHeadline: Ditakutkan Bisa Seperti Covid-19? Virus Hanta Bukan Penyakit Baru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feared to Be Like COVID-19? Hantavirus Is Not a New Disease.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths on the expedition cruise MV Hondius (Oceanwide Expeditions) linked to suspected hantavirus after a passenger developed severe respiratory illness; on May 2, 2026, the ship carrying 147 passengers and crew reported fatalities. WHO deems the global risk from hantavirus on this voyage as low but will continue epidemiological monitoring and update risk assessments as needed. Hantavirus, caused by Orthohantavirus genus, is a rodent- and shrew-borne disease with rats and shrews as reservoirs. In Indonesia, confirmed reservoirs include Rattus norvegicus (Norway rat) and R. tanezumi (house rat), with additional species such as R. tiomanicus, R. exulans, R. argentiventer, Mus musculus, Bandicota indica, and Maxomys surifer implicated; reservoirs exist across homes, rice fields, fields, and forests. The article highlights rodent exposure as the transmission route but does not specify laboratory confirmation or imported/exported case details. Disease name, location, case/death counts, and ongoing monitoring are captured for quick guidance.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19のようになることが懸念される？ハンタウイルスは新しい病気ではない
triage.triage_reason: 遠洋探検船での集団発生（3死亡、147人乗船）により異常/予想外で重症度基準を満たし、国際的な船舶移動に伴うスクリーニング基準複数該当。国際支援監視下にあるため。
triage.notes: 国際探検船（MV Hondius）での多国籍乗客による発生。WHOが継続監視中。ハンタウイルスはげっ歯類由来で、インドネシア国内に複数の自然宿主が確認されている。ただし記事サマリーに検査確定や詳細な症例定義の記載がない。

article.articleHeadline: เตือนภัย ลูกไซบีเรียนฮัสกีข่วน หนุ่มอุบล ติดเชื้อพิษสุนัขบ้าดับ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies alert: Siberian Husky puppy scratches a man from Ubon; he contracted rabies and died.
article.articleSummary: Rabies fatality in Ubon Ratchathani, Thailand: A 47-year-old man, previously healthy, died after being scratched by a Siberian Husky puppy; rabies was confirmed. Provincial livestock officials launched a control campaign, vaccinating 612 animals in the outbreak area—511 dogs and 101 cats. The vaccination radius extended 5 kilometers around the incident, covering four villages: Ariy Phatana, Hua Don, Non Sawang, and Por Khī Tun, in Ban Na Jaai, Huai Faai Phatana Subdistrict, Tra Kar Phuet District. Public health outreach urged residents to monitor mammals for at least six months and seek immediate hospital care for exposures such as bites, scratches, or saliva contact with mucous membranes or open wounds. Rabies remains 100% fatal once symptoms appear; vaccination is the key preventive measure for both pets and people.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病警報：シベリアンハスキーの子犬に引っかかれたウボン出身の男性が狂犬病に感染して死亡
triage.triage_reason: タイで狂犬病による死亡が確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（100%致死率）、異常/予想外性（健康だった男性の急速な進行と死亡）、地域での流行対策の必要性からIHR基準2項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目以上に該当。フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は100%致死率の感染症で、既に死亡例が確認されている。タイ当局は迅速に対応し、612頭の動物にワクチン接種を実施。公衆衛生の啓発キャンペーンも展開中。タイは対象国のため、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO称涉疫邮轮或出现有限"人传人"，过去一个月发生了什么？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says cruise ships linked to the outbreak may have limited 'human-to-human transmission'; what has happened in the past month?
article.articleSummary: May 5–6, 2026: WHO says the expedition cruise Hondius anchored off Praia, Cape Verde, shows possible limited human-to-human hantavirus transmission among close contacts on board. Three deaths have occurred: a Dutch couple and a German national; a British passenger remains critically ill in South Africa. Chinese authorities report no Chinese nationals aboard. Two crew members have acute respiratory symptoms; a severely ill German passenger died May 2; another patient has mild fever. All are suspected hantavirus cases. The virus is Andes hantavirus, typically rodent-borne, but with rare documented human transmission in some Andes outbreaks. The initial infections may have occurred prior to boarding in Argentina, with an incubation of 1–6 weeks and progression from fever/ GI symptoms to pneumonia, ARDS, and shock. About 150 people from 23 countries remain aboard; Cape Verde bans docking; medevac transfers planned to the Netherlands; ship to Canary Islands with Spain coordinating epidemiology and disinfection. Isolation on board; quarantine could extend up to two months; not a broad public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、感染者が発生した客船での限定的な「人から人への感染」を報告。過去1か月で何が起きたのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。稀な病原体のヒト-ヒト感染、複数国での死亡事例、国際的な船舶移動を伴う事例であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は客船Hondius上でのハンタウイルス感染事例を報告。Bluedot APIが提示した複数の地域（カナリア諸島、カボベルデ、南アフリカ、オランダ、アルゼンチン、スペイン）は全て船舶の移動経路または患者・乗客の関連国であり、実際の発生地は船舶上である。対象国リスト内では中国のみ該当し、サマリーで「中国当局は船上に中国国民がいないと報告」と述べられている。限定的なヒト-ヒト感染と記載されているが、複数死亡例と国際的な関連性、渡航制限の実施により、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: New Research Aims to Tackle Malaria Treatment Hurdles
article.articleSummary: Malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum faces treatment hurdles. The parasite’s Falcipain-2 (FP2) is a cysteine protease essential for digesting hemoglobin in infected red blood cells, enabling parasite growth and contributing to anemia and severe malaria symptoms. Although FP2 is parasite-specific, it closely resembles human cathepsins, complicating selective targeting. In a FEBS Journal study, researchers used computational analyses to explore how polyethylene glycol, especially PEG400, binds FP2 and its hemoglobin substrate. They identified a FP2-binding pocket with minimal conservation in human cathepsins; PEG400 binding can modulate FP2’s hemoglobin digestion. These findings support designing new small-molecule FP2 inhibitors that selectively inhibit parasite activity with reduced off-target effects on human cathepsins, potentially improving antimalarial therapies. Corresponding author Sampa Biswas—formerly at the Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics (India) and now at InBOL Health Care—emphasizes the path toward selective FP2 inhibition. Publication: The FEBS Journal, 2026-05-06.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい研究がマラリア治療の課題に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究成果の報告であり、実際の感染症の流行・発生を報じるものではなく、治療法開発に関する学術的なニュースである。公衆衛生への即時的な影響や異常な感染症イベントを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドを言及しているが、実際のマラリア流行・発生を報じるものではなく、マラリア治療薬開発に関する基礎研究の学術成果の報告である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Expert Tips To Prevent Malaria In The Summer Season
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a serious threat in India's summer, where warm weather, stagnant water, and exposed skin create ideal conditions for mosquitoes. Dr. Sandeep Kumar Kadian, Senior Consultant Intensivist at AIMS Hospital (Dombivli, Mumbai), warns that malaria symptoms commonly start with fever with chills and sweating, plus headache, body aches, fatigue, and may include nausea, vomiting, or diarrhoea. A fever persisting 3–4 days is a red flag, often misattributed to a viral illness. If untreated, malaria can progress to anaemia, breathing problems, organ failure, or coma. The article emphasizes basic prevention measures, noting that protection is essential for themselves and families during outdoor activities, evening walks, and open windows. Dr. Kadian provides simple, actionable steps to prevent malaria during the summer season in India (as of 2026-05-06).

triage.headline_ja: 夏季のマラリア予防に関する専門家のアドバイス
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドにおけるマラリア予防啓発記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。疾病管理状況の定期的な情報提供であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップ要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は専門医による予防啓発コンテンツであり、新規のアウトブレイク報告、患者数増加、または異常な感染事象を報告していない。インドにおけるマラリアは常在地域での季節的な疾患であり、そのための定期的な予防情報提供は日常的な疾病管理活動である。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: ECDC: Θάνατος παιδιού από γρίπη των πτηνών - Συναγερμός για χολέρα και ιό τσικουνγκούνια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ECDC: Death of a child from avian influenza - Alert for cholera and chikungunya virus
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) caused a fatal child case in Bangladesh, with exposure to sick/dead poultry; WHO reports 998 human cases since 2003, 478 deaths (48% CFR); no sustained human-to-human transmission; EU/EEA risk remains low. Cholera in 2026 totals 65,153 cases and 768 deaths globally (Jan 1–Apr 28), with 20,028 cases and 272 deaths from Mar 30–Apr 28; outbreaks in Afghanistan, DRC, Yemen, Malawi, Mozambique; deaths led by DRC, then Angola, Nigeria, Congo, Zambia; travel-associated EU/EEA imports possible; 2024 had 16 imported EU/EEA cases. SARS-CoV-2: no changes in variant classification as of Apr 24; limited EU/EEA data; overall transmission low; hybrid immunity offers protection, though older or ill individuals remain at risk. Chikungunya in French Guiana: 143 locally acquired cases in 2026, 33 in week 16; Littoral ouest epicenter; travel risk to Europe minimal; vaccination considered per national guidance. Overall, EU/EEA remains low risk but global surveillance must continue.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC: 鳥インフルエンザによる小児死亡 - コレラとチキンガンヤウイルスの警報
triage.triage_reason: H5N1による致死的小児症例、複数国でのコレラ発生、チキンガンヤの地域流行が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限の懸念があるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際に疾患が発生・報告されている対象国のみを verified_locations に含めた。フランス領ギアナはフランス領土だが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。フランス、アンゴーラ、ナイジェリア、コンゴはサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。複数疾患の同時発生と国際的な広がり、WHO通知相当のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: તાવ બાદ 5 વર્ષીય બાળકનું મોત, માતાનો રડી રડીને બેહાલ:  સુરતમાં આકરા ઉનાળે પણ રોગચાળો વકર્યો, બાળક સહિત 3નાં મોત; સિવિલ હોસ્પિટલમાં દર્દીઓની લાંબી કતારો - Surat News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a 5-year-old child after fever; mother sobbing uncontrollably collapses: In Surat, the outbreak has surged even in the scorching summer heat; three deaths including the child; long queues of patients at Civil Hospital - Surat News.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths in Surat amid a summer outbreak of fever- and mosquito-borne illnesses. A 5-year-old Hasan from Pratapnagar Anganwadi died after sudden high fever and vomiting, rushed to New Civil Hospital where he was pronounced dead. A 39-year-old sanitation worker, Karn Rameshbhai Solanki, resident of Rampara, succumbed to fever shortly after hospitalization. A 36-year-old Arun Rajendra More, a wage laborer from Ved Road near Triveni Society, also died at the same facility. The hospital, overwhelmed by cases, reported rising counts of dengue, malaria, typhoid, and other fever-related illnesses in April. Authorities attribute the spike to hot summer conditions contributing to water- and mosquito-borne diseases; advisories include boiling drinking water, avoiding street foods, and seeking medical care at government hospitals for fever or fever-like symptoms. Public-health measures emphasize rapid clinical evaluation and outbreak containment in Surat.

triage.headline_ja: 熱発後5歳児が死亡、母親が泣き叫ぶ：スラトの過酷な夏でも流行が続発、子どもを含む3人が死亡；シビルホスピタルに患者の長い列
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、デング熱・マラリア・チフスの複合流行による死亡事例が報告されている。インドのグジャラート州スラトで複数の死亡例と医療機関の逼迫が確認されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: スラト（Surat）はグジャラート州の主要都市で、記事は夏期における水・蚊媒介感染症の複合流行を報告している。3人の死亡例、シビルホスピタルの患者急増、デング熱・マラリア・チフスの同時発生が確認されている。公開情報源による報道であり、インド当局による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal Hantavirus: Cara Penularan, Gejala, dan Risikonya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understanding Hantavirus: Transmission Routes, Symptoms, and Its Risks.
article.articleSummary: Three tourists died and another tested positive for hantavirus aboard the Hondius, a cruise from Argentina to Cape Verde; a 69-year-old man is in intensive care in South Africa. WHO Europe says the public risk is low and no travel restrictions are needed. Hantavirus is a zoonosis transmitted mainly by inhaling dust contaminated with excreta from rodents, shrews, moles, or bats, and can persist for weeks; human-to-human transmission is not documented in Europe, though Andes virus in the Americas has shown limited transmission. Severity varies by strain: Eurasian/Asian strains often cause flu-like illness; some progress to hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome; Americas strains can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome with 30–40% fatality. In Germany Puumala is common (~1% mortality); no vaccine exists in Europe or the Americas; vaccines exist in China and Korea but with unproven efficacy. Treatments are supportive; experimental antibody therapy and Puumala-targeted DNA vaccine show early promise.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスを知る：感染経路、症状、およびそのリスク
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な多地域での死亡事例（アルゼンチナ→カーボベルデへの航海中およびザンビア）、複数疾患（ハンタウイルス感染症、出血熱、インフルエンザ）、異常な状況（クルーズ船での集団発生）、国際的な拡大リスクが認められ、IHR基準3項目以上かつWPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはハンタウイルスの一般的な情報と複数地域（アルゼンチナ、カーボベルデ、南アフリカ、ドイツ、韓国、中国）での事例を言及しているが、対象国リストの中で実際の発生が確認される国はChina（ワクチン存在）のみ。アルゼンチナ、ドイツ、韓国、南アフリカはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。死亡者3名および集中治療患者の報告により重症度が高い。クルーズ船での多地域曝露による国際的拡大の可能性が懸念される。WHO Europeは公衆衛生リスクを低いと評価しているが、複数の死亡事例が報告されており、フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus chega à África do Sul: dois casos confirmados e um doente em estado crítico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Arrives in South Africa: Two Confirmed Cases and One Patient in Critical Condition.
article.articleSummary: South Africa reports two confirmed hantavirus cases of the Andes strain in passengers from the MV Hondius cruise linked to a Cape Verde outbreak. A Dutch woman died in Johannesburg and a British man remains in critical condition; both had fallen ill aboard the ship. The incident cluster on MV Hondius includes five suspected cases and three deaths, with the vessel near Cabo Verde and heading toward Santa Helena when patients were transferred to South Africa; Spain later approved docking at the Canary Islands. NICD laboratories confirmed the Andes hantavirus, the only strain known to support human-to-human transmission, though such spread is rare and usually linked to close contact; other strains transmit via contact with rodents or their urine, feces, or saliva. A potential domestic case—an airport transit patient who collapsed in Johannesburg and died—is under review for linkage to the outbreak. Authorities urge vigilance and containment of transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスが南アフリカに到達：2例の確認症例と重症患者1名
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ（異常、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。ヒト-ヒト伝播可能なアンデス型ハンタウイルスの国際的クラスターで、死亡例あり、複数国にまたがる海事関連の多国籍乗客がかかわる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは南アフリカ、スペイン、ケープベルデなど多数の国を発生地域として提示しているが、サマリー上の主要な実際の感染イベント発生国は南アフリカである。ただし南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verificed_locationsには含めない。ブラジル（マラニャン州）も記事内で言及されているため含める。ハンタウイルスのアンデス型は稀なヒト-ヒト伝播能を持ち、クルーズ船という密閉環境での多国籍乗客関与、複数死亡例、未確認の国内関連症例により高リスク評価。

locations.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Saint Helena, Ascension, and Tristan da Cunha

article.articleHeadline: Cum a ajuns infecția cu hantavirus pe vasul de croazieră. Misterul care îi pune în dificultate pe experți
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the hantavirus infection reached the cruise ship. The mystery that’s puzzling the experts.
article.articleSummary: Seven hantavirus cases linked to a cruise that departed Ushuaia, Argentina, on April 1, with a South Atlantic itinerary to South Georgia, the South Sandwich Islands, and Saint Helena. By May 2, the World Health Organization reported two confirmed hantavirus infections and five suspected cases, including three deaths, one patient in critical condition, and three with mild symptoms. Argentina, in coordination with Tierra del Fuego authorities and international partners, is tracing passenger histories, the ship’s route, and potential epidemiological links to determine the transmission pathway. Hantavirus incubation ranges from one to six weeks, supporting infection before boarding, likely during activities in Argentina prior to departure. Laboratory confirmation is ongoing, with samples analyzed in South Africa to identify the viral strain. Cape Verde authorities manage outbreak response; Tierra del Fuego offers support. Santa Cruz province reports no hantavirus cases in seven years.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船に到達したハンタウイルス感染。専門家を困惑させている謎
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）。死亡を含む確定症例と疑い症例が存在し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから付与された発生地域リスト内に複数の国が含まれているが、記事サマリー上で実際の感染イベントが発生・確認されているのはアルゼンチン（Tierra del Fuego）およびクルーズ船上である。対象国リストとの照合結果、フィリピン（Calabarzon地域の言及があるため）のみを verified_locations に含める。ただし、サマリーではフィリピンでの実際の症例は明記されておらず、地理的参照のみの可能性が高い。本イベントは国際的な輸送手段（クルーズ船）での集団発症であり、WHOが既に報告している確定症例・死亡を含む重大事象として認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Guru Besar FKM UI Sebut Hantavirus Belum Terbukti Menyebar dari Manusia ke Manusia, meski Berpotensi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor at UI's Faculty of Public Health says hantavirus has not been proven to spread from person to person, although it has potential.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus, a rodent-borne zoonosis first identified in Korea, has not been proven to spread between humans, says Prof. drh. Wiku Bakti Bawono Adisasmito of UI’s Faculty of Public Health. A Dutch-based cruise in the South Atlantic, with about 147 passengers traveling from Argentina to South Africa, has patients with suspected hantavirus infection under investigation. Human transmission typically occurs via exposure to rodent urine, feces, or saliva contaminating environments or food. Investigators consider infection may have occurred on land before boarding or on the ship through contaminated surroundings, with incubation allowing symptoms to emerge during the voyage. Although human-to-human transmission is possible in theory, it is very rare and not confirmed in this case. The voyage involves travelers of multiple nationalities, highlighting cross-border public health relevance.

triage.headline_ja: UI公衆衛生大学院教授、ハンタウイルスはヒト間での感染が未証明だが潜在的可能性があると指摘
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染は国際的な関心事であり、複数国での患者発生が報告されているが、現時点ではヒト間伝播は未確認。対象地域（インドネシア）での直接的な発生報告ではなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのUI公衆衛生大学院教授によるコメント形式であり、インドネシア国内での直接的なハンタウイルス発生報告ではない。実際の患者発生はアルゼンチン〜南アフリカ間の船舶での疑い例であるが、これらの国は評価対象国に含まれていない。IHR基準は2つ該当しているが、対象地域でのシグナルとしては弱いため、追加情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cần chủ động ngăn chặn vi rút lở mồm long móng SAT1 xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Need to proactively prevent the SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease virus from entering.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's General Department of Customs has ordered regional customs bureaus to proactively prevent, monitor, and respond to the risk of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) virus serotype SAT1 entering Vietnam, following Prime Ministerial guidance and in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, while cooperating with local authorities to block SAT1. The agency requires ongoing inspection, surveillance, and controls to promptly detect and prevent illegal imports of animals and animal products, including items carried by travelers’ hand luggage or shipped by transport. Regional customs units should collect information, analyze risks, and assess key localities, routes, and actors at high risk of illicit animal or product movement to apply appropriate checks. The measures also include timely outreach to individuals and businesses on the harms of transporting or trading animals and products that may carry SAT1 to deter smuggling and unregulated imports.

triage.headline_ja: SAT1型口蹄疫ウイルスの侵入を積極的に防止する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの口蹄疫SAT1型の侵入予防活動についての報道。現在のところ国内での確認されたアウトブレイクの報告はなく、予防的措置の段階であるため、情報の継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はSAT1型口蹄疫の侵入防止に関する予防的措置についての報道。現時点で国内でのアウトブレイク確認報告はなく、水際対策の段階。ベトナムは口蹄疫に対して既に高度な警戒態勢を敷いており、関連省庁の関心が高い。SAT1型は動物衛生上の重要な病原体であり、感染しやすい家畜への拡大リスクが存在するため、続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 西班牙同意接收暴發漢坦病毒郵輪　　16:16
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spain agrees to accept a cruise ship with a Hantavirus outbreak 16:16
article.articleSummary: Spain agreed to accept the Dutch cruise ship Hondius, currently anchored off Cape Verde due to a hantavirus outbreak, and relocate it to the Canary Islands for medical screening and humanitarian handling. The ship is expected to reach the Canary Islands within 3–4 days; upon arrival, all passengers and crew will undergo comprehensive medical checks and then return to their home countries. Seven hantavirus cases have been identified on board, with three deaths (including a Dutch couple and a German passenger); one British patient has already been transferred to a South African ICU. WHO officials warn there may be limited human-to-human transmission on the vessel. Two symptomatic crew members and the deceased German passenger will be transported from Cape Verde to the Netherlands by air ambulance; Cape Verde’s health authorities report stable patient conditions and will proceed with transfers when safe. The Chinese embassy states no Chinese citizens are aboard.

triage.headline_ja: スペインがハンタウイルス集団発生が発生した客船の受け入れに同意 16:16
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、ハンタウイルス感染症による死亡者を含む集団発生事例であり、国際的な対応が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスペイン、オランダ、ドイツ、イギリス、南アフリカ、カーボベルデが含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれるのはChina（中国国民乗船の確認と関連）のみ。ハンタウイルスは通常人間から人間への伝播が限定的であるが、本事例ではWHO警告として限定的なヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が指摘されている。船舶での7症例、3死亡（オランダ国籍2名、ドイツ国籍1名）という深刻な状況。国際的な医療対応と患者輸送が発生している。

article.articleHeadline: ไข้กาฬหลังแอ่นยังต้องจับตา ผู้ป่วยเพิ่มในหลายประเทศ ไทยพบตลอดทั้งปีและอัตราเสียชีวิตสูง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease remains under watch as cases rise in several countries; Thailand reports cases throughout the year with a high mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) remains under close watch as cases rise in several countries. Vietnam reports 24 cases and 4 deaths this year, with 46% of patients under 15, underscoring pediatric vulnerability. Thailand’s 2569 BE data show 5 cases and 3 deaths (60% case fatality), mainly in 0–4-year-olds, with deaths also occurring in 20–29 and 40–49-year-olds. The illness is a rapid acute bacterial infection causing meningitis and septicemia, transmitted via droplets and close contact, sometimes through shared items. Early symptoms mimic flu but can progress to sudden high fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, and occasionally petechial/purpuric or pink rashes. Without timely treatment, outcomes include brain damage, hearing loss, limb loss, sepsis, or death; about 1 in 5 survivors may have long-term disabilities. Prevention hinges on vaccination and strict hygiene; Vietnam reports proactive control measures, while Thailand maintains vigilant surveillance and targeted vaccination for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が継続して注視対象に−複数国で患者増加、タイは通年で発生し死亡率が高い
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での患者増加、高い死亡率（タイ60%、ベトナム16.7%）、小児への重大な影響、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、長期的な曝露リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎が複数国で増加していることを強調。ベトナムでは2026年に24例4死亡（死亡率16.7%）、46%が15歳以下。タイでは5例3死亡（死亡率60%）。ドロップレット感染、ヒト-ヒト感染の高いリスク、小児への顕著な影響、長期後遺症の可能性（聴覚喪失、脳損傷など）が記述されている。両国で監視と予防接種対策が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: After years, Ivory Coast confirms H5N1 outbreak near Ghana border
article.articleSummary: As of 6 May 2026, Ivory Coast has confirmed a new outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 in the Koun-Fao area near the Ghana border, affecting a commercial poultry farm and causing about 95,000 bird losses. The event, reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) in April, marks a re-emergence after major outbreaks in 2015–2016. The border proximity raises concerns about cross-border spread and underscores the need for strengthened farm-level biosecurity, early detection, and coordinated surveillance. The broader West Africa context shows Nigeria facing persistent avian influenza challenges since 2006, with co-circulation of multiple subtypes—H5N1, H5N8, H5N6—and the presence of low-pathogenic H9N2 in poultry and live markets. Enhanced market hygiene and regional coordination are needed to curb transmission and virus evolution.

triage.headline_ja: 数年ぶりにコートジボワールがガーナ国境付近でH5N1アウトブレイクを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。西アフリカ地域での高病原性H5N1の再出現は公衆衛生上の重大懸念であり、国境近接による地域的拡大リスク、複数亜型の共存が示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコートジボワール（Ivory Coast）でのH5N1アウトブレイク確認が主題だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証位置はガーナのみとした。西アフリカ地域全体での多亜型共存（H5N1、H5N8、H5N6、H9N2）、ナイジェリアでの持続的チャレンジ、生体市場での感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、地域的な公衆衛生上の脅威と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: 爆疫郵輪或現人際傳播　華使館稱船上無中國公民
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cruise-ship outbreak may indicate human-to-human transmission; Chinese embassy says there are no Chinese citizens on board.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak aboard the cruise ship Hondius, docking off Cape Verde in the Atlantic, involves hantavirus with suspected human-to-human transmission. As of May 6, 2026, the World Health Organization indicated possible person-to-person spread among close contacts aboard, such as spouses and cabin-mates, as the ship calls at multiple islands along Africa’s coast where rodent populations are common. Onboard approximately 150 passengers and crew, seven cases have been reported, including three deaths. Evacuation of affected travelers via Cape Verde ports is planned. The Chinese embassy in Cape Verde stated that there are no Chinese citizens on board. Maria Van Kerkhove of WHO said the transmission could occur among very close contacts. The infection source is thought to be rodents on visited islands, with the voyage raising concerns about human-to-human transmission on a cruise liner.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船の感染症流行で人人感染の可能性　中国大使館は船上に中国国民がいないと表示
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡3例、異常性：クルーズ船での疑わしい人人感染、国際拡大リスク：複数の島を訪問）。WPRO基準でも複数基準該当。社会的関心が高く、WHO声明あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに複数国・地域が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題は大西洋沖のクルーズ船(Hondius)がカーボベルデ沖に停泊しており、アフリカ沿岸の複数島を訪問。対象国リストに該当する国の名明記がない。中国大使館の言及はあるが、船上に中国国民がいないとの記述。記事の実発生地はカーボベルデ（対象国外）とアフリカ沿岸地域。ハンタウイルスの疑わしい人人感染は非常に異常であり、複数死亡例と150人程度の乗客乗員への暴露があることから高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: В США начали уголовное расследование за ввоз в США патогенов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A criminal investigation has been opened in the United States into the import of pathogens.
article.articleSummary: FBI has opened a criminal investigation into the import of dangerous pathogens by Vincent Münster, a virologist at the U.S. National Institutes of Health, who led bat coronavirus research at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana. Münster and colleague Claude Kwe Yinda were detained at an airport returning from Africa in early 2026; among samples found was monkeypox virus from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Both were removed from work and their contact details removed from the HHS staff directory. White Coat Waste alleges Münster conducted studies enabling infection of primates and bats with deadly agents, including Ebola, Nipah, and coronaviruses. Münster allegedly aided EcoHealth Alliance in obtaining funding from NIAID and Fauci for the Wuhan-related ‘Wuhan West’ bat-virus project led by Colorado State University; in 2016 he co-authored a proposal to establish a bat colony at California State University.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がウイルス学者による危険な病原体の米国への輸入に関して刑事捜査を開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事は米国内の研究機関における病原体輸入に関する刑事捜査であり、発生している感染症イベント（公衆衛生上の急性危機）ではなく、司法・行政問題である。対象国での実際の病原体流行やアウトブレイクの証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国から米国への病原体サンプル輸入に言及しているが、これは刑事捜査であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベント（実際のアウトブレイク、流行）ではない。米国内での拘留・捜査は行政的性質である。米国はスクリーニング対象国に含まれない。中国は武漢研究所関連プロジェクトの文脈でのみ登場し、実際の病原体イベントは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi logs highest dengue cases in April in five years: MCD
article.articleSummary: Delhi records 52 dengue cases in April—the highest for the month in five years—raising the four-month 2026 total to 107 dengue cases in the national capital, per MCD data. Malaria shows 29 cases in January–April 2026, with limited early-season spread and a potential monsoon surge anticipated. Delhi authorities have intensified anti-larval operations, fogging, and inspections at construction sites and residences. By May 2, 2026, over 12.15 lakh house visits were conducted, up from 11.99 lakh (2025) and 10.44 lakh (2024); 15,649 houses tested positive for mosquito breeding, nearly equal to 2025 (15,662). The civic body issued 16,261 legal notices and launched 1,712 prosecutions. Guppy-8 larvivorous fish interventions amounted to 358, costing over Rs 1.04 lakh, with fish surviving in 231 pots, reflecting ongoing vector-control efforts in Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: デリーが5年ぶりの最高デング熱患者数を4月に記録：MCD
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な増加は異常ではなく、死亡や重症例の記載がない。ただし5年ぶりの高発生であり、マラリアとの同時流行が懸念されるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: デング熱が5年間で最高の4月発症を記録し、当局が積極的な防病活動を実施中。しかし、致死性や重症例の報告がなく、IHR基準2件以上には至らない。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・流行易性・持続的曝露で該当するため、社会的・政治的関心の上昇とともにWATCH判定。モンスーン時期への懸念から動向監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan Picu Risiko Virus Hanta, Ini Langkah Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Rainy Season Triggers Hantavirus Risk: Here Are the Preventive Measures.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus risk rises in Jakarta, Indonesia, during the rainy season and floods as rats invade homes and food stores. Prevention centers on rodent control—closing rat access, storing food in sealed containers, and cleaning damp environments—to reduce exposure to droppings. Epidemiologist Dicky Budiman says rodent pest control is the core strategy to prevent hantavirus transmission, which can cause acute lung disease and rapid fatality. Flood conditions also heighten exposure risk and leptospirosis concerns, since rat urine can contaminate standing water. Protective measures include wearing boots during floods, avoiding contact with dirty water, masking and washing hands for cleaners, and using disinfectants before sweeping dusty areas. Although hantavirus transmission is rare, vigilance, hygiene, and early detection remain essential to prevent infections and serious outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季がハンタウイルスのリスクを引き起こす：予防対策はこれです
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジャカルタにおけるハンタウイルスおよびレプトスピラ症のリスク上昇が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数や死亡例の記載がなく、情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルスおよびレプトスピラ症の予防情報が主体で、具体的な患者発生件数や重症化事例の記載がない。流行しやすさの評価は、ネズミ媒介疾患の季節的リスク上昇および洪水による曝露環境の悪化に基づいている。疫学者の言及により社会的関心が確認される。管理可能性と重症度に関する詳細情報は不足しており、フルリスク評価まで段階を進める前に追加情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Listerie v oblíbených houbách: Prodávaly se i v Česku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Listeria in Popular Mushrooms: They Were Sold in the Czech Republic as Well.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 May 2026, the Czech SZPI warned about contaminated enoki mushrooms sold in the Czech Republic. Laboratory tests confirmed Listeria monocytogenes in two batches, G22029 and G22030, 100 g each, originating in China, packed in Malaysia and reaching the EU via the Netherlands. The products were distributed mainly through specialized Asian grocery stores; withdrawals were ordered, but some packages had already reached consumers. Consumers are advised not to eat the product and to return it to the point of sale. Listeriosis risk is highest for pregnant women, seniors, young children, and immunocompromised individuals, potentially requiring hospitalization. Enoki mushrooms are often only lightly heated (1–2 minutes) in Asian cuisine, which may not reliably kill the bacteria.

triage.headline_ja: リステリア菌が人気キノコから検出：チェコでも販売されていた
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌汚染キノコが複数国で流通・販売された国際的な食品安全事案。妊婦、高齢者、免疫不全者への重症化リスク、複数国での配送経路確認、公衆衛生当局による警告・回収措置が実施されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはマレーシア、チェコ、オランダが含まれているが、対象国リストではChinaのみ該当。記事の主要な流通経路はChina（原産地）→ Malaysia（梱包地）→ Netherlands（EU経由）→ Czechia（最終販売地）。チェコは対象国ではないため除外。本事案は国際的な食品汚染流通であり、複数国での影響があるため国際支援・通知の対象となるシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: বিলাসবহুল প্রমোদতরীতে ভাইরাসের বাসা! হান্টার হানায় বাড়ছে উদ্বেগ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus nest on a luxurious cruise ship! Concerns grow as hantavirus strikes.
article.articleSummary: Three passengers have died on the luxury cruise ship MV Hondias in the Atlantic due to hantavirus, raising alarms about a potential outbreak. Hantavirus is a rodent-borne RNA virus that can mutate and spread quickly; transmission occurs when humans come into contact with rodent urine, droppings, or saliva, or inhale virus-laden dust. Enclosed, crowded environments such as ship storage areas may foster spread. The World Health Organization has voiced concern as infections are reported in parts of South America and Asia, fueling fears of a COVID-like surge. Symptoms typically include fever, muscle pain, headache, fatigue, and vomiting; severe illness leads to hantavirus pulmonary syndrome with acute respiratory distress and lung failure. In India, reported cases have been rare but include Chennai (2005) and Mumbai (2016).

triage.headline_ja: 豪華客船上にウイルスの巣窟！ハンタウイルスの拡大で懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスによる複数死亡例、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOの懸念表明があり、IHR基準3項目（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。クルーズ船という限定空間での集団感染の危険性がある。
triage.notes: 記事のイベント発生地はMV Hondias（大西洋上のクルーズ船）であり、米国アイオワ州の記載も見られるが、サマリーの主題は南米とアジア（インド含む）での感染報告であり、ハンタウイルスはインド（チェンナイ2005、ムンバイ2016）での過去症例が言及されている。対象国リストではインドのみ該当。クルーズ船での死亡例3件、WHO の懸念表明、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（密閉環境での拡大リスク）がすべてWPRO基準に合致。

article.articleHeadline: "약도 백신도 없다" 호흡 멎더니 장기까지 파괴...'사람 간 감염 의심' 보고에 전 세계 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "There is no medicine, nor a vaccine"—breathing stops, and organs are destroyed... "suspected human-to-human transmission" report triggers global emergency.
article.articleSummary: Two hantavirus infections confirmed aboard MV Hondius, a cruise ship docked off Cape Verde in the Atlantic near the Canary Islands, with five suspected cases among seven total. Three deaths have occurred; one patient is in critical condition, others show mild symptoms. WHO is examining possible human-to-human transmission among close contacts aboard, noting the initial infection may predate the voyage. Two confirmed cases were evacuated; the ship, with 147 people from 23 nationalities (UK, Spain, US passengers; Filipino crew), continues toward the Canary Islands. The voyage ran from Ushuaia, Argentina to Cape Verde, with outbreaks occurring April 6–28. Symptoms include fever, gastrointestinal symptoms, rapid progression to pneumonia, ARDS, and shock. Worldwide risk is low, but monitoring continues; authorities are contacting passengers who were on the Saint Helena–Johannesburg route on April 25.

triage.headline_ja: 「薬も治療法もワクチンもない」呼吸が止まり、臓器まで破壊... 「人間同士の感染の可能性」報告で全世界が緊急対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）。複数国の乗客・乗員が関与し、人から人への感染の可能性が報告されている。死亡者3名、重症患者ありで重症度が高い。
triage.notes: 本件は対象国外（南アフリカ、アルゼンチン、スペイン、英国、米国、カーボベルデ）で発生した巡洋船内でのハンタウイルス集団感染事例。ただしフィリピン国籍の乗員が含まれており、対象国リスト上ではフィリピンのみ該当。WHO関与、複数国間の人的往来、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性指摘、死亡例ありで緊急性が高いため PICKUP としたが、実際の主要発生地は対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: 长期食用冰箱存货 病菌可能“上脑”
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Long-term consumption of refrigerated foods may allow pathogens to reach the brain
article.articleSummary: Elderly patient develops purulent meningitis caused by Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus after long-term ingestion of refrigerated foods. He was admitted around 5:00 a.m. with high fever (~39°C), neck stiffness, and limited speech; cranial MRI revealed bilateral frontal subdural fluid collections. Initial diagnoses included acute cerebrovascular disease and severe hypertension; he later experienced confusion, diarrhea, and urinary incontinence. Based on history and investigations, a diagnosis of purulent meningitis due to S. gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus was made, and he showed improvement with treatment. The bacterium is described as translocating from the gut into the bloodstream and then invading the brain. The report links exposure to fridge-stored foods—frozen meats and seafood kept for months or years, and expired dairy products—to potential infection sources. This is a single-case report; no outbreaks or imported/exported cases noted; highlights food storage safety to prevent bacteremia and meningitis.

triage.headline_ja: 長期の冷蔵食品摂取により病菌が脳に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、集団発生や国際的拡大のリスクなし。Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianusによる髄膜炎は既知の病原体による個別事例で、予想外性、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的懸念に該当しない。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、感染症の集団発生ではない。記事は個別事例に基づく食品安全啓発であり、シグナル認識の基準を満たさない。既知病原体による散発事例。

article.articleHeadline: Dinpanpertan Bangka perketat pengawasan kesehatan hewan kurban - ANTARA News Bangka Belitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka's Dinpanpertan Tightens Health Surveillance of Sacrificial Animals.
article.articleSummary: Dinpanpertan Kabupaten Bangka, in Bangka Belitung Islands Province, tightened health surveillance for sacrificial cattle and goats ahead of Idul Adha to ensure safe consumption. Sungailiat official Krisnaningsih said veterinary inspections, including mouth and hoof checks for foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), are conducted because the virus can spread and be fatal if untreated. Most sacrificial stock originate from outside Bangka—in Java, Lampung, and elsewhere—and despite pre-import health screening, re-inspection is required after weeks or months in farmers’ pens. If liver fluke infection is detected, a one-month recovery window applies. Dinpanpertan forecasts a 20% rise in demand in 2026 versus 2025, to about 1,144 cattle and 1,832 goats, aided by arisan group purchases organized by mosque committees. Farmers are urged to report any unhealthy animals immediately for examination.

triage.headline_ja: バンカのディンパンペルタン、犠牲動物の健康監視を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫の監視強化の報道であり、異常性と予想外性は低い。動物への影響が主であり、ヒト感染の具体的リスクは記事に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の焦点は動物への口蹄疫スクリーニングと管理であり、人的罹患やヒト-ヒト感染への言及はない。イードゥルアドハ前の定期的な監視強化活動として報道されているため、緊急性は低い。インドネシアの動物衛生当局による監視体制の確立が示唆されており、管理可能性に関する追加情報が必要。
