article.articleHeadline: Cum s-au infectat pasagerii de pe vasul Hondius cu hantavirus. Inclusiv medicul de la bord e în stare critică
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the passengers aboard the Hondius contracted hantavirus. Even the ship's doctor is in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths from hantavirus linked to the Hondius cruise ship, carrying about 150 passengers and crew, with mainly British, American, and Spanish nationals. The voyage, promoted as Antarctic nature exploration, visited the Antarctic Peninsula, South Georgia, and Tristan da Cunha. Victims: an elderly Dutch couple and a German citizen. The first Dutch passenger died April 11; his body was debarked at Saint Helena on April 24, with his wife repatriated and later dying on April 26 in Johannesburg after GI symptoms. WHO notes seven suspected cases under laboratory testing; a British patient in Johannesburg tested positive, and the Netherlands confirmed hantavirus in the Dutch woman. Likely infections occurred before boarding in Argentina, with exposure possibly during birdwatching on visited islands; onboard transmission possible but not confirmed. Spain allows docking at Canary Islands; the ship’s doctor, in critical condition, to be transported there for care. Hantavirus is rodent-borne and can cause HPS (pulmonary) or HFRS (renal), with global incidence cited as ~150,000 HFRS cases annually, mostly in Europe/Asia and many in China; US data show 890 cases from 1993–2023.

triage.headline_ja: ホンディウス船のハンタウイルス感染 船医も重篤状態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国の乗客が関与する国際クルーズ船での集団感染で、複数死亡例と確定診断あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから取得した多数の地域には、実際の感染発生地を反映していない候補が含まれている（Antarctica、Greater Antarctica、Canary Islands、Saint Helena等）。記事サマリーから実際に確認された感染者：オランダ人夫婦（1名死亡、1名ジョハネスバーグで死亡）、ドイツ国籍者（1名死亡）、英国患者（ジョハネスバーグで陽性確認）。乗客の多くが英国・米国・スペイン国籍だが、クルーズ船での感染であり発生国として特定できない。感染前の露出がアルゼンチンの可能性も指摘されているが、確定していない。対象国リストではChinaのみが該当し、記事内でハンタウイルス疾学における中国言及（年間HFRS症例多数）として参照されている。国際海上での感染イベントであり、複数国への医療対応の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Ambon imbau warga terapkan 3M antisipasi DBD akibat curah hujan meningkat - ANTARA News Ambon, Maluku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ambon Health Office urges residents to adopt 3M to prevent dengue fever as rainfall increases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, dengue fever risk rises in Ambon, Maluku, amid increasing rainfall. The Ambon City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Ambon) urges residents to adopt 3M: drain standing water, tightly cover water containers, and bury or recycle items that can hold rainwater to prevent Aedes mosquito breeding and dengue transmission. Residents should also use insect repellent and participate in community clean-ups; fogging is not routinely implemented, as it targets adults only and does not affect larvae. The note emphasizes post-flood vulnerability and the importance of household-level prevention. Historical data show 2021 dengue cases in Ambon reached 81 with 2 deaths through June, concentrated mainly in Sirimau (43), Nusaniwe (18), Baguala (11), Leitimur Selatan (6), and Teluk Ambon (3). In 2022 there were 20 cases; in 2023, 17. No current 2026 outbreak figures are provided.

triage.headline_ja: アンボン保健所、降雨量の増加に対応してデング熱予防のための3M実施を市民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（北スマトラ州、マルク州アンボン市）でのデング熱リスク上昇の予防啓発であり、異常・予想外の疾患発生ではなく、個別の重症症例・死亡報告も現在時点では提示されていない。ただしデング熱の季節的リスク上昇と市民啓発は継続監視の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発に焦点を当てており、現在のアウトブレイク数値は提供されていない。過去データ（2021年81例、2022年20例、2023年17例）は歴史的背景を示すが、2026年の具体的な症例数報告がないため重症度の評価は困難。降雨量増加に伴うAedes蚊媒介の感染リスク上昇は季節的・予想可能な現象であり、異常や予想外の事象ではない。ただし集団感染の可能性と継続的なベクター媒介感染リスクにより、WPRO基準で「prolonged_exposure」「epidemic_prone」に該当し、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Penemuan Kasus TB Nasional Capai 241 Ribu, Pemerintah Percepat Skrining Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National TB Case Finding Reaches 241,000; Government Accelerates Free Screening
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's national TB program reports TB case finding surpassed 241,000 as of May 3, 2026, with free screening expansion. Initiation of TB treatment is 84% of the 95% target; treatment success is 80% of the 90% target. To reach elimination, the government integrates screening with the Free Health Check (CKG) program and will strengthen detection at Puskesmas, adding Near Point of Care Testing (NPOCT) and X-ray facilities in the second half of this year. Desa Siaga TB: 6,484 villages across 117 districts, with a 30% target of ~70,000 villages to conduct screening, tracing, and treatment support. Program also includes preventive therapy, nutritious meals, and housing improvements in 8,000 high-burden homes. Indonesia remains among the world's TB burden nations; authorities optimistic integrated actions will reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 国家結核症例発見が241,000例に達成、政府は無料スクリーニングを加速
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核症例報告は継続的な公衆衛生上の関心事項であるが、本記事は既知の結核負担国における定期的なプログラム進捗報告であり、新規の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示すシグナルではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: インドネシアは世界的な結核負担国であり、継続的な監視の対象国である。本記事は治療開始率・治療成功率が目標値を下回っている状況を示しており、プログラム強化の政策的努力を記述している。異常な流行拡大やアウトブレイクを示す直接的なシグナルではないが、結核制御プログラムの進捗を追跡する価値があるため、WAL判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Uốn ván, hiểm họa từ những vết thương nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tetanus: The danger from minor wounds.
article.articleSummary: 53-year-old man from Ninh Bình presented with severe generalized tetanus after two small wounds on the left hand and thumb incurred at a chicken coop, a high-risk environment for contamination with poultry manure and mud. He had not been vaccinated against tetanus in the past decade and did not receive tetanus antitoxin before admission. About 24 hours before admission, he developed worsening trismus, with rigidity spreading to the neck, chest, and abdomen; mouth opening was about 0.5 cm on arrival. He received tetanus antitoxin, tetanus vaccine, antibiotics, and sedatives. Seven hours after admission, generalized hypertonia progressed with risk of respiratory failure; he was intubated and later underwent tracheostomy, now under intensive care in the ICU of the Infectious Disease Unit, 108 Central Military Hospital. Clinicians emphasize vaccination, timely wound care, and administration of tetanus immunoglobulin for dirty wounds, noting tetanus does not confer lasting immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 破傷風：小さな傷からの危険
triage.triage_reason: 単一の症例報告であり、IHR基準は満たさない。破傷風は予防可能な疾患であり、公衆衛生上の異常性、国際的拡大リスク、流行性は低い。臨床教育的記事と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一症例のケーススタディであり、破傷風の臨床管理と予防啓発を目的とした医療専門誌の記事と見られる。重症度は高いが、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Lo ngại virus lở mồm long móng SAT1: Đề xuất nhập khẩu vaccine khẩn cấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease virus: proposal for emergency vaccine import.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a transboundary infection caused by a Picornaviridae Aphthovirus with seven serotypes (O, A, C, Asia1, SAT1, SAT2, SAT3). Vietnam has historically detected serotypes O, A, and Asia1; SAT1 has not been reported domestically but is spreading from Africa to the Middle East and Western Asia, with China reporting SAT1 outbreaks in Gansu and Xinjiang in early April 2026, signaling proximity to Southeast Asia. Vietnam’s extensive livestock sector—about 31.4 million pigs, 6.14 million cattle, 1.95 million buffalo, and over 3 million goats/sheep—faces elevated exposure risk due to long borders and cross-border animal movements. Current Vietnamese vaccines cover O, A, Asia1 only; SAT1 vaccines exist globally (e.g., Biogénesis Bagó, DOLLVET, Boehringer Ingelheim, Biopharma, KEVEVAPI, BVI) but are not common in Southeast Asia, with variable protection against field strains. The Ministry proposes importing SAT1 vaccines not yet licensed domestically for emergency use, subject to quality testing, funded by farming enterprises, to bolster proactive immunity and prevent widespread outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: SAT1型口蹄疫ウイルスへの懸念：緊急ワクチン輸入を提案
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1型の越境感染脅威が中国で既に確認され、ベトナムの隣接地域に急速に接近している。ベトナムは大規模な畜産業（豚3,140万頭等）を有し、SAT1ワクチンの緊急輸入提案により政府レベルの対応が既に開始されている。IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、WPRO基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: SAT1型口蹄疫は2026年4月初旬に中国甘粛省・新疆地域で報告され、アフリカから中東・西アジアを経由して急速に拡大。ベトナムは現在O、A、Asia1型ワクチンのみで対応しており、SAT1型は国内未報告だが隣接リスクが極めて高い。畜産業の規模（豚牛水牛等3,100万頭以上）と越境動物移動により、越境感染の可能性が極めて高い。ベトナム政府が既にSAT1ワクチンの緊急輸入を提案しており、公式対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Human-to-human hantavirus transmission rare
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak on luxury cruise ship M/V Hondius off West Africa has resulted in three deaths and several illnesses among nearly 150 passengers and crew. About 38 crew members are from the Philippines. Hantavirus is rodent-borne and is not airborne like Covid-19; transmission requires prolonged close contact, typically via contact with infected rodents’ urine, droppings, or saliva. The World Health Organization has not issued travel restrictions for hantavirus. Philippine health official Domingo said there is no WHO advisory for travel bans, and no need for restrictions, while noting the Bureau of Quarantine remains prepared. He emphasized the outbreak appears very isolated to the ship, and containment is maintained as long as passengers and crew do not disembark. The situation is being monitored, with cases confined on board.

triage.headline_ja: DOH: ハンタウイルスのヒト-ヒト感染は稀である
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの集団発生（3人の死亡含む）が報告されており重症度基準に該当するが、発生地点が船舶上で孤立しており、フィリピンは乗組員の派遣国に過ぎない。実際の主たる発生地はアフリカ沖洋上であり、対象国内での発生ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーを精読すると、実際のハンタウイルス発生地点は西アフリカ沖の豪華クルーズ船M/V Hondiusであり、対象国外での発生。フィリピンは乗組員約38人の派遣国として言及されているのみ。Bluedot APIの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー上はアンゴラでの発生とは明示されていないため、verified_locationsにはフィリピンのみを含める。IHR基準2つ以上該当するが、地理的な検証と情報の明確性から、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: BKHIT Maluku gencarkan uji laboratorium hewan kurban deteksi dini PMK jelang Idul Adha - ANTARA News Ambon, Maluku
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maluku's BKHIT steps up laboratory testing of sacrificial animals for early detection of FMD ahead of Eid al-Adha - ANTARA News Ambon, Maluku
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) surveillance in Maluku, Indonesia, is intensified by BKHIT Maluku ahead of Eid al-Adha. In Ambon, 22 serum samples from cattle in Tual were tested using ELISA NSP to detect antibodies indicating prior exposure to FMD virus, enabling earlier containment. BKHIT Maluku also conducts physical examinations, health-document verification, and cross-region livestock movement monitoring to ensure sacrificial animals are healthy. FMD is a viral disease affecting cloven-hooved animals such as cattle, goats, and sheep; signs include fever, mouth and hoof blisters, and reduced appetite, with potential economic losses from decreased meat and milk production. Humans are not significantly at risk. The program emphasizes data-driven surveillance, rapid control measures, and farmer cooperation in reporting animal health concerns to quarantine officials.

triage.headline_ja: マルク州BKHITが犠牲動物の実験室検査を強化し、イード・アル・アドハ前のFMD早期検出に対応 - アンタラニュース・アンボン、マルク州
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマルク州で口蹄疫（FMD）の監視活動が進行中。動物への影響は明確だが、現時点では確定的な発生ではなく予防的・監視活動段階であり、情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は口蹄疫の実際の発生報告ではなく、イード・アル・アドハ（犠牲祭）に先立つ予防的監視活動と検査プログラムを記述している。ELISAテストが実施されているが、陽性結果や新規感染の報告は明記されていない。人畜共通感染は低いとされている。ただし、FMDは畜産への潜在的脅威であり、地域での継続的な監視が重要なため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: La historia del hantavirus a través de sus brotes más importantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The History of Hantavirus Through Its Most Significant Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Two hantavirus syndromes predominate: HFRS, affecting kidneys in Europe and Asia, and HPS, affecting lungs in the Americas. Major events include: the 1951 Korean hemorrhagic fever outbreak among UN soldiers (>3,000 cases; renal failure with internal bleeding); 1978 isolation of Hantaan virus in Korea; 1993 Four Corners outbreak in NM/AZ/CO/UT that established Andes virus and person-to-person transmission; the Yosemite, California, Curry Village outbreak (10 cases, 3 deaths; 30% fatality) which led the CDC to trace more than 10,000 visitors and to overhaul cabin design and cleaning protocols to prevent aerosolization from rodent droppings. Epuyén, Argentina, 2018: 34 confirmed cases, 11 deaths, with selective isolation of contacts; R0 exceeded 2.1 pre-control and events of superpropagation. China bears the largest burden with 10,000–15,000 annual HFRS cases; Bavaria and parts of Scandinavia show periodic spikes tied to field mouse populations.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの歴史：重要なアウトブレイクを通じて
triage.triage_reason: 記事は過去のハンタウイルス流行の歴史的レビュー・解説記事であり、新規イベント報告ではない。現在進行中の感染症危機を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のハンタウイルス流行（1951年朝鮮半島、1993年Four Corners、2018年アルゼンチン等）の歴史的総説であり、新規アウトブレイク情報ではない。記事サマリーで中国が現在も最大の負担（年間10,000～15,000例のHFRS）を持つことが述べられているため、中国を verified_locations に含めた。ただしこれは背景情報であり、新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Como chegou o hantavírus ao cruzeiro? Argentina investiga origem do surto que já fez 32 mortes num ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How did hantavirus reach the cruise ship? Argentina investigates the origin of the outbreak that has already killed 32 people in a year.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus is being investigated after the cruise MV Hondius developed a cluster of severe respiratory illness at sea, with docking planned in the Canary Islands after leaving Ushuaia, Argentina on 1 April for the South Atlantic. As of 2 May, seven cases have been identified (two lab-confirmed, five suspected), including three deaths; one patient critical. The World Health Organization says hantavirus incubation can range from one to six weeks, supporting infection before the voyage, possibly in Ushuaia. Argentina is monitoring cases and reviewing passenger histories; tests are underway at South Africa’s National Reference Laboratory to identify the strain and origin. Tierra del Fuego and Santa Cruz report no hantavirus cases recently. Argentina has 41 cases this year, 101 since June last year, with 32 deaths (31.7% fatality). The Andes variant may transmit human-to-human in rare circumstances; rodent exposure aboard the ship is considered unlikely.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスはいかにして客船に到達したのか？アルゼンチンが1年で32人の死者を出した患者集団発生の起源を調査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たし（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、客船での集団発生という異常事象と高い死亡率（31.7%）が確認されているため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は客船MV Hondiusでのハンタウイルス集団発生について扱っており、アルゼンチン（Ushuaia、Tierra del Fuego出発）とスペイン（Canary Islands寄港）が主な発生地点である。しかし対象国リストではフィリピンのみが記事中に言及されている地域に含まれる（Calabarzon地域が記事で特定される可能性）。記事サマリーでは実際の感染場所がアルゼンチン沖およびスペイン領域であり、対象国外での発生が主である。この点を鑑みて、verified_locationsはフィリピンのみとしたが、実質的には対象国外での事象である。高い死亡率（31.7%）、未確認の感染源、国際航海での感染拡大リスク、およびWHO関与の記載からピックアップ相当と判定。

article.articleHeadline: From Mild Fever to ICU: The Rapid Progression of Deadly Hantavirus Explained
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus, a rodent-borne disease, can progress from mild fever to a life-threatening condition within days, with rapid progression and high mortality when not treated promptly. The article notes worldwide attention and emphasizes understanding how the infection develops and recognizing early warning signs. There are no cases currently reported in India, but awareness is urged to be prepared and to recognize illness early. The discussion highlights the potential for escalation to ICU-level illness as symptoms worsen, underscoring the need for timely medical attention even where hantavirus is not actively reported. The piece serves as a precaution for public and healthcare providers in regions without current cases. Published May 6, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 軽い発熱からICUへ：致命的なハンタウイルスの急速な進行メカニズムの解説
triage.triage_reason: インドでのハンタウイルス確定症例は報告されておらず、記事は一般的な啓発・教育記事である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は現在インドでのハンタウイルス症例がないことを明記している。内容は疾病啓発・予防知識の普及を目的とした教育的記事であり、具体的な感染症イベントの報告ではない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Mengapa Hantavirus Menyebar di Kapal Pesiar?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Hantavirus spreading on cruise ships?
article.articleSummary: On May 4, 2026, the international cruise MV Hondius was quarantined off Praia, Cape Verde, after multiple passengers died from suspected hantavirus infection. By May 5, three deaths were confirmed (two Dutch, one German) with several others in critical condition; evacuation and docking decisions were being weighed. The World Health Organization dispatched a health team; Cape Verde authorities refused to let the ship dock to protect residents. Evacuation options include potential landing in the Canary Islands, Spain, with Dutch authorities (RIVM) coordinating. The Oceanwide Expeditions vessel had sailed from Argentina in March 2026; a Dutch passenger died April 11, his wife died after disembarking at St Helena, a British passenger was evacuated to South Africa in critical condition, and a German passenger died on May 2. Transmission is believed to be via rodent excreta or secretions; human-to-human spread is rare. CDC notes hantavirus can cause HPS and related syndromes, with high mortality and no specific treatment or vaccine, only supportive care. WHO characterizes this as an isolated incident, not a global outbreak, though hantavirus has a wide distribution worldwide, including Indonesia, with at least eight cases noted in context.

triage.headline_ja: なぜハンタウイルスが客船で拡大しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響：複数死亡者、異常な状況：客船での集団発症、国際的拡大リスク：複数国での症例・避難）、スクリーニング基準4つ（重症度：死亡者複数・致死率高い、流行しやすさ：密閉環境での感染、管理可能性：複数国の当局介入、異常：国際客船での大規模感染）に該当し、高度な社会的・国際的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで複数の地理的な言及があるが、実際のハンタウイルス感染イベントの発生地は客船MV Hondius（カボベルデ沖で検疫）であり、記事本文に「インドネシアを含む世界中での分布」と記載されている。対象国リストではインドネシアのみ該当。カナリア諸島はスペイン領（対象国外）、カボベルデ（対象国外）、南アフリカ（対象国外）、アルゼンチン（対象国外）。複数死亡者、高致死率（HPS：平均40%超）、治療法なし、WHOの対応による国際的重症度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ako ste kupili ove gljive - ne jedite ih: Povučene su zbog patogenih bakterija
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you bought these mushrooms, do not eat them: They have been recalled due to pathogenic bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Series G22030 mushrooms, barcode 6936489101348, recalled in Croatia after confirmation of Listeria monocytogenes. The product arrived in Croatia via Dutch supplier Asia Express Food of Kampen and was distributed on the domestic market by Zagreb-based Gorkhas and Associates d.o.o.; origin of the mushrooms is China. Listeria infection, listeriosis, can cause serious illness, particularly in the elderly, pregnant individuals, newborns, and immunocompromised patients. The bacteria can survive and multiply at low temperatures, including in refrigerators. Contamination is commonly linked to consumption of contaminated foods, including raw or undercooked items, ready-to-eat chilled dishes, delicatessen products, dairy products, and vegetables. The recall aims to prevent exposure; the article does not report any confirmed cases. Consumers who bought the product should not eat it and should follow recall instructions from authorities.

triage.headline_ja: これらのキノコを購入した場合は食べないでください：病原性細菌のため回収されました
triage.triage_reason: リステリア汚染が確認された食品リコール事案であり、異常性と長期曝露の可能性はあるが、現時点で確認患者がなく、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクの評価には情報不足。社会的関心は限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはCroatia、Netherlands、Chinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの分析によると：（1）イベント主題の感染症（リステリア汚染食品）の発生地はクロアチア（ザグレブ）、（2）オランダは流通経路（サプライヤー所在地）、（3）中国は原産国として言及されている。指定対象国リスト（Zambia、Philippines、Thailand、Ghana、DRC、Brazil、Indonesia、China、Myanmar、Vietnam、India）に照らすと、該当地域はない。Croatiaは対象国リストに含まれず、ChinaはGeoNames ID 1814991で対象国であるが、記事の主題はクロアチアでのリコール事案であり、中国での発生ではない。したがってverified_locationsは空とする。患者確認なしの食品リコール事案であり、PICKUP基準（IHR2つ以上またはスクリーニング1つ以上かつ社会的関心）は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Confirman que la cepa detectada en el crucero aislado por Hantavirus es la Andes, la única variante transmisible entre humanos - LA GACETA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They confirm that the strain detected on the cruise ship quarantined due to hantavirus is the Andes strain, the only human-transmissible variant.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak aboard the luxury cruise MV Hondius near Cape Verde is now linked to the Andes strain, the only hantavirus variant with documented human-to-human transmission. Sequencing of a passenger sample at the Geneva-based Centre for Emerging Viral Diseases at Geneva University Hospitals (HUG) confirmed Andes in this case. Among 38 known hantavirus variants, Andes is the sole one capable of person-to-person spread; other strains transmit mainly via contact with infected rodent excreta or inhalation of contaminated particles. Andes has historically been reported in Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking countries—Argentina, Chile, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay—where human transmission chains have occurred. Early symptoms mimic influenza: fever, chills, and muscle pains, potentially progressing to severe respiratory failure and renal or cardio-respiratory collapse. With no vaccine or proven antiviral, public health measures focus on isolating affected individuals and identifying close contacts, heightening scrutiny of the quarantined ship off Cabo Verde.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船で検出されたハンタウイルスはアンデス株と確認、ヒト−ヒト感染可能な唯一の変異株
triage.triage_reason: アンデス株ハンタウイルスの確認により、38種のうちヒト−ヒト感染可能な唯一の変異株による国際的クルーズ船での集団発生である。重症度（呼吸不全、臓器障害）、ヒト−ヒト感染の流行性、対象国（ブラジル）での確認、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬の欠如により、IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケープベルデ沖のクルーズ船での発生、ジュネーブ大学病院での遺伝子解析確認、アルゼンチン・チリ・ボリビア・ブラジル・パラグアイ・ウルグアイでの歴史的ヒト伝播事例を述べているが、対象国リストではブラジルのみ該当。クルーズ船という国際的移動リスク、アンデス株の特異性（38種中唯一のヒト−ヒト感染株）、重症度（呼吸不全、腎障害、心肺虚脱）、治療法の欠如により高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: İsviçre'de hantavirüs hastası bir kişi izole edildi - Diken
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Switzerland, a hantavirus patient was isolated.
article.articleSummary: Switzerland’s Federal Office of Public Health (FOPH) reports a hantavirus patient isolated at Zurich University Hospital. The infection traces to the MV Hondius cruise from Argentina to Cape Verde, where one passenger tested positive; symptoms began after returning from America in late April, with spouse under observation. HUG laboratory confirmed Andes virus, South American variant; the risk to Switzerland’s ~9 million people is low, with a maximum of six hantavirus cases annually and most infections acquired abroad. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne and usually transmitted by inhalation of dried excreta; worldwide infections are estimated at 10,000–100,000 annually, with Asia and Europe most affected; China and South Korea report thousands of hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. Seven hantavirus cases were identified on MV Hondius, with three fatalities (two Dutch, one German). The WHO warned that rare human-to-human transmission is possible after deaths on an Atlantic cruise; some experts think ship deaths occurred pre-boarding.

triage.headline_ja: スイスでハンタウイルス患者1人が隔離される
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は重篤な出血熱ですが、本件は単一症例で対象国内での発生なし。情報不足により続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にスイスの単一症例について報じており、スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。一方、記事内で中国と韓国の大規模なハンタウイルス感染があることが記載されているが、本イベント記事の主題は南米発生の船舶関連事案であり、中国での発生は背景情報扱い。IHR基準3つ以上該当およびWPRO基準2つ以上該当するが、対象国内での実際の発生地がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus vs Coronavirus: हंता या कोरोना... कौन सा वायरस हैं ज्यादा जानलेवा? जानें एक्सपर्ट्स की राय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus vs Coronavirus: Hanta or Corona... Which virus is more deadly? Find out what experts say.
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, the article contrasts Hantavirus with Coronavirus. Hantavirus is rare but potentially deadly and is primarily transmitted to humans via rodents, through contact with droppings, urine, saliva, or inhalation of contaminated aerosols in poorly cleaned, enclosed spaces; human-to-human spread is rare. Coronavirus spreads mainly between people and caused a global pandemic due to rapid transmission, though it is less deadly. Early hantavirus symptoms resemble flu—fever, fatigue, body aches—but progression can cause breathing difficulties, pulmonary edema, and kidney problems. In India, no major hantavirus threat exists; cases are very few and often hard to distinguish from other illnesses. Prevention emphasizes cleanliness, rodent avoidance, and careful cleaning of dirty or enclosed areas; COVID-19 precautions include handwashing, masks, and avoiding crowds.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス対コロナウイルス：ハンタか新型コロナか...どのウイルスが最も致命的か？専門家の意見を確認する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドにおけるハンタウイルスとCOVID-19の比較解説であり、実際の流行イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、教育的・啓発的な内容である。インドでのハンタウイルス症例は「非常に少なく」、「他の疾患との区別が難しい」と記載され、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常な状況を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な病原体比較記事であり、実際のアウトブレイク報告ではない。インド国内でのハンタウイルス脅威が「存在しない」と明記されており、シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Meledak 3 Kali Lipat, Siklus Wabah Kini Makin Cepat dan Tak Terduga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases Surge Threefold; Outbreak Cycle Now Faster and More Unpredictable.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Indonesia, including Jakarta, have surged, with a threefold rise over the past two decades and outbreak cycles shortening to about three years or less, indicating year-round transmission rather than seasonality. 2024 dengue hospitalizations exceeded one million, imposing about Rp3 trillion in costs per BPJS Kesehatan. Early dengue symptoms—sudden high fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, nausea or vomiting—can rapidly progress to severe bleeding and shock. About 75% of cases occur in ages 5–44, while the largest share of deaths (≈41%) is among 5–14 year‑olds; adults, especially those with comorbidities, remain at substantial risk and frequently require hospitalization. Public health experts emphasize the unpredictable, fast‑changing nature of dengue, underscoring year‑round vulnerability and the need for vigilance in both pediatric and adult populations.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数が3倍に激増、流行サイクルが加速化して予測困難に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の急激な増加（3倍）、流行サイクルの短縮（3年以下）、年間を通じた伝播、100万人以上の入院患者と甚大な経済負担（約3兆ルピア）が報告されており、IHR基準での深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性、WPROスクリーニング基準での重症度・流行適応性・管理可能性が複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年の100万人以上の入院と甚大な経済負担（Rp3兆）を強調しており、デング熱が単なる季節性疾患ではなく年間を通じて伝播する深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威となっていることを示唆している。5～14歳での死亡率が最大（約41%）であることも注目すべき。流行サイクルの予測困難性の増加は国家レベルでの管理困難性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Buriti une Saúde e Educação em grande mobilização contra a Dengue - Voz do Bico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buriti unites Health and Education in a major mobilization against dengue fever - Voz do Bico
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-06, Buriti do Tocantins, Brazil, conducted a dengue prevention mobilization led by the Municipal Health Secretariat in partnership with the local school network. The campaign engaged students and teachers alongside health teams to educate residents on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites. No dengue cases or deaths are reported in the article; the emphasis is on prevention and community engagement. Informational materials were distributed, with guidance on the dangers of dengue and practical steps to prevent mosquito proliferation. Students act as multipliers, bringing classroom lessons to households. Key measures highlighted: remove containers that collect standing water, maintain yards, and keep water tanks properly sealed. The initiative underscores school–community–government collaboration as the main asset in sustaining dengue protection.

triage.headline_ja: ブリティがデング熱対策に向けて保健と教育を一体化した大規模動員活動を展開 - ボズ・ド・ビコ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルのデング熱予防キャンペーンについて述べているが、確定または疑い患者の報告がなく、実際の感染症発生イベントではなく予防啓発活動である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中の感染症イベントではなく、ブラジル・トカンチンス州ブリティにおける定期的なデング熱予防キャンペーンの報告である。患者数、死亡者数、または新規確認例の報告がないため、シグナルとしてはピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: KLB Campak di Kabupaten Cirebon Dinkes Gelar ORI di Kecamatan Ciwaringin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Outbreak in Cirebon Regency: Health Office Holds Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) in Ciwaringin District
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in Cirebon Regency, Indonesia, prompted the health office to launch Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) in Ciwaringin District on May 6, 2026. About 2,400 children aged 9–59 months across 52 posyandu are targeted, aiming for at least 95% coverage to establish herd immunity. ORI runs through May 13, 2026, with door-to-door visits for those not attending posyandu and mobile announcements by ambulances in local dialect. The KLB (outbreak) designation spans four sub-districts — Mundu, Sumber, Greged, Ciwaringin — with 119 suspected cases and 23 lab-confirmed positives; Ciwaringin reports nine suspected and three confirmed. This is the district’s first measles outbreak this year. Authorities stress measles risks to young children and immunization as the key prevention.

triage.headline_ja: チレボン県麻疹アウトブレイク：チワリンギン郡でアウトブレイク対応予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の確定症例を含むアウトブレイク（119疑い例、23確定例）が発生しており、IHR基準で異常性と深刻性に該当。WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、流行しやすさが該当し、インドネシアはシグナル識別対象国。
triage.notes: 麻疹は高い伝播力を持つ急性感染症。119疑い例と23確定例が4つの郡に分布しており、特に9～59ヶ月の幼児が対象となっている点で重症度懸念あり。当局が集団免疫確立目標（95%カバレッジ）を掲げた積極的な予防接種キャンペーン（ORI）を実施していることは管理側の対応が機能していることを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Giải pháp nào kiểm soát dịch bệnh tôm trong điều kiện mới?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What solutions are there to control shrimp disease under new conditions?
article.articleSummary: May 6, 2026 update from Vietnam on shrimp disease control under changing conditions. At a sector event, experts, scientists, and industry leaders identified major threats including acute hepatopancreatic necrosis disease (AHPND), White Spot Disease (WSD), and Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP), with climate-driven shifts in temperature, salinity, pH, and water quality increasing vulnerability and suppressing shrimp immunity. Viet-Uc Group’s Trinh Trung Phi emphasizes proactive risk management from broodstock selection to biosecurity and early disease detection. Water treatment moves beyond traditional chlorine to hybrid chemical processes, improving disinfection, removing organics and heavy metals, and cutting costs from 3,000–4,000 VND/m3 to 800–900 VND/m3. Seed quality is pivotal, accounting for about 40% of success; probiotics like Bacillus are central to biosafety, while high-dose probiotic regimens are recommended to suppress Vibrio, and antibiotic use should be guided by susceptibility testing to avoid resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい条件下でのエビ病制御のための解決策は何か？
triage.triage_reason: Vibrio属菌（ビブリオ症）に関する記事であるが、記事内容は養殖エビ産業における疾病管理・予防対策の一般的な専門家議論であり、感染症のアウトブレイク・発生状況の報告ではない。具体的な患者数、死亡例、急速な流行の兆候がなく、公衆衛生上の危機的状況を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナムの養殖エビ産業における疾病制御方法に関する産業セクター向けの専門家討論会の報道。AHPND、WSD、EHP、Vibrio等の既知の養殖疾患に対する予防・管理戦略（種苗選別、バイオセキュリティ、水処理、プロバイオティクス）の紹介であり、アウトブレイク検知信号ではない。
