article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus: l'évacuation des passagers du navire de croisière commencera lundi à partir des Canaries
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Evacuation of passengers from the cruise ship will begin Monday from the Canary Islands.
article.articleSummary: A hantavirus outbreak on the cruise ship MV Hondius, currently immobilized off Praia, Cape Verde, prompted Spain to plan evacuations from the Canary Islands. The Interior Ministry said evacuation of passengers will begin Monday, May 11, with all travelers remaining on board until repatriation flights arrive. The vessel, which departed Cape Verde on Wednesday, is expected to reach the Canaries by Saturday and may dock in Tenerife for onward transfer. Three deaths have occurred among those on board; the source and transmission mode, as well as the outbreak’s true scale, remain unclear. The ship carries 147 people (88 passengers, 59 crew) from 23 nationalities. Passenger nationalities include Britain (19), United States (17), Spain (13), and France (five). Crew are predominantly Filipino (38) and Ukrainian (5). The incident involves an imported/evacuation scenario with ongoing uncertainty about the outbreak’s dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：クルーズ船の乗客の避難はカナリア諸島から月曜日に開始される
triage.triage_reason: カナリア諸島（スペイン領）のクルーズ船でハンタウイルスアウトブレイクが発生し、3名の死亡が報告されている。複数国籍の147人が乗船しており、国際的な対応（避難・本国送還）が必要な状況であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される対象国は、乗船クルー構成に記載されるフィリピン籍38名のみ。イベントの主発生地はカナリア諸島（スペイン領）だが、対象国リストに該当なし。ハンタウイルスは高い致死率を持ち、クルーズ船という閉鎖環境での複数死亡は極めて異常。伝播経路・感染源が不明であり、乗船者の本国送還に伴う二次的な国際拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 台中廚餘之亂未解 民憂恐爆鼠患 - 生活 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taichung kitchen waste mess remains unresolved; residents fear a rodent infestation outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Taichung City, Taiwan faces an unresolved kitchen-waste crisis with large-capacity garbage bags at Dali and Wenshan landfills, raising fears of a rodent infestation and potential Hantavirus outbreak amid ongoing northern Taiwan cases. While Taipei and New Taipei are tightening anti-rodent measures, Taichung officials are criticized for inaction. Mayor Lu Shiow-yen vows strengthened environmental cleaning, noting improvements since a prior Hantavirus incident and promising ongoing prevention. Councilors Chen Shuhua and Chen Yurong urge a cross-agency task force and concrete rodent-control actions. The Environmental Protection Bureau says rodents will eat various foods, not only kitchen waste, and will bolster canal and environmental maintenance, supported by a 2.1 million budget to purchase 320,000 bait packs for district deployment. The issue is tied to post-African swine fever waste-management challenges and broader public-health vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 台中市の生ゴミ処理危機が未解決、ネズミ被害の流行を懸念 - 住民がハンタウイルス感染の危険を警告
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症への潜在的なリスク（ネズミ媒介）が記事の主要テーマであり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がある。ただし、実際の患者発生報告や深刻な公衆衛生影響は記事に明記されておらず、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は台中市（台湾）の生ゴミ危機とハンタウイルス感染症のリスクに焦点を当てている。実際の感染者数や死亡事例は明記されていない。北台湾でのハンタウイルス症例が言及されているが、詳細は不明。アフリカ豚熱（ASF）との関連も記述されているが、本記事の主要テーマはハンタウイルスとネズミ被害である。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないが、Bluedot APIが中国（1814991）を位置情報に含めており、台湾地域として China (Taiwan) として記録。

article.articleHeadline: 台中廚餘之亂未解 民憂恐爆鼠患 - 臺中市 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taichung's Kitchen Waste Chaos Unresolved; Public Fears Rat Infestation Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Taichung's kitchen waste chaos remains unresolved, fueling fears of a rat infestation outbreak. City councilors Chen Shu-Hua and Chen Yu-Rong criticized ongoing disposal failures, noting garbage space bags accumulating at Dali and Wenshan landfills and warning they create rat breeding grounds. With hantavirus infections recently reported in the Greater Taipei area and preventive actions in Kaohsiung and Tainan, officials call for a cross-agency response; Mayor Lu Shiow-yen pledged stronger environmental cleaning and vigilance to prevent hantavirus. Environmental Protection Bureau head Wu Shengzhong said waste collection is currently smooth and will bolster canal and environmental maintenance, including a 2.1 million budget to procure about 32,000 baiting sachets for district use. Critics urged a formal interdepartmental pest-control task force, while officials stressed comprehensive prevention beyond kitchen waste, referencing last year’s African swine fever context.

triage.headline_ja: 台中の台所ゴミ混乱が未解決、住民がネズミ患発生を懸念
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でハンタウイルス感染が報告されており、ゴミ処理の失敗がネズミ繁殖地を生み出す可能性が指摘されている。ただし、現在のところハンタウイルスの症例数や重症度に関する具体的情報がなく、ネズミ患の発生は懸念段階であるため。
triage.notes: 台湾はWHO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題が台中地域でのハンタウイルス感染懸念であり、verified_locationsは空配列とするべき。ただし、台湾は実際の発生地域のため、注記として中国管轄下の地域として記載。記事ではアフリカ豚コレラも言及されているが、これは昨年の状況参照であり現在のイベントではない。具体的な症例数や重症度情報の不足により情報レベルはWATCH段階に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Com baixa procura, Dourados cria unidade móvel de vacinação contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With low turnout, Dourados sets up a mobile vaccination unit against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Low turnout for chikungunya vaccination in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, with only 1,807 people vaccinated over seven days (1,607 urban, 200 in the Indigenous Reserve). To boost coverage among about 43,000 target residents, the city deployed a Mobile Vaccination Unit that visits neighborhoods with higher Aedes aegypti activity; a drive-thru on May 1, International Workers' Day, yielded 405 doses at the Municipal Administrative Center. The Emergency Operations Center notes demand remains well below expectations and urges the public to visit the nearest health unit. State health authorities will extend vaccination to Amambai, Batayporã, Douradina, and Sete Quedas, with 14,400 doses allocated across these four towns and initially reallocated from Dourados. The vaccine is a single-dose, for ages 18–59, and is contraindicated in pregnancy, puerperal, immunocompromised individuals, decompensated chronic disease, or severe allergic reactions.

triage.headline_ja: 低い接種率を受けて、ドゥラード市がチクングニア熱ワクチン接種の移動ユニットを設置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内でのチクングニア熱ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、異常性や重症度の証拠は限定的だが、ベクター媒介感染症の活動継続を示唆する信号として経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱に対する公的なワクチン接種活動と、ブラジル内複数都市への展開を報告している。これは流行が継続している（Aedes aegyptiの活動が続いている）ことを示唆するシグナルだが、新規発症数や重症例の報告がないため、現段階ではWATCHレベルの判定とした。続報で病例数の増加、重症例、または地域外への拡大が報告される場合はPICKUPへの昇格を検討する。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe: Campinas confirma duas novas mortes; vítimas não estavam vacinadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu: Campinas confirms two more deaths; the victims were not vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, reports two new deaths from influenza-associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), bringing 2026 fatalities to five. The deceased are a 93-year-old man and an 80-year-old woman with preexisting conditions who were not vaccinated this year; they died April 11 and April 14. The city has recorded 65 influenza-linked SRAG cases in 2026. The vaccination campaign, started March 28, has administered 134,713 doses to priority groups, but childhood coverage remains only 14.16%. In 2025, Campinas logged 552 SRAG cases and 67 deaths, with 53 deaths among the unvaccinated. Of 14 vaccinated individuals who became ill, 12 were within the 15-day protection window and 2 showed symptoms earlier. About 66 victims had preexisting conditions. School-based vaccination began April 4 for children 6 months to under 6 years, targeting ~70 units through May 31; vaccines are available at Health Centers, except Centro Health Center, which vaccinates at Divino Salvador Parish (Av. Júlio de Mesquita, 126, 8–16h).

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：カンピーナス市が2人の新たな死亡を確認、被害者はワクチン接種を受けていなかった
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なインフルエンザ関連死亡の報告であり、予防接種状況との関連が指摘されている。ただし国際的拡大の兆候や公衆衛生上の重大な異常性は不明確であり、情報の詳細確認が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・カンピーナス市におけるインフルエンザ関連死亡報告。2026年に5例の死亡確認、うち2例は未接種者。地域的な死亡症例の発生であるが、季節性インフルエンザとしては予想内の発生である。ワクチンカバレッジ情報が提供されており、公衆衛生対応は実施中。IHR基準は1つのみ該当、WPROスクリーニングは2つ該当するため、社会的関心と合わせてWATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Man from China guilty in Fresno, Reedley COVID-19 scheme: DOJ
article.articleSummary: 64-year-old Jia Bei Zhu from China was found guilty after a Fresno County trial of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, eight counts of wire fraud, two counts distributing adulterated and misbranded medical devices, and one count making a false statement to the FDA, tied to an illegal biolab in Reedley that sold more than a million COVID-19 tests via Universal Meditech Inc. (UMI). Tests were marketed as legitimate, FDA-authorized, USA-made, and tied to a lab, but were faulty, missing parts, and could not detect COVID. The scheme ran August 2020 to March 2023 and emerged in mid-2022 civil litigation; UMI moved to Reedley and renamed Prestige Biotech Inc. (PBI). Zhu previously worked at IND in Canada, fled to the U.S., and used aliases; he claimed to be Qiang "David" He in 2023. Sentencing is set for August 24, 2026; maximum penalties total 191 years. Wang is a fugitive in China.

triage.headline_ja: カリフォルニア州フレスノのCOVID-19詐欺事件で中国人男性が有罪判決を受ける：司法省
triage.triage_reason: 本事件は違法な医療機器販売詐欺の刑事事件であり、感染症の新規発生や流行ではない。過去に発生した医療詐欺への法的判決であり、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にChina (1814991)を含めているが、記事の主題は過去のCOVID-19テスト詐欺事件の刑事判決であり、中国での感染症発生イベントではない。感染症イベント監視対象外の刑事裁判事例のため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: VÍDEO: capitão anuncia morte em navio com surto de hantavírus | G1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO: captain announces death on ship with a hantavirus outbreak | G1.
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, three people have died aboard the luxury cruise MV Hondius amid a hantavirus outbreak confirmed by the WHO. The ship departed Ushuaia, Argentina, bound for Cape Verde. A April 12 video shows captain Jan Dobrogowski announcing the death of a Dutch passenger, with officials noting the illness on board was not infectious. The Dutch man’s body left the ship on April 24 at Santa Helena for repatriation, and his wife died two days later after testing positive for hantavirus. A German passenger died on May 2 with the cause not identified. Two other passengers tested positive: a British national in serious condition in South Africa and another hospitalized in Zurich. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne and can cause respiratory and cardiac problems. The ship was anchored near Praia, Cape Verde; Spain plans to repatriate foreign travelers after May 11, with 14 Spaniards to Madrid for quarantine, while Tenerife seeks to bar docking.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：ハンタウイルス感染症の流行が発生している船上で船長が死亡を発表 | G1
triage.triage_reason: 国際クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生で複数死亡、WHOが確認。複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスク、異常性が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、クルーズ船MV Hondiusはウスアイア（アルゼンチン出発）からカボベルデに向かう航程で、ブラジル（サンタ・ヘレナ）で故人を下船。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれる唯一の実発生国。スペイン・スイス・南アフリカは症例発生地だが対象国外のため除外。船舶集団感染で複数国への二次拡大リスク（スペインでの隔離予定、スイス・南アフリカでの症例）が極めて高く、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda o surto de hantavírus em cruzeiro e o alerta da OMS ao Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship and the WHO alert for Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths and at least eight related cases (three confirmed, five suspected) from a hantavirus outbreak aboard the expedition ship MV Hondius, as of 6 May 2026. The Andes hantavirus variant involved has rare but documented human-to-human transmission. The ship, carrying 174 people, departed Ushuaia on 1 April for Antarctica and South Atlantic islands. Illnesses emerged mid-cruise: a 70-year-old Dutch man died 11 April; his 69-year-old wife died in a South African hospital on return; a 69-year-old German passenger died onboard on 2 May; a 69-year-old British passenger was evacuated to Johannesburg with positive tests. The vessel was isolated near Cape Verde; Spain will transfer it to the Canary Islands for medical screening and repatriation. WHO deems general population risk low and there are no travel restrictions. Brazil is monitoring due to Andes circulation; diagnosis relies on lab confirmation; no vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生を理解し、ブラジルへのWHO警告
triage.triage_reason: 国際的に拡大したハンタウイルス集団発生（複数国の乗客・乗員が罹患）、稀な人間から人間への感染が記録された亜種、複数死亡例あり。IHR基準で少なくとも2項目以上該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはアルゼンチン、スペイン、南アフリカ、カーボベルデ、南極なども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は国際的なクルーズ船の集団発生であり、対象国の中ではブラジルのみが言及されている（「ブラジルが監視中」）。記事は複数国からの乗客が関与するが、クルーズ船は南極向け遠洋航海中の発生事例であり、特定国での集団発生ではない。ただし、WPROの対象国であるブラジルがWHO警告の対象国として明示されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: MG registra uma morte por meningite a cada 4 dias; infectologista explica sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais records a death from meningitis every four days; infectious-disease specialist explains symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, faces bacterial meningitis burden. In 2025 the state recorded 443 confirmed meningitis cases and 100 deaths; through May 2026 there were 91 confirmed cases and 22 deaths, with over one death per week and about 22 cases and five deaths per month. A Contagem child at Centro Materno Infantil had brain death confirmed on May 6, but SES-MG says the case is not yet notified. Belo Horizonte registered 28 meningitis cases in 2026 by May; 2025 saw 265 meningococcal disease cases in the capital. No statewide outbreak is reported. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, headache, vomiting, prostration, and neck stiffness; severe disease can involve the brain and lead to death. Treatment relies on antibiotics after diagnosis, with isolation. Vaccination—pneumococcal, meningococcal, Hib—remains the primary prevention strategy. A 2030 federal plan targets 50% fewer vaccine-preventable cases and 70% fewer deaths, with stronger immunization, surveillance, and diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州は毎日4日ごとに髄膜炎で1人死亡；感染症医が症状と予防策を説明
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州で継続的な細菌性髄膜炎の発生が報告されており、2025年に443例、2026年5月までに91例の確認症例と重大な死亡数（22死亡）が記録されている。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさが該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジルのミナスジェライス州における髄膜炎（特に髄膜球菌性髄膜炎）の実質的な疾病負荷を記載。ワクチン接種および診断強化を含む連邦計画（2030年目標）が存在することから、ブラジル当局の関心が高い。WHOへの通知要件を満たす可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Es peligroso el hantavirus? Los datos tras la alerta en el crucero de Tenerife - La Voz De Ibiza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is hantavirus dangerous? The data after the alert on the Tenerife cruise ship - The Voice of Ibiza
article.articleSummary: Three passenger deaths on the cruise ship MV Hondius in Tenerife triggered hantavirus surveillance in Spain. Authorities say community transmission risk in Spain remains very low, though the WHO alert prompts symptom monitoring. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral; management is supportive, with early detection crucial for survival. Treatment centers on ICU transfer and ventilatory support; antibiotics are not routinely used unless coinfection, and immunomodulators are not recommended. Transmission is not typically person-to-person; the Tenerife outbreak is attributed to confined spaces and prolonged close contact, with asymptomatic individuals not contagious. Puumala is the European strain most associated with roughly 1% mortality, while American variants can reach 30–50%. Spain has had no autochthonous cases 2019–2023; last imported in 2018 (Nepal, Vall d'Hebron). Global WHO estimates 10,000–100,000 infections annually, mainly in East Asia and Northern Europe; 2023 European cases <2,000 across 28 countries, mostly mild.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスは危険か？テネリフェ島のクルーズ船での警告後のデータ
triage.triage_reason: スペイン（対象国外）でのクルーズ船上の3人死亡事例だが、記事サマリーではスペイン国内のコミュニティ感染リスクは非常に低いと当局が述べている。対象国はシナでのみ発生の可能性があるが、サマリーではシナの感染例についての具体的記述がなく、情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にスペイン（対象国外）、ネパール（対象国外）が含まれているが、記事の主題は船内での出来事であり、対象国リストではシナのみが該当する。ただしサマリーではシナでの具体的な感染事例は明記されておらず、参考情報として地球規模での統計が記載されている。IHR基準は2つ以上該当だが、スペイン国内のコミュニティ感染リスク低という当局評価とシナでの具体的発生状況の不明確さから、WATCH段階での判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de hantavírus é possível? Entenda riscos da doença virar nova pandemia global - Ser Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is a hantavirus outbreak possible? Understand the risks of the disease becoming a new global pandemic - Ser Saúde.
article.articleSummary: Three crew members died from hantavirus aboard the MV Hondius cruise en route to Spain; three other crew members are ill, with confirmed cases stable. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says global risk is low and not comparable to COVID-19. Hantavirus (Hantaviridae) is rarely transmitted person-to-person; spread mainly via rodents and inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent urine, feces, or saliva. Risk factors include exposure in closed rural buildings, deforestation, grain milling/storage, and contact with wild rodents. The cruise departed Ushuaia, Argentina, on April 1, traversed South Atlantic regions (Antarctica, South Georgia, Tristan da Cunha, Saint Helena, Ascension) and is now isolated off Cabo Verde for investigation by Oceanwide Expeditions. In Brazil, hantavirus has about 1,300 cases and 540 deaths (2007–2024), concentrated in the South, Central-West, and Southeast. Early symptoms: back pain, headache, fever, GI; severe: dry cough, dyspnea, hypotension, pulmonary edema. Clinicians should note rural/wildlife exposure to avoid misdiagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの流行は可能か？この疾病が新たなグローバルパンデミックになるリスクを理解する
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスによる船舶での複数死亡事例（確認者5名、死亡者3名）と南米での既往症例数が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度と流行しやすさに該当。ただしWHOが「グローバルリスクは低い」と評価し、人間への感染拡大リスクは限定的なため、フルRRA前の経過観察判定。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが南米・南大洋関連地点（Tierra del Fuego、Ushuaia、Argentina等）を列挙したが、記事サマリーではハンタウイルス症例の詳細な流行データが提供されているのはブラジルのみ（1,300症例、540死亡、2007～2024年）。船舶（MV Hondius）はアルゼンチン出発だが、イベント主体はハンタウイルス感染症の地域的リスク評価であり、対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみが該当。WHOの低リスク評価と人間への限定的な感染伝播リスク（主にげっ歯類由来）を考慮し、WATCH判定。続報で症例数増加やヒト-ヒト感染の確認があればPICKUPへ昇格の可能性。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Egg supply to Surat halted after bird flu outbreak | Surat News
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Navapur, Nandurbar district, India prompted halt of egg shipments to Surat and South Gujarat after laboratory tests confirmed H1N1 infection in poultry samples. About 2.40 lakh chickens were culled within a one-kilometre radius of the affected farm, with surveillance intensified in a two-kilometre radius. Samples from Tapi district poultry farms were sent to Bhopal for testing. Navapur, which accounts for 27 of 38 poultry farms in Nandurbar, previously faced outbreaks in 2006 and 2021; the area supplies roughly 10 lakh eggs daily to Surat, now stopped. Traders report no immediate shortage in Surat as eggs are sourced from Kheda, Ajmer, and Hyderabad, with prices stable. Surat Municipal Corporation is monitoring the situation and will act per state directives; culling and testing initiatives indicate ongoing containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: スラット市への卵供給が鳥インフルエンザ発生後に停止
triage.triage_reason: インドで確認された鳥インフルエンザ（H1N1）の家禽感染事例であり、スクリーニング基準の重症度（大規模な殺処分）、流行しやすさ（家禽-ヒト感染リスク）、管理可能性（公衆衛生対応が進行中）が該当。社会的関心も高い（報道・取引への影響）。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザH1N1の家禽への感染であり、ヒト感染の具体的報告はサマリーに記載されていない。ただし、家禽での確認および大規模な防疫対応（24万羽の殺処分）、広域な流通停止（日10万個の卵供給停止）、過去の反復発生（2006年、2021年）から、IHR基準3項目以上とWPRO基準5項目全て該当。公式な検査・監視機構が機能しており管理可能性は高いが、シグナルとしてのピックアップ価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatite A dispara em Juiz de Fora e cidade já concentra 70% dos casos de Minas Gerais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A surges in Juiz de Fora, and the city already accounts for 70% of the state's cases
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, in Minas Gerais, Brazil, is facing a rapid hepatitis A surge in 2026, now accounting for about 70% of state cases with 729 confirmed infections, including 114 new diagnoses in eight days. The outbreak, up 1,925% from 2025 (36 cases), has surpassed the totals from the last decade, with transmission across multiple city regions, especially Central and South. A 60-year-old woman is under investigation for a potential hepatitis A death at Hospital e Maternidade Therezinha de Jesus. Vaccination has been expanded to: children 15 months to under 5 years who are unvaccinated; pregnant women; people with liver disease or immunosuppression; PrEP users; unvaccinated household contacts aged 11–39; and sexual contacts of infected individuals, regardless of age. Public health measures include intensified testing, distribution of sodium hypochlorite, sanitary inspections, and campaigns on hygiene, treated water, and safe food handling.

triage.headline_ja: ジュイス・ジ・フォーラでA型肝炎が急増、同都市がミナス・ジェライス州の症例の70%を占めるに至った
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。前年比1925%増加、過去10年間の累計を超える急速な集団発生、死亡例の可能性、複数地域への拡大が認められる。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナス・ジェライス州ジュイス・ジ・フォーラ市での急速なA型肝炎集団発生。2026年確認症例729件、前年比1925%増加、過去10年の累計超過。死亡例の可能性あり。ワクチン拡大接種、衛生検査、飲料水安全対策など公衆衛生対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa: ¿en qué países se han detectado contagios de hantavirus?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Map: In which countries have Hantavirus infections been detected?
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius, stranded off Cape Verde, triggered an international health response. With about 150 people aboard, cases quickly escalated to a health emergency, including at least three deaths and multiple critical patients. The World Health Organization coordinated a global assessment with several countries to analyze transmissions. Studies in South Africa and Switzerland identified Andes orthohantavirus, notable for sustained human-to-human transmission in close, prolonged contact—a rarity among hantaviruses. Hantaviruses are typically rodent-borne, reaching humans via inhalation of urine, saliva, or excreta; human-to-human transmission is uncommon. More than 80 genotypes exist; over 30 in the Americas, 11 officially recognized by ICTV. Notable American variants include Andes (Argentina, Chile), Laguna Negra (Paraguay, Bolivia), Juquitiba (Brazil). Europe/Asia variants Puumala and Hantaan cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome. The Hondius episode underscores how confinement, international travel, and close contact can alter transmission dynamics, informing isolation protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 地図：ハンタウイルス感染がどの国で検出されたか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。クルーズ船での集団発生、複数国での検出、WHOが調整する国際保健対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国でのハンタウイルス検出を言及しているが、実際の集団発生事象は「オランダのクルーズ船MV Hondiusでケープベルデ沖で発生」。記事の地理的参照（南アフリカ、スイス、アルゼンチン、チリ、パラグアイ、ボリビア）は主に疾患のジェノタイプ分布の説明であり、当該イベント発生地ではない。対象国リスト内では、Brazil（ジュキティバハンタウイルスの言及）のみ記事の実質的主題に関連。ケープベルデはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi notifies 12,078 TB cases in detection drive
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 12,078 tuberculosis (TB) cases detected in a screening drive under the Delhi National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) from March 24 to May 5, 2026. Of these, 1,323 are pediatric (11%), and 10,755 adults (89%); 6,360 male (52.6%), 5,715 female (47.3%), and 3 transgender. The drive screened 71,603 people (16.8% positivity) through 984 Ayushman Arogya Shivirs, including 224 camps in 38 high‑risk wards and 79 congregate settings. Diagnostic effort includes 64,764 chest X‑rays and 33,038 NAAT tests. Extrapulmonary TB comprises 5,073 cases (42%), among the highest shares nationally; EPTB involves organs other than the lungs and presents diagnostic challenges. Delhi’s overall TB burden remains the highest in India per the 2019–2021 prevalence survey (747 per 100,000; infection rate ~61%).

triage.headline_ja: デリーが検査推進で12,078件のTB症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 結核の大規模検出プログラムであるが、スクリーニング段階での検出であり急性かつ深刻な新規発生のシグナルとは言い難い。ただし、インド国内で最高の結核負荷を示す地域からの大規模なケースレポートであり、情報の追加確認が必要。
triage.notes: スクリーニング駆動型の検出増加であるため、既存患者の発見を主目的としており、新規感染の急速な拡大を示唆するものではない可能性が高い。デリーは既知の高TB負荷地域であり、この検出数は疾患対策プログラムの実施成果として解釈される可能性がある。肺外結核(EPTB)が42%と高比率である点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirose: o perigo silencioso trazido pelas chuvas e alagamentos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis: The Silent Danger Brought by Rain and Flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Pernambuco, Brazil: 28 confirmed cases and 6 deaths as of April 18, 2026, with 56 deaths in 2025 and 85 cases in the same period (67% higher). Transmission occurs via floodwater contaminated with rat urine, particularly during heavy rains that spread contamination across roofs, yards, and streets. Early symptoms mimic arboviruses; later stages feature calf pain, stiffness, and progressive renal and hepatic injury. Other floodwater–related infections include tetanus, hepatitis A, and diarrheal diseases. Protective measures include wearing impermeable boots and gloves in flooded areas, covering wounds with waterproof bandages, discarding food touched by floodwater, and washing exposed skin; seek health care if fever develops within 30 days of exposure. Emphasis on surveillance and public health messaging during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症：雨と洪水がもたらす静かな危険
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な増加傾向、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。ブラジルの対象国リストへの含有により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ペルナンブーコ州でレプトスピラ症の流行が進行中。2025年同期との比較で症例数67%増、死亡数も増加傾向。洪水による水系感染が主要な流行メカニズム。同時にテタヌス、A型肝炎、下痢症など複数の水系感染症が報告されている。季節性（雨季）の流行パターンは予測可能だが、被害規模の増加は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura vistoria mais 1.298 imóveis e identifica 11 focos de Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall inspects another 1,298 properties and identifies 11 foci of Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: On May 5, 2026, Dourados city health teams inspected 1,298 properties for Aedes aegypti, the vector of chikungunya, dengue, and Zika virus, identifying 11 mosquito foci. Of the sites, 177 were closed and owners notified to clean and facilitate access for control workers. The Emergency Health Operations Center (COE) coordinates daily actions. Authorities issued 51 notifications; 57 properties with water-holding deposits received chemical treatment. A further 100 notifications and 82 fines are planned. Inspections covered numerous districts, including Esplanada, Jardim Água Boa, Jardim São Pedro, Vila Adelina, Vila Toscana, Parque Rego D’água, Campo Dourado, Jardim Vista Alegre, Jardim Terra Roxa, and adjacent areas. A Leco vehicle sprayed 269 blocks across multiple neighborhoods. By May 5, 2026, 568 larvicidal stations (EDL traps) were received with 525 installed in areas such as Assentamento Santa Fé, Santa Felicidade, Jóque Clube, Vila Mariana, Parque das Nações, Terra Dourada, Jardim dos Estados, and Vila Cachoeirinha. Residents are urged to remove standing water; COE coordinator Marcio Figueiredo notes ongoing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 市庁舎がさらに1,298棟の物件を検査し、チクングニアの11の焦点を特定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部ドラードス市におけるチクングニア・デング・ジカウイルスの媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）対策の進行状況報告。個別の感染症の爆発や異常な増加は記述されておらず、通常の蚊媒介性疾患対策活動と判断される。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はドラードス市（ブラジル南部マットグロッソ・ド・スル州）における蚊媒介性疾患対策活動の進捗報告である。実際の感染症患者数や異常増加は記述されていない。ネッタイシマカは蚊媒介性疾患の一般的なベクターであり、その対策活動は当該地域では継続的に実施されている。より詳細な感染症患者データや異常な増加傾向の情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah Genjot Pengendalian TBC, Perbaiki 8.000 Rumah Pasien
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government steps up TB control, repairs 8,000 patients' homes.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) control in Indonesia progressed with integrated screening through the Free Health Check (CKG) program since early 2025, plus Near Point of Care (nPOC) tools and X-Ray at community health centers to bolster capacity. As of May 3, 2026, TB case finding exceeded 241,000, with treatment initiation at 84% of the national target (95%) and treatment success at 80% of the target (90%). To curb transmission and accelerate recovery, the government plans to repair 8,000 TB patients’ homes in high-burden areas in 2026, up from 300 homes per year (2020–2023); 5,453 homes have already been proposed via the SIBARU app. Across 23 provinces, 6,484 villages and sub-district TB-ready communities are strengthening prevention and response. Indonesia remains among the countries with the highest TB burden.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が結核対策を加速、患者8,000世帯の家屋を改修
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核制御プログラムの進捗に関する記事で、予防的な公衆衛生措置と対策の強化について報告しているが、新規アウトブレイク、急速な拡大、深刻な重症度の報告がないため、現時点ではWATCHに分類。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中の結核制御プログラムと政府の能動的な対応の進捗を報告している。インドネシアは世界的に高い結核負担を持つ国の一つであり、長期的な曝露と流行しやすさの基準には該当するが、急速な増加や緊急的な危機の兆候は見当たらない。継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde autoriza produção da vacina contra Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health authorizes production of the Chikungunya vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Rising chikungunya cases across the country lead the Brazilian Ministry of Health to authorize the Instituto Butantan to produce a chikungunya vaccine. The decision marks an official grant to manufacture the vaccine domestically as chikungunya activity increases nationwide. In Mato Grosso do Sul, multiple municipalities are facing a public health emergency in response to the situation described. The article is reported by Aline Imercio and Gilberto Pereira. It does not provide details on production capacity, timelines, or distribution plans, leaving timelines and logistical details unspecified. No information is provided about vaccine efficacy, regulatory status, or cost. No information is provided about imports or exports.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がチクングニヤワクチン生産を承認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニヤ症例増加に対応したワクチン生産承認という政策的対応が報告されている。しかし、記事は主にワクチン生産の政策決定に焦点があり、実際の流行規模、症例数、死亡者、国際拡大リスク等の詳細が不明であるため、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン生産承認の政策的決定が中心で、実際の流行の規模、症例数、重症度、死亡に関する具体的データが欠落している。チクングニヤは人-人感染が可能な感染症であり、マト・グロッソ・ド・スルで複数自治体が公衆衛生上の緊急事態に直面しているとされているが、詳細は不明。続報で流行状況の実態把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La unidad de aislamiento del Gómez Ulla, una cámara segura creada tras la crisis del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Gómez Ulla isolation unit, a secure chamber created after the Ebola crisis.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-07, Spaniards evacuated from the MV Hondius, where hantavirus cases were detected, will be flown from the Canary Islands to Madrid by a military aircraft and admitted to the Gómez Ulla Central Defense Hospital. They will be held in the hospital’s high-level isolation unit (UAAN), the largest such unit in Spain, with eight isolation rooms, a BSL-III laboratory, and an NRBQ control center with advanced domotics, plus critical-care and an operating theatre. The unit was created in 2015 after the Ebola crisis; historic cases include Miguel Pajares and Teresa Romero. It last year treated a Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever patient and in 2020 housed Spaniards repatriated from Wuhan. The evacuees will undergo medical testing on arrival in the Canary Islands and during quarantine. Staff training, PPE protocols, dual airlocks, and an automated decontamination system reflect ongoing commitment to biosafety and NATO-standard facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ゴメス・ウージャ隔離施設、エボラ危機後に創設されたセキュア・チェンバー
triage.triage_reason: 複数の出血熱（ハンタウイルス、クリミア・コンゴ出血熱）の確認に伴う隔離対応が報じられており、国際的な疾病管理と公衆衛生対応が示唆される。スペインにおける高度隔離施設の稼働は重要な対応事例。
triage.notes: 記事は主にスペインの隔離施設対応に焦点を当てているが、対象国リストの制限により検証対象は中国のみ（武漢からの過去の引揚事例言及）。スペインは対象外。ハンタウイルス、CCHF、エボラの3つの重篤感染症が複数の地理的位置で言及されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Carros fumacê apoiam combate à dengue, zika chikungunya em Alagoinhas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging trucks support the fight against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Alagoinhas.
article.articleSummary: Ten fogging trucks will operate in Alagoinhas, Bahia, Brazil, starting May 7, 2026, to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya spread by Aedes aegypti. Alongside more than 50 endemic agents conducting house-to-house visits across over 1,700 blocks and school-based education, the vehicles supplement routine control efforts. Five trucks launch immediately, with five more arriving soon. Mayor Gustavo Carmo praised the partnership with Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues and Health Secretary Roberta Santana. Health Secretary Luciano Sérgio said deployment follows technical monitoring of the epidemic and targets areas with the highest infestation; the operation follows a schedule and aims to balance efficacy with environmental and health risks, noting that indiscriminate use can cause resistance. The latest bulletin reports 1,374 suspected dengue/Zika/chikungunya cases in 2026, of which 198 are confirmed, 288 discarded, and 888 under investigation. The schedule starts in Petrolar and Centro, with residents urged to continue eliminating breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: アラゴイニャスでデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱との戦いを支援する燻蒸車
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州アラゴイニャスで複数のベクター媒介性感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の同時流行を報告。2026年1374例の疑似患者、198例の確定患者を記録しており異常性と流行性があるが、記事は主に対策実施（燻蒸車派遣）の報道であり、重症度や国際的波及の直接的証拠がないため、情報不足のまま段階的監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はベクター媒介性感染症の複数同時流行を報告しているが、焦点は地方行政による対策実施の報道であるため、より詳細な流行データ（重症度、入院率、死亡例の有無）の確認が必要。バイア州内の限定的な流行と判断される現段階では、後続情報による事態悪化の監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: São Gonçalo mantém ações contra proliferação do Aedes aegypti | São Gonçalo | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Gonçalo maintains actions against the proliferation of Aedes aegypti | São Gonçalo | O Dia
article.articleSummary: São Gonçalo, May 6, 2026 — Aedes aegypti, the mosquito vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, remains a focus of year-round surveillance in São Gonçalo. Although summer has passed, vigilance must be constant, according to the Environmental Health Surveillance agents of the City Health Secretariat. The article notes ongoing efforts by municipal health workers to curb the mosquito's proliferation, while stressing that community participation is essential. Residents are urged to care for their homes and, especially, their backyards, maintaining cleanliness to remove potential breeding sites. The message underscores a collaborative public health approach between authorities and residents to prevent transmission of the arboviruses associated with Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: サンゴンサーロ市がネッタイシマカの増殖に対する対策を継続 | サンゴンサーロ | オ・ディア
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はネッタイシマカ対策の啓発・予防措置に関する公衆衛生情報であり、新たなアウトブレイク事象や異常な感染者急増を報告していない。定常的な蚊媒介感染症対策の実施状況に関する一般的な報道であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の媒介蚊であるネッタイシマカの定常的な監視・対策について述べており、特定の感染症アウトブレイク事象や緊急事態を報告していない。公衆衛生啓発・予防キャンペーンの報道であり、シグナル検知の対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Jundiaí descarta gripe aviária em ave acolhida pela Mata Ciliar | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jundiaí rules out avian influenza in bird sheltered by Mata Ciliar | TVS+
article.articleSummary: In Sorocaba along Raposo Tavares, a wild biguá admitted to the Mata Ciliar rescue center died on 25 April with neurological signs after arriving from a neighboring municipality. On 2 May, authorities initially reported a positive test for Influenza A. The Campinas Epidemiological Surveillance Group (GVE XVII) later confirmed that the sample did not detect Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) or Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza (LPAI); only Influenza A was found, and the epidemiological investigation was closed. Public health officials reiterate precautions: avoid direct contact with sick or dead birds and report suspected cases, and do not handle the animals yourselves. The revised result reduces concerns related to human health risk.

triage.headline_ja: ジュンジャイ市、マタ・シリアルに保護されたの野鳥の鳥インフルエンザを除外 | TVS+
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザは否定されており、通常のインフルエンザAのみ検出。動物での単発例で、公衆衛生への重大な影響やヒト-ヒト感染の国際的拡大リスクは低い。社会的・政治的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は高病原性鳥インフルエンザの陽性初報があったが、その後確認検査で否定された事例を報告している。最終的には通常のインフルエンザAのみ検出で、動物での単発事例。公式な疫学調査は終了し、懸念は低減されている。HPAI/LPAIの確認検査で陰性確定済みのため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Com apoio da SES, projeto de capacitação e diagnóstico em hanseníase percorre Mato Grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With support from the State Health Secretariat, a project for capacity-building and leprosy diagnosis travels across Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Mato Grosso State Health Secretariat backs the 'Roda-Hans: Carreta da Saúde - Leprosy' mobile project, led by the Ministry of Health in partnership with Novartis Biociências S.A. and the Brazilian Society of Dermatology, to train Primary Health Care teams in leprosy management and timely diagnosis. The mobile unit operates in Pontes e Lacerda through May 8 beside USF São Cristóvão, with a stop planned for Conquista d'Oeste from May 11–15. Earlier stops included Cáceres (April 22–24) and Porto Esperidião (April 27–30), training 103 professionals across medical, nursing, dental, and allied fields. The initiative emphasizes active case finding, early diagnosis, contact evaluation, and free SUS treatment to interrupt transmission, with rapid tests for contacts and medication dispensation. In April, SES-MT also conducted the first Leprosy training for 80 Community Health Agents in Várzea Grande. Leprosy is chronic and transmissible, affects skin, peripheral nerves, mucosa of the upper respiratory tract, and eyes; cure is available through SUS, with care at basic units and specialist referral as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ州保健局の支援を受け、ハンセン病対策と診断の能力向上プロジェクトが進行中
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の訓練・能力構築プロジェクトに関する記事で、新規の感染症アウトブレイクではなく公衆衛生プログラムの報道である。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国に含まれていない（南米地域）ため、verified_locationsは空配列。記事内容は既知のハンセン病に対する定期的な公衆衛生イニシアティブであり、緊急の感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Marataízes realiza mutirão contra mosquitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marataízes carries out a mosquito-control drive.
article.articleSummary: On May 6, 2026, Marataízes municipal government conducted a mosquito-control mutirão in Barra de Itapemirim, targeting Aedes aegypti breeding sites in the Filemon Tenório and Candinha neighborhoods and around the CAIC school. The effort mobilized health and urban-services departments. Over 50 sanitation workers, with trucks and machinery, removed tons of debris and ensured proper disposal. More than 80 professionals from Environmental Surveillance and Primary Care inspected streets and properties for potential breeding sites. The Health Secretary emphasized that eliminating breeding sites reduces the risk of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The city notes that irregular debris dumping is prohibited; residents should use dumpsters for construction waste and prevent material accumulation. Citizens are urged to keep yards clean and report irregularities to help curb mosquito proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: マラタイゼス市が蚊対策キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのエスピリト・サント州で実施された蚊対策キャンペーンに関する記事。デング熱、ジカウイルス感染症、チクングニアの予防対策が主題だが、現在のアウトブレイク・症例増加の報告ではなく、予防的なベクター管理活動の報告のため、現段階ではシグナル基準を満たさない。ただし対象国での蚊媒介感染症に関する継続的な関心から経過観察対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事は市民への予防啓発と自治体レベルでの蚊対策キャンペーン実施に焦点を当てている。アクティブなアウトブレイク情報や症例数増加の報告ではなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生対策であるため、現時点ではシグナルピックアップの基準を満たさない。ただしデング熱・ジカウイルス・チクングニアのような蚊媒介性の蔓延しやすい感染症が対象地域で関心事項とされている点から、今後の発生報告に備えた経過観察対象として分類した。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus: tudo o que se sabe sobre vírus que causou óbitos em um cruzeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: everything we know about the virus that caused deaths on a cruise ship.
article.articleSummary: Three deaths linked to a suspected hantavirus outbreak aboard the MV Hondius, a cruise between Argentina and Cabo Verde in the Atlantic, with one confirmed case and five others under investigation as of May 3, 2026 (WHO). Hantavirus is primarily rodent-borne, transmitted to humans mainly by inhaling air contaminated with dried rodent droppings, urine, or saliva; rare transmission via bites or scratches is possible. The disease most commonly causes Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome, beginning with fever, fatigue, muscle pains, chills, headaches and abdominal symptoms, and can progress to severe respiratory distress; CDC notes mortality up to about 38% in severe respiratory involvement. In Brazil the illness is Cardiopulmonary Hantavirus Syndrome; a related condition, Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome, affects kidneys and is more common in Europe/Asia. There is no specific treatment; emphasis on prevention and early diagnosis. A 2025 case involving Betsy Arakawa, wife of Oscar-winning actor Gene Hackman, died from hantavirus-associated respiratory illness.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：クルーズ船での死亡を引き起こしたウイルスについて分かっていることすべて
triage.triage_reason: クルーズ船でのハンタウイルス集団発生疑い（3名死亡、確定1名、調査中5名）は異常かつ予想外で、国際的な拡大リスク（アルゼンチンとカーボベルデ間の航海）があり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。また社会的関心も高い（著名人の死亡例言及）。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域に複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーによると事象は「アルゼンチンとカーボベルデ間のクルーズ船MV Hondiusでの集団発生」であり、対象国リストではBrazilのみが該当。記事がBrazilのハンタウイルス症状形態（心肺型）について言及しているため、Brazilを verified_locations に含める。米国（アイオワ州など）の地名が含まれているが、記事主題はクルーズ船での発生であり米国は主要な発生地ではないため除外。WHO報告による確定1名、調査中5名の事例あり。致命率最大38%との記載で重症度が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever vaccination program expands to ten states
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination program in Venezuela expands from four to ten federal entities as acting president Delcy Rodríguez announced. The states Lara, Portuguesa, Barinas and Aragua—initially covered—are now joined by Guárico, Monagas, Sucre, Apure, Yaracuy and Cojedes. Health Minister Carlos Alvarado said the country has sufficient vaccine supplies to meet demand. To date, 793,455 doses have been administered in the initial four states, reaching 68% of the target population. More than 15,000 university students have joined the training to administer doses, with a similar number projected for the next phase. Rodríguez noted donations from the USA account for 4% of monthly supply, with medicines directed to the Rafael Rangel National Institute of Hygiene for technical verification to ensure safe use. She also cited transparency and ongoing support from UAE, Brazil, and the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病ワクチン接種プログラムが10州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はベネズエラにおける黄熱病ワクチン接種プログラムの拡大に関する公衆衛生対策の実施状況を報じており、新規感染症アウトブレイクの検出ではなく、既存の予防プログラムの運営拡張である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する懸念要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症シグナルではなく、ワクチン接種プログラムの行政上の拡大を報じている。アウトブレイク検出や異常な感染増加の報告ではない。Brazil は記事内で国際支援国として言及されている。ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 62 guests suffer from suspected food poisoning after attending Purandar wedding
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning linked to a Purandar wedding in Maharashtra affected 62 guests after lunch on May 3; symptoms included vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea and abdominal pain. At least 28 were hospitalised, while 38 were treated as outpatients; cases centered in Somurdi village (31 cases, 20 hospitalised) and Nazare Supe (12 outpatient). An additional 11 persons were treated at four private hospitals. A rapid public health response with door-to-door surveys and inpatient care was deployed, with patients in Saswad and nearby private facilities receiving treatment as cases rose. Health teams from Belsar Primary Health Centre and Garade Sub-Centre were mobilised; FDA officials visited but could not collect food samples since the food had ended. No new cases have been reported, and officials say the situation is under control.

triage.headline_ja: プランダル結婚式参列後、62名が食中毒の疑いで罹患
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な食中毒事例（単一イベント由来）で、異常性や国際拡大のリスクは低い。ただし複数州への拡散兆候と初期情報の制約があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはイスラエルが含まれているが、記事サマリーはインド（マハラシュトラ州プランダル）の結婚式関連食中毒に限定。イスラエル（ナザレ）への言及は地理的同名地を誤検出した可能性が高く、検証が必要。イベントは単一結婚式に由来する限定的食中毒で、公衆衛生対応は機能している。症例数は限定的だが、複数の村・施設への分散と初期情報不足により継続観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Tinggi, Pemerintah Genjot Skrining dan Desa Siaga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High TB Cases, Government Steps Up Screening and the Siaga Village Program.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia intensifies TB control with the Siaga TB Village program and expanded screening. In 2026, authorities report more than 241,000 TB cases identified nationwide; treatment initiation reached 84% of a 95% target, while treatment success stood at 80% of a 90% target. TB screening is now integrated with the Free Health Check (CKG) program for the public and workers, initially rolled out across 16 ministries and slated to reach 50 ministries. Community health centers (puskesmas) will receive TB testing devices and X-ray facilities in the second half of 2026 to accelerate case detection. Some 6,484 villages and urban communities have pledged TB prevention efforts, with a goal to establish TB-ready villages in 30% of about 70,000 desa/kelurahan. The government also aims to improve 8,000 homes of TB patients to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者数が多い、政府はスクリーニングと村警戒プログラムを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の高い症例数と政府の対策強化を報告する記事だが、新規の異常な発生、深刻な死亡増加、急速な国際拡大、または緊急の公衆衛生危機を示す具体的な証拠が不足している。既知の疾患に対する継続的な制御活動の報告であり、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 結核は長期的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）を示す既知の疾患であり、WPROスクリーニング基準で2項目該当する。ただし、記事は新規の異常発生やアウトブレイク状況ではなく、政府の継続的な制御プログラムの進捗報告である。国家規模での公衆衛生対応が進行中であることは注目されるが、IHR基準は該当しない。経過観察として、治療成功率の改善動向と新規症例数の推移を継続監視することが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác nguy cơ nhiễm virus Hanta từ thực phẩm bị chuột xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be alert to the risk of Hantavirus infection from food infested by mice.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus infection spreads primarily via contact with urine, feces, or saliva of infected rodents or by inhaling contaminated dust. It can contaminate food indirectly through rodent waste. WHO notes HCPS in the Americas and HFRS in Europe and Asia; human-to-human transmission is rare, recorded only for Andes hantavirus with close, early-contact cases. Transmission routes include rodent bites, consuming contaminated food, or touching contaminated surfaces then mucous membranes. Prevention focuses on reducing rodent contact: clean, seal entry points, securely store food (including animal feed), dampen dust before cleaning, avoid dry sweeping, and reinforce hand hygiene. During outbreaks, early case identification, isolation, and contact tracing are crucial. Vietnam has not recorded human hantavirus cases to date; authorities urge vigilance. triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症は重症度が高く、オランダの船での3名の死亡事例があり国際的拡大リスクがある。ベトナムでは初の警戒警告が発出され、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
